title: Site Care Partner (Lead CRA), Oncology - UK (Remote) - FSP
description:
About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role


We are seeking a Site Care Partner to join our team in a remote capacity. This home-based position includes regular travel across the UK. As a Site Care Partner, you will serve as the primary point of contact for investigative sites throughout the clinical study lifecycle, supporting study start-up, activation, site engagement, recruitment performance, study conduct, and closeout activities.


This role plays a critical part in ensuring site operational success, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and high-quality study delivery. You will build and maintain trusted relationships with investigators and site personnel, coordinate with cross functional study teams, and help drive successful clinical trial execution from study initiation through completion.


You will join a collaborative and growth-oriented environment where your expertise directly contributes to advancing clinical research and helping bring new therapies to patients. This is an excellent opportunity to broaden your impact, strengthen strategic site partnerships, and further develop your career within a global clinical development organization.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead site start-up and activation activities, including site qualification, pre-trial assessments, site initiation activities, and activation readiness
  • Support country and site selection processes by providing local intelligence, feasibility insights, and site assessment input
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with investigator sites throughout the study lifecycle
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for site level questions, coordinating issue resolution across study teams and stakeholders
  • Ensure completion of required training, documentation, and systems activities necessary for successful site activation and study execution
  • Drive site recruitment planning and enrolment support to help achieve study and country level targets
  • Maintain regular communication with sites to monitor study progress, recruitment performance, and operational deliverables
  • Review site monitoring reports and support site compliance with informed consent documentation and amendments
  • Oversee site related deliverables, ensuring timely completion of data entry, data review activities, database lock readiness, and investigator documentation
  • Proactively identify quality, compliance, and operational risks using study data and local intelligence, and implement appropriate mitigation plans
  • Support implementation of decentralized trial capabilities and site adoption of study technologies and processes
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize communication, improve site experience, and strengthen study delivery outcomes

Candidate Profile


You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong relationship building, stakeholder management, and communication skills
  • Experience working in clinical research and regulated healthcare environments
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across cross functional and geographically diverse teams
  • A patient focused mindset with strong attention to quality, compliance, and operational excellence
  • Comfort working with clinical trial systems, study oversight processes, and site management activities

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree, Registered Nurse qualification, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • At least 5 years of experience in clinical research, site management, monitoring, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience in site management with prior experience as a Site Monitor/CRA
  • Demonstrated experience across the full clinical trial lifecycle, from study start-up and site activation through closeout
  • Knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
  • Experience working with clinical trial systems such as EDC, Shared Investigator Platform, Site Profile, or similar clinical research technologies
  • Strong communication, organizational, problem solving, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to travel regularly throughout the UK, up to 50%
  • Proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience supporting multinational clinical studies across a range of therapeutic areas
  • Experience contributing to site feasibility, recruitment planning, and study performance optimization
  • Familiarity with decentralized clinical trial capabilities and associated site technologies
  • Subject matter expertise in clinical research systems, processes, or site management practices

Benefits and Compensation


  • Medical & Dental Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Pension
  • Critical Illness Insurance & Health Screenings

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, which includes life assurance, medical and dental insurance, and additional benefit offerings in accordance with the terms of our applicable plans.


If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work.


Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

We're looking for our next Verification Engineer to join the Verification and Streaming team within the Custom Engineering organisation at Cytiva's site in Uppsala. You will work closely with project managers, design engineers, manufacturing, quality, and customer-facing teams to ensure products are verified against specifications and delivered with the highest standards of quality and compliance. This position offers a combination of hands-on testing, technical problem-solving, documentation, and customer interaction.

This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden and is an onsite role.

  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and project teams to resolve technical challenges and ensure successful project execution.
  • Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and participate in technical discussions with customers.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of verification methods, test equipment, work instructions, and procedures.
  • Ensure verification activities are performed in accordance with Cytiva's quality management system, safety requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of verification activities and test results.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Biotechnology Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong technical aptitude and interest in testing, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, engineering drawings, and product specifications.
  • Experience with technical documentation and report writing.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in product verification, validation, testing, commissioning, or a similar technical role.
  • Experience working with custom-engineered equipment, process systems, or industrial products.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems and regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing activities such as Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), Site Acceptance Tests (SATs), or commissioning activities.

title: Rengasasentajia syksyn sesonkiin
location: Ypäjä, Koski Tl, Oripää, Loimaa, Finland
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksillemme reippaita ja motivoituneita työntekijöitä syksyn rengassesonkiin!
Tarjolla on monipuolisia rengasalan työtehtäviä asiakasyritysten tarpeiden mukaan.

Työtehtäviin voi kuulua esimerkiksi renkaanvaihtoa ja rengaspaineiden tarkistamista, renkaiden siirtelyä, pesua ja varastointia sekä rengasvaraston järjestyksen ylläpitoa. Työssä käytetään muun muassa pulttipyssyä ja autonosturia sekä osaamisen mukaan myös vannekonetta.

Aikaisempi kokemus rengastöistä tai ajoneuvoalalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on reipas ja ahkera työote sekä halu oppia uutta. Myös kokeneemmille tekijöille löytyy mahdollisuuksia sesongin aikana.

Työajat ja työvuorojen määrä voivat vaihdella asiakasyrityksen tarpeen mukaan. Tarjolla voi olla yksittäisiä keikkoja, osa-aikaisempaa työtä tai enemmän tunteja koko sesongin ajaksi. Myös lyhyemmästä työjaksosta kiinnostuneet ovat tervetulleita hakemaan.

Hyvälle tekijälle voi sesonkityön jälkeen avautua mahdollisuus jatkaa pidemmässä tai jopa vakituisessa työsuhteessa. Rengassesonki voikin olla hyvä mahdollisuus päästä tutustumaan työpaikkaan ja löytää pidempiaikainen työ.

Työt alkavat alustavasti syksyn rengassesongin käynnistyessä, ja työvuorot sijoittuvat pääasiassa arkipäiviin. Työaikojen ja työvuorojen suhteen on kuitenkin mahdollista olla joustava asiakasyrityksen tarpeiden mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we’re researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta’s portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

The Finer Print

You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research & Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

In this role, you have the opportunity to:

  • Lead a holistic, human-centered approach to design.
  • Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long-term strategy for your product area.
  • Design and facilitate co-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
  • Craft user-centered artifacts and end-to-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
  • Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
  • Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
  • Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
  • Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team-level and design practice and process improvements.
  • Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
  • Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
  • Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
  • Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
  • Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You have experience leading cross-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
  • You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
  • You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
  • You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day-to-day design workflow.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
  • You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
  • You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
  • You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
  • You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation.
  • You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
  • Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
  • You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
  • Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
  • Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
  • Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
  • Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)

title: Verkstadschef
description:
På Nouryon arbetar vårt globala team målmedvetet för ständig utveckling – kollektivt och individuellt. Vi skapar innovativa, hållbara lösningar som bidrar till våra kunders framgång och till att möta samhällets behov, idag och i morgon.

Vi söker kollegor som skapar nya idéer, driver andra framåt och arbetar tillsammans för att bli bättre. Låter det som du?

Verkstadschefen ansvarar för att leda, planera och utveckla verkstadsverksamheten för att säkerställa att underhåll, reparationer och modifieringar genomförs på ett säkert, effektivt sätt och i enlighet med Nouryons krav avseende säkerhet, kvalitet, miljö och kostnadseffektivitet.

Rollen omfattar ansvar för personal, arbetsmiljö och budget inom verkstadens ansvarsområde och innebär ett nära samarbete med Produktion, PQC, HSE, underhållsorganisationen samt projektorganisationen.

I din framtida roll som Verksandschef kommer du

  • Leda, planera och utveckla den dagliga verksamheten inom verkstaden
  • Säkerställa att underhålls-, reparations- och modifieringsarbeten genomförs säkert, effektivt och med hög kvalitet
  • Ha personalansvar för verkstadens medarbetare, inklusive kompetensutveckling och arbetsmiljöarbete
  • Ansvara för verkstadens budget samt följa upp kostnader och resursutnyttjande
  • Säkerställa efterlevnad av Nouryons krav och riktlinjer inom HSE, kvalitet och hållbarhet

Vi tror att du har

  • Godkänd gymnasial utbildning
  • Gedigen erfarenhet av verkstads-, underhålls- eller industriverksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare och utveckla team mot gemensamma mål
  • God kunskap om arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och riskhantering inom industriell verksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av budgetarbete samt uppföljning av kostnader och nyckeltal
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Bra om du har

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom teknik, underhåll, produktion eller annat relevant område
  • Erfarenhet från processindustri eller kemisk industri
  • Kunskap om underhållssystem, exempelvis SAP PM eller motsvarande
  • Erfarenhet av projektledning, förbättringsarbete eller LEAN-metodik

Vi tror att du är...

En trygg och engagerande ledare som skapar förtroende och delaktighet i gruppen. Du har förmågan att prioritera, fatta beslut och driva arbetet framåt även när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du arbetar strukturerat och säkerhetsmedvetet, med fokus på kvalitet och långsiktiga resultat. Samtidigt är du kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad, vilket gör att du bygger starka relationer både inom den egna verksamheten och med andra funktioner.

Vi erbjuder dig

På Nouryon erbjuder vi inte bara en spännande roll och trevliga kollegor utan även förmåner utöver din lön. Nouryon har kollektivavtal med IKEM, men utöver det erbjuder vi även förmåner som bonus, arbetstidsförkortning, friskvårdsbidrag, kostförmån och mycket mer.

Har vi fångat ditt intresse?

Detta är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placeringsort Örnsköldsvik. Du kommer att rapportera till Magnus Sander, Underhållschef.

Vänligen ansök via vårt rekryteringsverktyg med ett jobbspecifikt CV. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post. När din ansökan nått oss kommer vi att granska för att se om vi har en matchning mellan din kompetens och rollen! För mer information om vår rekryteringsprocess, vänligen besök: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

Som sökande kommer du att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning. Du kommer att få mer information om detta senare i rekryteringsprocessen. Vi arbetar aktivt och strukturerat med HSE-frågor för att skapa en säker och hållbar arbetsmiljö för våra medarbetare. Som anställd kan du därför, vid slumpmässiga tillfällen, komma att genomföra drogtester. Allt för att värna säkerheten och välmående för våra anställda.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

För vissa specifika roller krävs, förutom en god matchning av kvalifikationerna även en genomförd och godkänd hälsoundersökning vid anställningstillfället. Om detta påverkar denna roll kommer det att informeras vid senare tillfälle.

Vi uppmuntrar dig som en uppskattad Nouryon-anställd att dela med dig av talanger från ditt nätverk för att hjälpa oss att ta in nya medarbetare genom vårt nya Employee Referral Program! Att ta in nya, duktiga personer med ett bra mindset är fördelaktigt för både dig och Nouryon. All information du behöver för att göra en referral finns Här. Var med och bidra till tillväxten av Nouryon!

Om Nouryon

Om du letar efter ditt nästa steg i karriären, sök idag och gå med i Nouryons globala team för att erbjuda viktiga lösningar som våra kunder använder för att tillverka vardagsprodukter som personlig vård, rengöring, färger och beläggningar, jordbruk och livsmedel, läkemedel och byggprodukter. Våra anställda drivs av viljan att göra skillnad och aktivt driva positiv förändring. Om det gäller dig, ger vi gärna plats för dina ambitioner. Från dag ett stöttar vi dig i din personliga utveckling, genom utmanande positioner och omfattande möjligheter till lärande och utveckling, i en dynamisk, internationell, mångsidig och proaktiv arbetsmiljö.

Kontakt

För ytterligare information om den lediga tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Magnus Sander, Underhållschef, magnus.sander@nouryon.com

Om du har några frågor om rekryteringsprocessen eller din ansökan eller behöver hjälp, vänligen kontakta: Recruiting.SE@Nouryon.com

För frågor relaterade till facket:

Unionen: Jörgen Tellström – Jorgen.tellstrom@nouryon.com

Akademikerföreningen: Emma Thelander – Emma.thelander@nouryon.com

Ledarna: Anders Broman – Anders.broman@nouryon.com

#WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs

title: Design Development Specialist
description:
Työn kuvaus

Vastaat yrityksemme uuden Revit-pohjaisen 3D-suunnitteluympäristön ja toimintamallin rakentamisesta sisustussuunnittelun käyttöön.

Kyseessä on strategisesti merkittävä tehtävä, jossa kehitetään yrityksen tulevaisuuden suunnittelutapaa. Työ alkaa käytännössä puhtaalta pöydältä, ja sinulla on keskeinen rooli toimintatapojen, työkalujen ja suunnitteluympäristön määrittelyssä. Et toimi varsinaisena suunnittelijana, mutta mahdollistat suunnittelijoiden tehokkaan työskentelyn rakentamalla heille toimivan suunnitteluympäristön.

Työskentelet itsenäisesti ohjausryhmän alaisuudessa. Meiltä saat substanssitukea suunnitteluasioissa sekä tarvittaessa tukea ulkoiselta yhteistyökumppanilta, jolla on kokemusta vastaavan ympäristön rakentamisesta.

title: Growth Accounts and Agency Lead
description:
Growth Accounts and Agency Lead

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working - 2 days in our Hatfield office and 1 day working with agencies in London)

Working hours per week: 40 hours

Level: Lead

Reporting into: Retail Media Director

Application Closing Date: Friday 9th October 2026

About us

Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value.

We’re Ocado Retail, a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, . Not only is the only place to shop a full range of M&S food online, it’s also the home to the widest online supermarket range in the UK and champion of small, independent brands. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado, our same-day grocery delivery service.

About the team and the role

The Growth Accounts and Agency Lead role will focus on accelerating revenue growth by managing and expanding our mid-tier and growth suppliers and driving strategic partnerships with media agencies. Your role covers selling the full Ocado Ads portfolio, including the Beet proprietary data and insights platform, to our CPG partners.

You will be a commercial leader with a deep understanding of retail media, digital advertising, and the grocery landscape.

What you’ll do

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of dedicated Media Planning Managers and Associates, ensuring high performance, professional development, and strong team morale.

  • Oversee team workload, capacity planning, and resource allocation to optimize account coverage and maximize revenue potential.

  • Drive a culture of accountability, commercial excellence, and proactive client engagement within the team.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and training sessions to ensure the team is leveraging best practices in retail media and client relationship management.

Strategic Growth and Account Management

  • Own and exceed ambitious revenue targets across a portfolio of high-value, high-potential mid-tier and growth accounts and agency partners, across retail media and data.

  • Collaborate with buyers and suppliers on their joint business plans (JBPs) for mid-tier clients, outlining strategic growth opportunities, product adoption, and campaign excellence.

  • Act as the primary commercial relationship holder for key advertisers, fostering deep, long-term partnerships at the senior level (CMO, Head of Media, etc.).

  • Identify and convert opportunities for upselling and cross-selling the full suite of Ocado Ads products, including sponsored search, programmatic display, and innovative custom solutions.

Agency Engagement and Development

  • Lead the commercial strategy and engagement with media and programmatic agencies.

  • Educate agency teams on the unique value proposition of Ocado Ads, our first-party data capabilities, and the Ocado Retail customer journey.

  • Establish Ocado Ads as a must-buy platform within agency planning cycles, ensuring deep integration into their clients' yearly media strategies.

  • Educate and enable the wider Ocado Ads team to lead account level agency discussions to drive incremental revenue.

Collaboration and Market Insight

  • Work closely with the Proposition Lead, Commercial and Customer teams to translate client needs into product roadmap suggestions and to effectively package and launch new offerings.

  • Provide accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management for the team’s combined book of business to leadership.

  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and industry changes to proactively adapt commercial strategies.

Who you are

  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, or account management.

  • Experience in a leadership/senior commercial role.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding large sales quotas and driving significant revenue growth.

  • Deep expertise in Retail Media, eCommerce, or programmatic advertising, with an understanding of the grocery sector a strong plus.

  • Exceptional ability to build rapport, influence, and negotiate at the senior executive level, both with clients and agencies.

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of using data and insights to create compelling commercial narratives.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Experience managing and closing complex, multi-year commercial agreements.

What’s in it for you

By joining Ocado Retail, you’ll have the chance to experience life at the world’s largest online retailer, work with an amazing bunch of people who challenge what’s possible each day, and grow your skills and career in online retail.

If that’s not enough to tempt you, you’ll also get access to loads of great benefits to sweeten the deal. Here’s a taste of what we offer:

Health & Wellbeing: Private medical insurance with option to add your family, Digital GP appointments, market-leading family policies, mental health support, discounted gym memberships, dental insurance, and more.

Spend & Save: Annual bonus scheme split between personal and business objectives, recognition with reward platform, up to 7% matched pension contributions, 15% Ocado discount, 20% M&S discount, free breakfast every day in the office, electric vehicle leasing scheme, and free shuttle bus from Hatfield station to the office.

Never miss the moments that matter: Hybrid working, 26 days holiday plus 8 flexible bank holidays, options to buy extra holiday, 2 weeks work from anywhere, and lifestyle break opportunities.

Our Hiring Process

Lucky for us, we receive a high volume of applications and genuinely appreciate the time and effort invested by every candidate. To ensure a fair and thorough process, every application is reviewed by a member of our team. If your skills and experience are a strong match, a Talent Partner will contact you to discuss the role and guide you through the next steps of our hiring process.

Your Application and AI

In the spirit of innovation, we welcome you to use AI tools in your application, just as we use them in our own business at Ocado Retail. However, as you leverage this technology, please don't lose sight of the most important element: your unique self. Your experiences, passions, and personality are what truly set you apart. Ensure that your application still authentically conveys who you are and why you're a great fit for us.

Everyone’s welcome

We’re an equal opportunities employer, which means that we make sure all potential colleagues are treated fairly and equally. We want to ensure everyone has a fair chance to apply; if you need this job description in an alternative format (e.g., larger print, different document type, etc.), please reach out to us at careers@ocadoretail.com and we'll be happy to assist you, and if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know on the application form.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Software Engineer — Full-Stack (Front-End Focused) About the company

A fast-growing, fully remote FinTech SaaS company sitting at the intersection of payments and data intelligence — the product helps merchants, and the software platforms they rely on, manage and reduce the cost of processing electronic payments. The team is small, close-knit, and genuinely AI-forward: engineers use agentic development tools day to day, and the culture leans toward mentorship and real autonomy over rigid process. It shows in retention — the engineering team's average tenure runs about four years, with zero voluntary attrition.

About the role

We're hiring a Software Engineer to join a small, high-trust engineering team and take real ownership of the front-end product experience. This is a full-stack role that is heavily front-end weighted in practice — you'll spend most of your time in the UI layer, with occasional backend exposure. You'll be this team's first dedicated front-end hire reporting to the front-end lead, so there's a genuine opportunity to shape how the role and the front-end practice grow from here.

What you'll do
  • Own front-end features end to end — from UI/UX implementation through shipping — using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and React (Vite as the build tool).

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
The Senior Software Engineer (IC3) on AI-Native ITSM designs, builds, and delivers agentic and conversational features that help IT operators and end-users navigate the ITSM workflows. You work within an established architecture and domain strategy to author agentic instructions, build conversational experiences, and integrate AI capabilities into production ITSM workflows. Unlike traditional full-stack roles, you engage directly with natural-language engineering—prompts, instructions, and tool definitions are your working materials, versioned and tested alongside code. You design and build the automated evaluation that verifies agentic behavior at scale, and you own the correctness and safety of the features you ship. You collaborate with IC4 architects on domain strategy and mentor IC1-IC2 engineers on the practices that make agentic delivery reliable. #### What You Do - Build agentic features within the incident and request lifecycle: Deliver complete features that span intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action—such as intelligent request categorization, incident summarization and classification, or guided self-service resolution—working within the domain architecture established by IC4. - Author and test agentic instructions: Write system instructions, tool definitions, guardrails, and escalation rules as engineered artifacts. Design evaluation sets and automated testing that verify behavior across model versions and edge cases. Collaborate with IC4 on shared instruction surfaces. - Build conversational experiences: Design and implement experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly to live agents, and behave consistently across chat, voice, and API channels. Account for user error recovery, confirmation before consequential actions, and graceful degradation. - Integrate AI capabilities into production ITSM workflows: Connect LLM APIs, retrieval-grounded features, agent orchestration, and tool calling to ITSM data models and business logic. Implement structured output enforcement and validation. - Design and operate automated evaluation: Build golden datasets, multi-turn test suites, and scoring frameworks calibrated to human judgment. Implement CI gates and drift detection that make it safe to iterate on instructions and models. - Participate in production operations: Monitor conversation quality, containment, and error rates. Investigate production issues, trace agentic reasoning, and feed findings back into specifications and evaluation sets. Participate in on-call rotations for customer-facing systems. - Mentor junior engineers: Guide IC1-IC2 engineers on agentic instruction authoring, testing practices, and responsible AI principles. Review code and specifications for correctness, security, and maintainability. - Contribute to platform architecture: Work with IC4 on data models, API design, and integration patterns that support agentic behavior at scale. Identify improvements and technical debt.

Required Experience and Skills - Production software delivery: 5–7 years building and shipping production features, including direct experience with AI-native application features used by real customers. - Agentic experience: Direct experience authoring prompts and instructions, designing autonomous workflows, or building evaluation for model-driven features. This is required, not preferred. - LLM integration: Experience with LLM APIs, agent orchestration, function calling, and retrieval augmentation in production systems. - Full-stack fundamentals: Strong proficiency in front-end development (modern frameworks), server-side development, data modeling, and API design (REST or GraphQL). - Applied ML literacy: Working understanding of evaluation metrics, embeddings, model behavior, and common failure modes sufficient to reason about and verify agentic behavior. - Testing and quality: Demonstrated ability to design comprehensive test suites, including automated testing of non-deterministic behavior. - Operational experience: Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerized workloads, observability, and incident response. - Collaboration: Strong communication and the ability to work across product, design, and engineering teams. - Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience - ITSM domain knowledge: Familiarity with incident management, request fulfillment, knowledge management, or service operations. - Evaluation tooling: Experience building or using evaluation frameworks, prompt management platforms, or tracing tools for AI applications. - Conversation design: Collaboration with conversation designers or UX professionals on dialogue and error handling. - ServiceNow platform: Familiarity with ServiceNow ITSM, Flow Designer, UI Builder, or ATF.

title: Business Analyst / Analytics Consultant
description:
The role

We’re hiring Business Analysts and Analytics Consultants to our team in Helsinki. We’re hiring at two levels. Business Analyst suits people earlier in their career who bring analytical strength and want to build the customer-facing and domain side here. Analytics Consultant suits people who already carry a customer engagement independently and can own the value story end to end. Apply once and we’ll talk with you about which fits.

You’ll work with real data from some of the largest retailers and manufacturers in the world, take ownership of the analysis and the demo that show what RELEX can do for them.

We expect you to be good with data when you arrive. We’ll make you better at it.

Your key strength is knowing the customer’s data and understanding what happens behind the numbers. Finding a gap in a customer’s replenishment performance is one thing. Knowing what it costs them, why their category manager cares, and what changes on Monday if they fix it is another.

You’ll work closely with our clients and present the work yourself. Most of that happens remotely, sometimes at the customer’s own office. It means staying credible about what your analysis does and doesn’t show.

You’ll build quickly. We use AI daily for data work, to speed up configuration, documentation and demo building, and to build our own prompts, agents and tools for the work we repeat. The people who build those tools are the same people who use them.

Our customers are global. Willingness to travel internationally for customer workshops and presentations is part of the role, though currently this isn’t a travel-heavy position.

What you’ll do

Turn data into a value case

  • Analyze large customer datasets to find performance gaps
  • Configure RELEX software to simulate improved performance, and root cause the impact on customer KPIs
  • Translate KPI movement into value the customer recognizes as their own problem, not a generic benchmark

Build with AI, and build quickly

  • Use AI tooling daily to enhance analysis, configuration, documentation and customer materials
  • Build prompts, tools, agents and skills that take repetitive work off the table and extend what every analyst can deliver
  • Turn what works into reusable assets that lift the whole team, not only your own output

Work with customers

  • Build and deliver solution demos using RELEX software
  • Present findings to customer stakeholders at every level, from operational teams to executives
  • Handle questions and challenge in the room, and adjust the story to the audience
  • Support sales and presales colleagues with RFP responses

What we expect

  • Comfort with data wrangling across large datasets, in the range of several million rows and multiple tables
  • Working proficiency in Python, SQL or Snowflake. PowerBI, Tableau or Excel alone won’t be enough
  • Everyday use of AI tooling in your work, or clear evidence that you pick up new tools fast and push them past the defaults
  • An instinct for why a finding matters commercially, not only whether it’s correct
  • The ability to explain a technical finding to a commercial audience and make them care about it
  • The courage to disagree and put your own view forward, with customers and with colleagues
  • Confidence presenting to stakeholders at every level
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can be productive before you feel fully up to speed, and an incomplete brief doesn’t stop you
  • Steadiness when things don’t go to plan, because in presales they sometimes don’t
  • Fluent English

What we consider a strong plus

  • Retail, CPG, wholesale or manufacturing experience, in any function close to planning, merchandising or supply chain
  • A relevant academic background such as business, engineering, supply chain, computer science or data analytics
  • Something you’ve built yourself with AI tooling that went beyond a prototype
  • Other languages at a high level

Who we are

RELEX Solutions is an industry-leading provider of an AI-driven unified supply chain and retail planning platform for retailers and manufacturers. We help companies optimize demand forecasting, replenishment, merchandising, supply chain operations, and production planning across the end-to-end value chain.

Presales Analytics is the team that shows customers what’s possible before they commit. We work with their data, configuring and adapting our platform to their needs, and build the case for a more value-adding future process. All the while working with the client to ensure our proposals are relevant and impactful.

It means we see more of this business than almost anyone. Many customers, many industries, every part of the platform, and all of it early, when the questions are still open.

Solution areas

We work across Forecasting & Replenishment, Manufacturing, and Merchandising. These roles aren’t tied to one area. We place people based on strength, interest and where we need them, so tell us in your application if something pulls you, and tell us if you’d rather stay open.

Ready to apply?

Complete our application form in English, including your resume and cover letter by October 11th. In your cover letter, please cover:

  • What interests you about Presales Analytics at RELEX specifically, and how you hope to develop in the role
  • A time you had to convince someone of something using data, and what made it land or fall flat
  • How you use AI tooling in your work today, and something you’ve built or automated with it
  • Which RELEX Value resonates with you most, and why (more about our culture and values)

We fill these positions as soon as we find the right people, so we’d recommend applying early. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Elektriker till Häggmarks Byggmodul

title: Freelance Senior DevSecOps Engineer
location: European Union, Kazakhstan, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia
description:
Company Intro

At Toloka AI we create data that powers leading GenAI models and innovations. We work with frontier labs, big tech, renowned AI startups, enterprises and non-profit research organizations worldwide. We use a combination of Experts + Crowd + Tech Platform to teach AI models to reason and evaluate their efficacy and safety. We have experts in more than 50 different domains—from doctors and lawyers to physicists and engineers—and boast one of the most diverse global crowds, representing over 100 countries and speaking 40+ languages. We are a well-funded startup with an enviable portfolio of clients including Anthropic, Amazon, Microsoft, poolside, Recraft, and Shopify.

Recently, we secured strategic investment led by Bezos Expeditions with participation from Mikhail Parakhin, CTO of Shopify and board advisor to leading GenAI companies, who now serves as our Chairman of the Board. Our remote-first team is globally distributed around the world: USA, UK, the Netherlands, Serbia, and more. We are headquartered in Amsterdam.

About the Position

Toloka is growing rapidly, adding new platforms and infrastructure across multiple cloud environments. We are hiring a senior, hands-on security engineer to own infrastructure security and vulnerability management: Kubernetes and service-mesh security, cloud hardening, and vulnerability remediation.

This is a senior, self-directed role. It requires the ability to define scope and drive execution independently, with ownership of core security tooling and processes from day one.

What you'll actually do

  • Own vulnerability management. Operate and maintain the vulnerability-management platform. Ensure container images are scanned and patched on a defined cadence. Maintain supply-chain scanning tooling and its severity-classification configuration. Define and enforce remediation SLAs.
  • Own cloud security across multiple providers. AWS, GCP, and Azure hardening, logging, and service-account governance.
  • Own Kubernetes and service-mesh security. Operate the service mesh and maintain the policy-as-code rollout so that policy is enforced automatically.
  • Audit and secure infrastructure in newly added environments. Review build pipelines and infrastructure in newer parts of the business as they come online, and remediate findings.
  • Contribute to security architecture and design review. Review new integrations and internal systems, including AI agents running in production, for security risk.
  • Support workforce and endpoint security. Contribute to VDI and browser-isolation initiatives as the program matures.
  • Use agentic tooling in your workflow. Use coding agents for first-pass review of infrastructure-as-code, container configuration, and cloud policy, verifying findings against source configuration before acting on them.

Key Priorities for the First 6 Months

The first six months focus on establishing full ownership of infrastructure and vulnerability management.

  • Weeks 1–2 - Onboard to the cloud environment, Kubernetes architecture, and existing security tooling.
  • Month 1 - Establish ownership of the vulnerability-management process; findings triaged and remediated on a defined cadence.
  • Month 2 - Complete configuration of supply-chain scanning tooling; implement automated image scanning and patching; deploy initial policy-as-code rules.
  • Month 3 - Complete policy-as-code rollout in at least one environment; begin infrastructure audits in newly added environments.
  • Month 4 - Close outstanding cloud logging and service-account gaps; establish and enforce a documented multi-cloud hardening baseline.
  • Months 5–6 - Full ownership of infrastructure and cloud security as a domain; independently deliver security-architecture design reviews.

Core Tech Stack

Kubernetes and service mesh, policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno/OPA), Terraform, AWS/GCP/Azure, vulnerability-management and supply-chain scanning platforms, container tooling, CI/CD, and Git. Detections and access rules are managed as code through pull requests. Familiarity with coding/agentic tools for infrastructure review is expected.

What We Evaluate

  • Production experience hardening cloud infrastructure - IAM, logging, service accounts, network security, on at least one major cloud provider (multi-cloud experience is a plus).
  • Kubernetes and container security - service mesh (Cilium, Istio, or similar) and policy-as-code (Kyverno, OPA, or similar).
  • Vulnerability-management experience - SCA/SAST tooling and SLA-driven remediation practice.
  • Fluency with coding agents - experience using agentic tools for infrastructure-as-code review or investigation work, and verifying their output.
  • Ability to work independently at a senior level - defining scope and priorities without detailed direction.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - able to run design reviews and communicate risk to engineers and leadership.

Nice to Have, None Required

Experience securing multi-tenant or multi-identity-domain environments; supply-chain security tooling (SBOM, Socket, JFrog, or similar); secure-SDLC or AppSec experience; Terraform/IaC at scale; relevant certifications (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure security specialties, CKS).

What We Can Offer

  • Contract (B2B) collaboration, with a path into a project team if things go well;
  • Flexible, fully remote schedule (40 hours per week);
  • Work at the leading edge of AI development, alongside a dedicated and dynamic team of experts;
  • Projects with customers that are AI industry leaders and well-known household names;
  • Friendly community.

[Important Notice] Scam Alert Regarding Fake Job Postings

It has come to our attention that an individual or group is fraudulently impersonating Toloka to post fake jobs and solicit personal information from applicants.Please be aware:

  • Official Communication: Our recruiting team will only contact you from an official "" email address. We will NEVER use Gmail, Yahoo, Tolokainc, toloka.inc, or other personal or seemingly business email accounts.
  • Our Process: We will never ask for your bank account details, credit card number, or any fees as part of the application or interview process.
  • Official Listings: All legitimate job openings are posted on our official careers page:
What to do: If you see a suspicious job posting or have been contacted by someone you suspect is a scammer, please do not provide any personal information. Instead, report the incident to us directly at security@toloka.ai and report the profile/post to LinkedIn.We are taking this matter very seriously and are working with the appropriate parties to resolve it.

Thank you for your vigilance!

To learn how we collect, use, disclose, and store personal data, check out our Privacy Notice.

title: Tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia toimitilahuoltajia, Porvoo / Loviisa / Sipoo / Pukkila
description:
Oletko puhtausalan ammattilainen ja etsit joustavaa työtä Porvoon, Loviisan, Sipoon tai Pukkilan alueelta? Tule osaksi Palmian siivouspalveluiden tiimiä tuottamaan puhtautta ja turvallisuutta monipuolisiin asiakaskohteisiimme!

Työtehtävät

Etsimme yhteensä seitsemää tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa toimitilahuoltajaa Porvoon, Loviisan, Sipoon ja Pukkilan alueille vaihteleviin työvuoroihin.

Työpäiväsi kuluu pääsääntöisesti terveydenhuollon kohteiden puhtauden parissa. Siivousalueeltasi löytyy muun muassa terveyskeskuksia ja palvelutaloja. Suoritat ylläpitosiivouksen ja jaksottaisten perussiivouksien työtehtävät ammattitaitoisella työotteella.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava. Työvuoroja on tarjolla kaikkina viikonpäivinä maanantaista sunnuntaihin. Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti klo 09.00-21.00 välille. Työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi osa-aikatyötä, lisätyötä tai joustavuutta arkeen etsivälle.

Miksi meille?

Teemme Palmialla arjen palvelutyötä, jolla on suora vaikutus ihmisten jokapäiväiseen arkeen. Meillä olet osa kehittyvää, monipuolista ja osaavaa työyhteisöä, jossa avautuu säännöllisesti urapolkumahdollisuuksia esimerkiksi kokoaikaiseksi toimitilahuoltajaksi.

Urapolku mahdollisuuksien lisäksi panostamme työntekijöidemme ammatilliseen osaamiseen. Tavoitteemme on, että jokainen siivouspalveluidemme työntekijä suorittaa työn ohessa toimitilapalvelualan ammattitutkintoon johtavan, Palmian oman PRYL-koulutuksen. Lisäksi tuemme esihenkilöidemme osaamista tarjoamalla heille mahdollisuuden suorittaa lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinnon.

Tarjoamme työsuhde-etuna Epassin, jota voit käyttää työmatka-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Työterveyspalvelumme kattavat lakisääteisen työterveyshuollon lisäksi tuki- ja liikuntaelinsairauksien ja mielenterveyden sairauksien ennaltaehkäisevät palvelut.

Lue työnantajalupauksemme ja katso mitä ammattilaisemme kertovat työstään!

Edellytämme sinulta

Edellytämme sinulta työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä tai puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan tutkintoa. Menestyäksesi työssä tarvitset vuorovaikutustaitoja ja hyvää suomen kielen suullista osaamista. Työskentelyalueestasi riippuen työssä voidaan edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Arvostamme, että olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, oma-aloitteinen ja motivoitunut henkilö. Katsomme eduksi käytännön kokemuksen terveydenhuollon kohteissa työskentelystä, sekä peruspesuista ja siivouskoneiden käytöstä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae heti, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 18.10.2026. Huomioithan, että vastaanotamme hakemuksia ainoastaan sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian, sopimuksen mukaan.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat rekrytointitiimiltämme sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekrytointi@palmia.fi.

Ihmisten arjen sujuvaksi tekeminen on työtä, joka ei tule koskaan loppumaan. Palmia on merkittävä palvelualan toimija ja tarjoaa laajasti uramahdollisuuksia eri alojen tekijöille. Tarvitsemme jatkuvasti lisää ammattilaisia turvallisuus-, ruoka- ja ravintola-, siivous- sekä kiinteistö- ja talotekniikkapalvelujen tehtäviin. Tule meille jättämään oma kädenjälkesi!

title: Staff Technical Program Manager
company: MX Build Technologies India Private Limited
description:
We are fueled by a moral imperative to advance mankind, and it all begins with our people, our product, and our purpose. Passion isn’t something we turn on and off; it’s woven into everything we do. If you thrive in high-challenge environments, are inspired by exceptional teammates, and are driven to grow beyond what you thought possible, MX is where you belong.

Come build the future with us. Join an award-winning company that isn’t just shaping the financial industry, but transforming it in ways that create meaningful, lasting impact for millions of people.

Job Summary

We are looking for a strong program leader and strategic operator who can autonomously execute complex enterprise initiatives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will wear multiple hats (Technical Program Manager, Agile Coach, Process Designer, Storyteller, and Systems Thinker) to drive critical Financial Product initiatives at MX while partnering with engineering and product leadership to align on high-impact outcomes and scalable architectures.

From day one, you will influence both product strategy and technical execution to help us build and improve our platform while scaling the organization itself. You will bring expertise in best-in-class frameworks for work intake, prioritization, SDLC optimization, team management, and decision-making, along with the ability to navigate technical trade-offs, increase developer velocity, and create clarity across ambiguous problems.

If you are a creative problem-solver with a passion for optimizing processes, scaling businesses through analytical and general management skills, and building through sane, compassionate collaboration, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Program Leadership & Delivery: Communicate goals, roles, and outcomes; drive delivery on time, within scope, and on budget. Own performance, scalability, and reliability targets for releases. Manage multiple simultaneous initiatives with time-sensitive constraints. Demonstrate financial acumen in budget planning, resource allocation, and P&L awareness.

  • Requirements & Strategic Planning: Translate high-level business needs into actionable technical roadmaps and API contracts. Develop program-level and product/technology roadmaps that align cross-functional dependencies. Inform executive decisions with data-backed resource and risk analysis.

  • Risk, Transparency, & Governance: Establish proactive risk detection frameworks using RAID logs and mitigation strategies. Track and publish program health dashboards, including executive summaries and detailed drill-downs. Drive data-informed decision reviews and OKR/KPI governance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Build effective networks across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and InfoSec. Simplify complex challenges into pragmatic plans and tell compelling program narratives that align diverse stakeholders. Navigate matrixed-management environments with empathy and influence.

  • Process Design, Coaching, & Technical Governance: Design enterprise-wide processes that increase successful program delivery and adoption. Mentor teams on software delivery best practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall). Facilitate technical design reviews and partner on architectural trade-offs between scalability and speed-to-market. Lead structured change rollouts and drive adoption. Develop and coach technical program managers to elevate the TPM discipline across the organization.

  • Tools & Systems Mastery: Establish Atlassian Suite governance and drive best practices in Jira Software, JPD, and JSM. Create data visualizations that translate complex information for executive and team audiences. Identify and implement AI-assisted automation to increase team efficiency in reporting, insights generation, and documentation, while staying current on emerging workflows.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Technical Program Management experience leading large-scale software delivery in a New Product Development environment.

  • 3+ years of experience leading or mentoring other technical program managers.

  • Proven track record of managing end-to-end SDLC for complex distributed systems.

  • Atlassian Suite expertise, ideally having served as a global administrator.

  • Expertise in the Scrum framework, with a proven track record of scaling and tailoring agile practices to an organization's maturity level to drive engineering velocity and sprint health.

  • Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with rapidly evolving priorities.

  • Strong bias toward action, with the ability to unblock teams autonomously and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across matrixed teams and build trust with peers at all levels.

  • Proven ability to rapidly absorb and synthesize complex technical information, allowing for deep engagement in architectural discussions.

Advanced Requirements (Optional)

  • Experience with personal financial management or wealth management tools.

  • Experience managing AI/ML product development and deployment.

  • Ability to navigate technical ambiguity and resolve blockers during zero-to-one builds.

  • Systems-thinking mindset with experience in long-term technical strategy and tech debt reduction.

  • Analytical skills to utilize engineering metrics for decision-making and product insights.

  • Bias toward building automated inspection mechanisms and technical governance processes.

  • 3+ years of direct experience in a technical role (SWE, SRE, DevOps, or Systems Architect).

  • Experience leading systemic change management within an engineering organization.

  • PMP and CSM certifications.

Compensation

The expected earnings for this role could be comprised of a base salary and other forms of cash compensation, such as bonus or commissions as applicable.

This pay range is just one component of MX’s total rewards package. MX takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location, skillset, peer compensation.

**Please note applicants applying for this position must have the legal right to work in India without the need for sponsorship. We are unable to provide work sponsorship for this role, and candidates should be able to verify their eligibility to work in the country independently. Proof of eligibility to work in India will be required as part of the hiring process.

Work Environment

In this role, a significant aspect of the job involves working in the office for a standard 40-hour workweek. We believe that the collaborative nature of our work and the face-to-face interactions among team members are essential for fostering a dynamic and productive work environment. Being present in the office enables seamless communication, facilitates quick decision-making, and encourages spontaneous collaboration that contributes to the overall success of our projects. We value the synergy that comes from having our team members physically together, allowing for immediate problem-solving, idea exchange, and team building.

title: Sales Engineer (SE)
description:
Sales Engineer (SE)

Help Make Manufacturing the Most Secure Industry in the World

At Secomea, we are on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

We are looking for a customer-focused Sales Engineer who can bridge the gap between complex technical environments and commercial success. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales and customers throughout the buying journey, helping prospects understand, validate, and successfully adopt Secomea's solutions.

You will play a critical role in technical discovery, solution design, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical deal execution, ensuring customers have the confidence to choose Secomea as their trusted cybersecurity partner.

This is a highly customer-facing role where you will work closely with Sales, Implementation, Product, and technical teams to understand customer challenges, design the right technical solution, and help customers validate that Secomea is the right choice for their environment.

You will report to Jesper Sønderby Andersen, Senior Director of Global CSM, Professional and Implementation Services, Solution Architects.

About Secomea

Secomea is on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

Trusted by thousands of industrial companies worldwide, we provide secure remote access and cybersecurity solutions that help manufacturers, machine builders, and infrastructure operators connect, monitor, and support critical equipment safely and efficiently.

Headquartered in Denmark and operating globally, Secomea combines deep industrial expertise with a strong cybersecurity focus. We are ambitious, customer-centric, and passionate about solving complex challenges for some of the world's most important industries.

Joining Secomea means becoming part of a growing international company where your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work has a direct impact on customers around the globe.

Your Mission

As one of our Sales Engineers, your primary objective is to establish Secomea as the preferred technical solution and remove technical barriers throughout the sales process.

You will partner with Sales from opportunity qualification through discovery, solution design, technical validation, Proof of Concept execution, and deal closure.

A significant part of your role will involve leading and executing customer PoCs. You will define success criteria, design and configure solutions, coordinate technical evaluations, solve challenges, and ensure customers reach a clear and confident technical decision.

Your role is not simply to demonstrate technology. You will help customers understand how Secomea solves their specific challenges and deliver the confidence needed to move forward.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Discovery & Solution Design

  • Support Sales in qualifying opportunities and determining the appropriate level of technical engagement.

  • Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, challenges, security requirements, and success criteria.

  • Design secure and scalable solution architectures aligned with customer OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity environments.

  • Identify technical risks early and develop mitigation strategies.

  • Deliver tailored demonstrations that address each customer's unique needs and use cases.

  • Translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes and customer value.

Proof of Concept (PoC) Leadership

A key part of this role is planning and executing successful customer PoCs.

You will:

  • Define scope, success criteria, timelines, responsibilities, and decision points.

  • Configure and deploy Secomea solutions within customer environments.

  • Collaborate directly with OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity teams.

  • Ensure agreed use cases and success criteria are validated.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with Product, Support, R&D, and Implementation teams when required.

  • Maintain momentum and proactively manage technical blockers and dependencies.

  • Present findings and technical recommendations to customer stakeholders.

  • Support Sales in converting successful technical validation into commercial success.

  • Capture learnings and continuously improve technical playbooks, demonstrations, and future engagements.

Technical Deal Execution

  • Own the technical solution strategy for assigned opportunities.

  • Support RFIs and RFPs with clear and compelling technical responses.

  • Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, and implementation recommendations.

  • Support security reviews, technical due diligence, and customer audits.

  • Address technical objections throughout the sales process.

  • Position Secomea effectively against competing solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical teams and decision-makers.

  • Ensure technical decision criteria are met and no unresolved blockers remain before deal closure.

Continuous Improvement

At Secomea, winning deals is important, but learning from them is equally valuable.

You will:

  • Conduct win/loss reviews on relevant opportunities.

  • Identify recurring objections, competitive challenges, and market trends.

  • Maintain accurate technical opportunity data within Salesforce.

  • Share customer and market insights with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Sales Engineering processes, demonstrations, and technical positioning.

What You'll Need to Succeed

To succeed in this role, you will be able to:

  • Understand complex technical environments across OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity.

  • Translate customer requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

  • Lead structured discovery sessions and uncover business and technical needs.

  • Manage complex Proofs of Concept involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues methodically and effectively.

  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build credibility with engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and technical decision-makers.

  • Balance technical expertise with commercial awareness.

  • Take ownership and drive customer engagements forward.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience within Sales Engineering, Operational Technology (OT), Cybersecurity, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and complex B2B sales cycles.

  • Strong understanding of networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or industrial environments.

  • Professional working proficiency in English and either French or German.

  • Ability to confidently conduct customer meetings, workshops, technical discussions, and Proofs of Concept in English and either French or German.

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, customer success, and commercial impact.

You are curious, analytical, and customer-focused. You enjoy solving complex challenges, communicating clearly, and helping customers make informed technical decisions.

We imagine you bring experience from one or more of the following areas:

  • Sales Engineering / Pre-Sales

  • Operational Technology (OT)

  • Cybersecurity

Experience across multiple disciplines will be considered a significant advantage.

It Would Be a Strong Advantage If You Have

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role.

  • Experience planning and executing customer PoCs or technical pilots.

  • Experience working with industrial customers, manufacturers, machine builders, or critical infrastructure.

  • Strong presentation and demonstration skills.

  • The ability to simplify complex technical concepts for different audiences.

  • A strong customer-centric mindset and commercial understanding.

  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Product, Support, and Implementation teams.

How We Think About Sales Engineering

At Secomea, Sales Engineering is not just about answering technical questions or delivering product demonstrations.

A great Sales Engineer helps move customers from:

Relevant → Secure → Validated → Justified → Closed

You help establish that:

  • Secomea is relevant to the customer's challenges.

  • The proposed architecture is secure and technically viable.

  • The solution works within the customer's environment.

  • Technical and business value are clearly understood.

  • Risks and objections are proactively addressed.

  • The customer is confident in selecting Secomea as their trusted partner.

Why Join Secomea

  • Join a global cybersecurity company with ambitious growth plans.

  • Work with some of the world's leading industrial companies and manufacturers.

  • Influence strategic customer decisions and directly impact commercial success.

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering.

  • Be part of a culture built on trust, ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about cybersecurity, industrial technology, and helping customers solve real-world challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Trainee | ALD Stavanger 2026

Lurer du på hvordan det er å jobbe som forretningsadvokat? Som trainee i Thommessen får du fem uker midt i kjernen av det vi driver med – fra den første klientsamtalen til den endelige kontrakten er signert.

Hensikten er enkel: du blir kjent med oss, og vi blir kjent med deg. Mange av våre advokatfullmektiger, advokater og partnere har selv stått i dine sko og startet karrieren som trainee i Thommessen. Målet vårt er at du skal trives hos oss, og få et reelt innblikk i vårt arbeidsmiljø og vår arbeidshverdag.

Hva opplever du hos oss?

Du er en del av teamet vårt – i et sterkt fagmiljø med tett samarbeid. Det betyr at du kan bli involvert i rettskildesøk og utredningsarbeid for pågående saker, skrive utkast til prosesskriv, tilsvar eller notater. Hos oss vil vi også at du skal få delta i klientmøter og se hvordan vi bygger tillit og relasjoner. Traineer får muligheten til å være med i pågående rettssaker og oppleve prosedyre på nært hold, og ellers bidra til andre praktiske oppgaver. Hos oss skal du ikke bare observere, du skal bidra. Kort sagt: du får prøve deg på det samme arbeidet som våre advokatfullmektiger gjør hver dag.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en jusstudent som har påbegynt tredje studieår. Vi forutsetter at studieløpet ditt inkluderer en mastergrad, eller at du er tatt opp på master i rettsvitenskap. Vi tar imot søkere fra alle universiteter.

Du har sterke akademiske resultater og engasjerer deg i nærings- og samfunnsliv. Du er motivert, liker nye utfordringer og er en lagspiller. Du trives med faglige problemstillinger, og ønsker å se jussens kommersielle side.

Søknad og prosess

Vi behandler søknader og intervjuer kandidater løpende, så ingen grunn til å vente med å sende inn søknaden din. I søknadsskjemaet ønsker vi at du svarer på noen relevante spørsmål knyttet til stillingen.

I Thommessen tror vi på styrken i et mangfoldig team og verdsetter ulike erfaringer og perspektiver. Hos oss skal alle, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, etnisitet, religion, seksuell orientering, funksjonsevne eller bakgrunn, kunne være seg selv og oppleve like muligheter. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

title: Store Collega JD Delft| 8-12u
description:
JD Delft zoekt nieuwe collega's (8-12u) die ons team willen ondersteunen en versterken!

Als Store Collega speel je een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een uitstekende winkelervaring. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich welkom, ondersteund en gewaardeerd voelen, en helpt hen bij het ontdekken van onze producten. Je brengt energie naar de winkelvloer door klanten vriendelijk te begroeten, de presentatie van de winkel verzorgd te houden, voorraadaanvulling uit te voeren en hoge service- en kwaliteitsnormen te waarborgen. Dankzij jouw positieve instelling, teamgeest en klantgerichte aanpak draag je bij aan een vlot draaiende winkel met de hoge standaard waarvoor wij bekendstaan.

Ben je klaar om aan de slag te gaan in een dynamische retailomgeving, nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en deel uit te maken van een ondersteunend team? Dan is dit een mooie kans om impact te maken en een sterke basis te leggen voor je verdere loopbaan.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verwelkomt klanten op een vriendelijke en professionele manier en helpt hen bij het vinden van de producten die bij hun wensen passen.
  • Je gebruikt de beschikbare winkeltools en digitale systemen om voorraad te controleren, productinformatie te delen en de klantenervaring te ondersteunen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de winkelvloer en de stock room netjes, verzorgd en goed aangevuld blijft, zodat productpresentaties aantrekkelijk en inspirerend zijn.
  • Je ondersteunt dagelijkse winkelactiviteiten, zoals kassawerkzaamheden, het aanvullen van voorraad, stock room werkzaamheden en het naleven van alle veiligheids- en winkelrichtlijnen.

Wie we zoeken

  • Je hebt een positieve en enthousiaste houding die past binnen een dynamische en klantgerichte retailomgeving.
  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel in het contact met klanten en collega's.
  • Je bent leergierig, neemt graag nieuwe taken op en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om verschillende diensten te werken, waaronder avonden, weekends en drukke seizoensperiodes.

Wat jou extra sterk maakt

  • Je hebt een oprechte interesse in merken, trends en nieuwe producten.
  • Je neemt initiatief en stapt gemakkelijk op klanten af om hen verder te helpen.
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en zorgt ervoor dat de winkel er steeds verzorgd en uitnodigend uitziet.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Wat wij bieden

Wij zijn een werkgever die gelijke kansen hoog in het vaandel draagt en zich inzet voor een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en ondersteund voelt. We geloven dat diversiteit onze organisatie sterker maakt en streven ernaar dat alle collega's, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of levenservaring, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en een betekenisvolle bijdrage kunnen leveren. Als onderdeel van een succesvolle en voortdurend evoluerende organisatie krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan onze strategische prioriteiten: mensen centraal stellen, voorop blijven lopen op het gebied van digitale innovatie, nauw aansluiten bij de behoeften van onze klanten en streven naar operationele excellentie. We staan open voor nieuwe ideeën en verwelkomen mensen die elke dag een positieve impact willen maken.

We waarderen de inzet en betrokkenheid van onze medewerkers en bieden daarom een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden en voordelen:

  • Staff korting op alle merken van de JD Group
  • 24 vakantiedagen op basis van full-time
  • Korting bij andere retailers in Nederland via de 'www.corporate-benefits.nl' app.
  • Nationale en internationale carrièremogelijkheden
  • Toegang to onze online leerplatform
  • Korting op zorgverzekering
  • Toegang tot 'Telus Health' wellnessplatform
  • Pensioenregeling

KLAAR OM DEEL UIT TE MAKEN VAN TEAM JD?

Wacht niet langer en solliciteer nu! We willen je graag leren kennen!

Opgericht in 1981 met één winkel in het noordwesten van Engeland, is JD Group uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevende wereldwijde omnichannel retailer in Sports Fashion- en Outdoor-merken. De groep telt momenteel 4.850 winkels (stand per 1 februari 2025) verspreid over 49 landen (inclusief franchises en joint ventures), met een sterke aanwezigheid in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Europa, Noord-Amerika en Azië-Pacific. JD Sports Nederland is te vinden op 33 locaties in het hele land, zoals Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Groningen en Venlo.

Een integriteitscheck via het waarschuwingsregister van de Fraud Approach Detailhandel Foundation maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hos itm8 søger vi en Senior Data Engineer, der brænder for at bygge robuste datafundamenter og omsætte komplekse behov til tekniske løsninger, der virker i praksis.

I vores Business Intelligence-team arbejder vi med nogle af Danmarks mest ambitiøse virksomheder og hjælper dem med at bygge dataplatforme, der skaber indsigt, automatisering og nye muligheder.

Du bliver en del af et Business Intelligence-team på 13 specialister, hvor faglig sparring og videndeling fylder meget i hverdagen. Her arbejder både erfarne arkitekter, specialister og nye talenter tæt sammen, og du får rig mulighed for at præge både løsninger, arbejdsmetoder og den faglige retning.

Din rolle

Som Senior Data Engineer får du en central rolle i udviklingen af moderne data- og analyseplatforme. Du arbejder tæt sammen med både kunder og kolleger og får stor indflydelse på, hvordan løsninger designes og implementeres.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Designe, udvikle og vedligeholde dataplatforme i Microsoft Azure og Microsoft Fabric.

  • Bygge og optimere data pipelines, integrationsløsninger og ELT-processer.

  • Arbejde med datamodellering, performanceoptimering og databearbejdning i SQL og Python.

  • Sparre med kunder om tekniske løsninger og omsætte forretningsbehov til skalerbar arkitektur.

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af vores framework, best practices og nye initiativer inden for AI.

Vi søger en teamm8 der

Har solid erfaring med data engineering og trives med at tage ansvar for tekniske løsninger fra analyse til implementering. Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar for dine løsninger og motiveres af at være den, andre går til for faglig sparring. Om du allerede har en etableret seniorprofil eller er klar til at tage næste skridt i den retning, er mindre vigtigt. Det afgørende er, at du har den faglige tyngde, nysgerrighed og selvstændighed, der skal til for at skabe værdi for både kunder og kolleger.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Platforme eller tilsvarende cloudbaserede datamiljøer.

  • Er stærk i SQL og har praktisk erfaring med Python.

  • Har arbejdet med CI/CD, DevOps-processer og moderne data engineering-principper.

  • Motiveres af både den tekniske fordybelse og dialogen med kunder og kolleger.

  • Kommunikerer flydende på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Det vigtigste er ikke din uddannelse, men din erfaring, nysgerrighed og evne til at omsætte teknologi til løsninger, der skaber værdi.

Det du får

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med moderne teknologier som Microsoft Fabric, Azure & AI

  • Stor indflydelse på både løsninger, faglig retning og udviklingen af teamets kompetencer.

  • Sparring med nogle af branchens stærkeste specialister inden for data og analytics.

  • Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og frihed under ansvar.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, videndeling og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for at deltagelse i nationale og internationale konferencer.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt Business Intelligence-miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden først, deler viden åbent og tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen.

Skal du med på holdet?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Manager - BI Data & Analytics, Mik Skovfoged Bødker Laursen på tlf. +45 2750 3767 eller på e-mail msbla@itm8.com

Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter desuden straffeattest forud for ansættelse.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Om itm8

Vi er itm8 – vores kunders IT-mate.

Bag os står 1.600+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Med specialister inden for alt fra IT-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

Men det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER – vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo. Og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Men om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig – hver dag.

Så spørg dig selv: Hvad kan du bygge i dag? Hvor kan det tage os i morgen?

Lyder det som dig? Så søg – og bliv vores næste team'm8'.
