title: IT Support Engineer
description:
Combell werft aan!

Als marktleider op vlak van hostingdiensten voor bedrijven is Combell uitgegroeid tot de meest betrouwbare one-stop partner voor de hosting van zowat elke IT-infrastructuur, website of applicatie. Wij bieden allerlei diensten aan die je van een kwaliteits-hoster mag verwachten: domeinnaamregistratie, hosting en server voor uw website of app, e-mail hosting, Microsoft Office 365, online tools zoals een Managed Sitebuilder,...

Voor ons uitgebreide interne Technical Support-team van 20 personen zijn we op zoek naar een nieuwe collega. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor de technische ondersteuning van alle shared Combell-producten. Op elke vraag probeert men een antwoord op maat van de klant te geven, zowel telefonisch als via chat en mail. Men specialiseert zich op verschillende vlakken en kan zo gericht advies geven.

We voorzien een uitgebreide en stapsgewijze on-the-job-opleidingsperiode om onze aanpak, producten en de kneepjes van het vak te leren kennen!

Als Support Engineer ...

  • Geef je ondersteuning met een persoonlijke touch.

  • Ben jij de rots in de branding van onze klanten. Ze kunnen bij jou terecht met al hun vragen en problemen - of toch mínstens die met betrekking tot onze producten en diensten 😉. Met je communicatieve superkracht informeer je klanten en schuif je problemen meteen van de baan. Jij put kracht uit tevreden klanten: klant blij, jij blij, iedereen blij!

  • Help je klanten in nood. Of ze nu technische vragen hebben over onze hosting, domeinnamen of mailboxen: jij snelt elke klant te hulp, via e-mail, livechat of telefoon. Je belangrijkste wapen: je kennis over onze producten (webhosting, domeinnamen, Exchange, Office 365, websitebuilder,...). Die leren we je snel genoeg aan en op termijn kan je je ook specialiseren!

  • Los je problemen op van A tot Z. Je neemt ownership over de binnenkomende problemen, denkt mee met de klant en lost het probleem op. Al kan je uiteraard escaleren indien nodig. Geen standaard 1st-, 2nd- en 3rd-lineprincipe!

  • Focus op correcte en vriendelijke omgang. Het kan gebeuren dat je in contact komt met minder tevreden klanten. Dan blijf je toch professioneel!

  • Beleef je elke dag anders. Elke klant heeft een eigen profiel, eigen wensen en eigen problemen – die jij zonder verpinken de wereld uithelpt (de problemen, niet de klant)!

Je bent ...

  • Leergierig. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Leergierigheid, een positieve ingesteldheid en proactiviteit primeren.

  • Technisch onderlegd. Je hoeft geen IT-specialist te zijn, maar je hebt wel een interesse in de wereld van webhosting.

  • Een fijn mens. Niet alleen je collega’s, maar ook je klanten houden een fijn gevoel over aan een gesprek met jou.

  • Flexibel. We zoeken geen slangenmens die zich in onmogelijke bochten kan wringen, maar wél iemand die niet vies is van shiftenwerk

  • Punctueel en nauwkeurig. Je hebt een onberispelijke spelling en je wordt een klein beetje kwaad omdat in deze zin een kern van een dt-fout staat.

  • As cool as a cucumber. Je kan het hoofd koel houden, ook wanneer het druk wordt.

  • In staat om te begrijpen wat ‘as cool as a cucumber’ betekent. We verwachten ook dat je feilloos Nederlands spreekt en schrijft, maar ook noties hebt van Frans en Engels. Geen nood als die laatste niet perfect zijn, je kan bij ons extra opleidingen volgen.

title: Omvårdnadspersonal till Vallentuna kommuns hemtjänst
description:
Har du mod att gå före och skapa ett Vallentuna där människor och idéer växer? Vill du ha ett arbete där du varje dag gör skillnad för människorna du möter? Är du duktig på att skapa relationer och trivs att ge stöd till de som behöver? Då ska du söka till vår hemtjänst. Just nu söker vi både medarbetare för tillsvidareanställningar, visstidsanställningar och timvikariat.

Vallentuna kommun har mod att gå före. Vår ambition är att ligga i framkant när det gäller innovativa lösningar, smarta arbetssätt och en effektiv organisation. Som medarbetare har du en viktig roll i utvecklingsarbetet. Kommunen som arbetsplats präglas av ett samförstånd mellan politik och verksamhet, där det gemensamma intresset och ansvaret för Vallentunas bästa lyser igenom. Bemötande, tillgänglighet och kundens fokus är viktigt i vårt arbete för goda resultat och ökad kvalitet.

Engagemang, samarbete och allas lika värde ska genomsyra vår organisation. Du som söker bör självklart dela våra gemensamma värderingar.

Om verksamheten

Socialförvaltningen består av cirka 600 medarbetare med uppdraget att arbeta förebyggande och stödjande inom så väl socialtjänst som vård och omsorg. Av dessa jobbar ca 160 inom Vallentuna kommuns hemtjänst.

Vi har behov av medarbetare till vår hemtjänst som jobbar med hjärtat för våra kunder. Tillsammans kan vi bara bli bättre. Vi satsar på en god arbetsmiljö och har regelbundna möten där vi arbetar med friskfaktorer och kompetensutveckling.

Hemtjänsten finns på Fabriksvägen 1C, 8 min gång från Roslagsbanan i Vallentuna Centrum eller buss (610 och 524, Fabriksvägen), som stannar precis utanför.

Lär dig mer om hur det är att arbeta på Vallentuna kommuns hemtjänst, möt våra engagerade medarbetare och se film: https://www.vallentuna.se/arbeta-inom-hemtjanst

Arbetsuppgifter

Att arbeta inom hemtjänsten innebär att ingen dag är den andra lik. Vår hemtjänst består av fyra grupper: Centralort, Tätort, Landsbygd samt Natt och larm. Du går, cyklar eller kör bil till kunderna beroende på avstånd. Arbetar man centralt i Vallentuna är körkort inte ett krav.

Som medarbetare i hemtjänsten ger du stöd till kunder i hens egna hem. Ett besök kan innehålla allt från att hjälpa kunden med måltider, dusch, påklädning eller promenad till att hjälpa kunden med tvätt, handla eller städa. För den som arbetar kväll och natt innebär besöken till hemtjänstkunderna ofta middagsleverans, hjälpa till sängs och tillsyn. Du dokumenterar löpande i systemet Treserva. Som tillsvidareanställd inom hemtjänsten kommer du också att vara fast omsorgskontakt för ett antal hemtjänstkunder samt skriva genomförandeplaner.

Alla våra anställda får introduktion i både praktiskt och teoretiskt arbete. Du gör din introduktion tillsammans med en ordinarie personal ute hos våra kunder och ni kommer även att gå igenom våra rutiner tillsammans. Du arbetar både självständigt så väl som i grupp. Arbetspassen är i skift dag och kväll mellan kl: 07.00 - 22.00. Våra nattpass är vanligtvis 21.30-07.00.

Om du tycker om att arbeta med människor och vill ha ett givande arbete är detta något för dig. Att arbeta i hemtjänsten är flexibelt och meningsfullt.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du har goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift.
  • Du är 18 år eller äldre.
  • Du har datavana så du kan dokumentera i socialjournal.

Meriterande:

  • Utbildad undersköterska.
  • Erfarenhet av vårdyrket.
  • Körkort.

Personliga egenskaper

  • Du arbetar mot resultat, visar pålitlighet och tar ansvar för planering och uppföljning av ditt arbete.
  • Du stärker relationer genom att du hjälper andra, samarbetar, följer regler och processer och delar information.
  • Du utvecklar, förbättrar, söker lösningar, lärande och kunskap på eget initiativ.
  • Du är länken, ger service, visar lojalitet utåt och inåt och omvärldsbevakar.
  • Gemensamma värderingar syns i ditt bemötande.
  • Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till olika situationer och människor.
  • Du är lyhörd, ansvarstagande och intresserad av människor.

Information

Som arbetsgivare vill vi tillvarata de kvaliteter som en jämn könsfördelning och kulturell mångfald tillför. Vallentuna kommun satsar på kompetensutveckling och ett hållbart arbetsliv. För att ha så goda förutsättningar som möjligt i din medarbetarroll har Vallentuna kommun en medarbetarakademi där du kommer att få utbildning och verktyg.

Just nu söker vi både dig som är intresserade av tillsvidareanställning på mellan 60-80%, längre vikariat (visstidsanställning) eller timvikariat, med start enligt överenskommelse. Som timvikarie har du en behovsanställning där du får ersättning per arbetad timme. I våra urvalsfrågor anger du vad du främst är intresserad av för typ av anställning.

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Personer som anställs för att arbeta med äldre och vuxna personer med funktionsvariation i hemmet ska visa upp ett utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret. https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/

Inför all nyanställning utför Vallentuna kommun bakgrundskontroll.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen använder vi verktyget ReachMee. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan genom att klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen. Du kommer att få svar på din ansökan via mejl, kolla gärna skräpposten om du inte fått svar inom några veckor. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar/intresseanmälningar via e-post. Har du några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta oss enligt nedan.

Du är varmt välkommen att skicka din ansökan med ett personligt brev och CV senast 1 november.

För mer information kontakta

Malin Wiklund, malin.wiklund@vallentuna.se, 08-5878 59 50

Mer information och fackliga representanter hittar du på vallentuna.se:

https://www.vallentuna.se/naringsliv-och-arbete/arbeta-hos-oss/lokala-fackliga-foretradare/

title: Senior Engineer - Data & AI Platform
description:
Job Description

Helia is Australia’s first Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI) provider, with more than 60 years of expertise in the Australian housing market. We exist to accelerate financial wellbeing through home ownership.


Our mission is to deliver innovative, tailored solutions in partnership with our customers, making the home ownership journey simpler and more accessible. We do this through efficient, customer-focused services powered by leading technology, data and digital solutions.

As a Senior Engineer – Data & AI Platform, you’ll help design and build an AI-native data platform within Snowflake, enabling AI workloads and intelligent applications across the organisation.

Working at the intersection of data and AI engineering, you’ll build scalable data pipelines, AI-enriched datasets and reusable data products, while helping shape a modern, AI-ready data architecture and supporting the organisation to get greater value from AI.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines and AI applications using Snowflake-native AI capabilities.
  • Enable in-database AI, LLM, vector and semantic workflows, reducing reliance on external processing.
  • Design and optimise data models and structures that support both analytical and AI workloads.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our AI-ready data architecture and enterprise data modelling approaches, including Data Vault and common data models.
  • Prepare and structure governed, high-quality data for AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
  • Partner with AI engineers and technology teams to integrate Snowflake-hosted intelligence into applications and workflows.
  • Implement AI observability, monitoring and alerting to support reliable AI and data solutions.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled engineering practices and standards, using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cortex Code.
  • Work with technical and business stakeholders to translate complex concepts into practical solutions and help build broader data and AI capability across the organisation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience with Snowflake, SQL, dbt and Python, ideally including Snowpark.
  • Experience with Snowflake AI capabilities and building AI-enabled workflows within a data platform.
  • Exposure to LLM, vector, embedding or semantic use cases.
  • Experience designing scalable data models and architectures, with knowledge of approaches such as Data Vault, common data models or dimensional modelling.
  • Understanding of machine learning data requirements, feature engineering and/or production AI/ML workflows.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in evolving AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical data and AI solutions.

At Helia, we’re building a team focused on creating opportunities and brighter futures for our people. When you join Helia, you become part of an organisation that genuinely cares about what matters to you — whether that’s work-life balance, flexible ways of working, wellbeing, or professional growth. We offer a range of benefits and support designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.


Helia is a place where you can grow, learn and make a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative and inclusive culture where innovation, continuous learning and cross-functional teamwork are encouraged to deliver great customer outcomes. Located in the heart of North Sydney, our office offers a vibrant workplace experience with some of Sydney’s best views.

If you are interested in joining a company where you can realise your full potential and grow, we would love to hear from you!


We have a diverse business community: our people, our customers and communities are reflective of this and as an organisation we are committed to continually hiring a diverse workforce. We ensure our people always feel supported and we do this by our openness to flexible work options and our commitment to inclusion, regardless of career level, life-stage, or experience.

title: UX Director
description:
LEGO Digital Play will bring the LEGO brand into digital entertainment in new, innovative, and wholly-owned ways. Our mission is to ensure the LEGO Brand remains as powerfully a part of children’s lives in the coming decades as it has ever been. We aim to reach every kid on the planet, their parents, and adult fans of LEGO—and provide them with meaningful, magical, and playful new experiences.

We are at the earliest phases of this new company, offering a unique opportunity to build a new entity for the world's most beloved and trusted brand. Our culture is open, collaborative, intellectually rigorous, and creatively vibrant.

Role Summary

We're looking for a UX Director to own the user experience for a new LEGO digital product, shaping that experience from the ground up: setting the UX vision, and building a team to deliver it.

Together with design, product, tech and art leads, you'll align your direction with the wider creative and technical vision and establish the workflows and standards that keep quality high as the product grows.

This is a role where a philosophy of clarity and accessibility matters as much as visual craft. The right person brings deep experience in mobile UX, an informed perspective, and the ability to translate audience needs into intuitive design.

Key Responsibilities

  • Owns the UX vision for a cross-platform product, designing for a broad and diverse audience.

  • Sets the UX quality standard and upholds it rigorously, prioritising clarity and accessibility.

  • Embeds trust and safety into the experience by design.

  • Establishes the pipelines, processes, design systems, and standards that keep UX quality consistent as the product scales.

  • Builds and leads the UX team, placing the right people in the right roles, empowering them to grow and own their work, and creating a culture of craft, trust, and accountability.

  • Works closely with design and art leads to align UX direction with the wider creative and technical vision.

  • Champions a flexible approach to UX, iterating continuously and validating decisions through usability testing and user feedback.

  • Presents UX direction and progress to stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial experience at UX Director level, with a track record of high-profile launched products across multiple platforms.

  • Proven ability to define and own a user experience for a live service product end-to-end, across multiple releases.

  • Expertise in UX for interactive products on PC and mobile, including interaction design, visual and UI craft, accessibility, information architecture, and usability heuristics.

  • Experience designing for a range of audiences, including younger or family audiences, with fluency in trust, safety, and age-appropriate design.

  • Experience adhering to design and brand guidelines at a large consumer brand or entertainment company.

  • Demonstrated success building and leading UX teams: hiring, developing talent, and setting the bar for craft.

  • Experience partnering with research functions to inform design decisions with user insight.

  • Deep understanding of design pipelines, production workflows, and how to build them from scratch.

  • Strong diplomatic and communication skills, with an ability to align stakeholders with varied priorities.

  • Experience integrating UX into agile, iterative development processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with licensed IP or external brand partners.

  • Experience with UX / UI for UGC platforms.

  • Proficiency with UX / UI design tools (e.g. Figma).

  • Experience with data-informed design using analytics and behavioural insights.

description:
Rakennussiivoojia Kainuun alueelle
Etsimme reippaita ja luotettavia rakennussiivoojia Kainuun alueelle. Rakennussiivoojana huolehdit työskentelyalueiden siisteydestä, järjestyksestä ja turvallisuudesta. Työ on käytännönläheistä, fyysistä ja liikkuvaa, joten tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka pidät aktiivisesta työstä ja siitä, että oman työn jäljen näkee konkreettisesti. Etsimme tekijöitä, jotka tarttuvat työhön oma-aloitteisesti ja hoitavat annetut tehtävät huolellisesti loppuun asti.
Työtehtävät:
Rakennussiivoojana työtehtäviisi kuuluu monipuolisesti työskentelyalueiden siisteydestä ja järjestyksestä huolehtiminen. Työpäiväsi voivat sisältää esimerkiksi pölyn ja lian poistamista, imurointia, pintojen puhdistamista sekä jätteiden keräämistä ja lajittelua. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös yleisen siisteyden ylläpitäminen ja muut rakennussiivoukseen liittyvät tehtävät. Työtehtävät voivat vaihdella työn etenemisen mukaan, joten työpäivät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia.
Odotamme:
Odotamme sinulta reipasta, luotettavaa ja oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä huolellisuutta tehtävien suorittamisessa. Tehtävässä edellytetään voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia. Toivomme, että pystyt työskentelemään sujuvasti niin itsenäisesti kuin osana työporukkaakin ja noudatat tarkasti annettuja työ- ja turvallisuusohjeita. Työ on fyysistä ja liikkuvaa, joten hyvä peruskunto auttaa tehtävässä pärjäämisessä. Aikaisempi kokemus rakennussiivoojan työstä katsotaan eduksi.
Tarjoamme:
Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen työn Kajaanissa sekä mahdollisuuden kartuttaa osaamistasi ja kokemustasi rakennussiivouksen parissa. Saat tehtävään asianmukaisen perehdytyksen ja tarvittavan tuen työn tekemiseen. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja tehtävässä on mahdollisuus aloittaa nopeallakin aikataululla.
Palkkaus:
Palkka tehtävässä määräytyy kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti. Palkassa huomioidaan tehtävän vaativuus sekä työntekijän aikaisempi työkokemus ja osaaminen.

title: Product Lead
description:
Product Lead – B2B SaaS / AI

About Zylu

Zylu is building an AI-powered growth and management platform for salons and beauty businesses. We help salons grow revenue, automate customer engagement, simplify bookings, and manage their business from one platform. Growing across India and international markets, including North America, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Southeast Asia.

We are a lean, fast-moving, product-driven SaaS company. We are looking for a hands-on Product Lead who can own product outcomes from discovery through adoption. This is not a project management or backlog management role.

You will have meaningful ownership of what we build, why we build it, and whether it creates measurable value.

What You'll Own

Product Discovery & Customer Understanding

  • Regularly engage with customers, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.

  • Understand the problem behind customer feature requests.

  • Identify opportunities using customer feedback, product usage data, market insights, and business priorities.

  • Develop a deep understanding of salon workflows and customer pain points.

  • Turn customer problems into scalable product solutions.

Product Strategy & Prioritisation

  • Own and prioritise the product roadmap.

  • Balance customer needs, business goals, product data, market opportunities, and technical constraints.

  • Decide what should be built now, next, later, or not at all.

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer requests, growth opportunities, product improvements, and technical investments.

  • Work directly with the founding team to translate business strategy into product priorities.

Product Execution

  • Turn product problems into clear requirements, user flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design from discovery through release.

  • Resolve product ambiguity quickly.

  • Help Engineering make informed product trade-offs.

  • Validate features before release.

  • Partner with Engineering and QA to ensure product quality.

Product Growth & Adoption

  • Own outcomes across:

    • Activation

    • Adoption

    • Engagement

    • Retention

    • Conversion

    • Expansion

  • Identify and remove friction from onboarding and key customer journeys.

  • Run experiments to improve customer and business outcomes.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to increase adoption.

  • Treat a feature as successful only when customers discover it, use it, and receive value from it.

Product Analytics

  • Define success metrics before major product initiatives begin.

  • Monitor feature usage and adoption after launch.

  • Analyse customer behaviour and feedback.

  • Identify friction, drop-offs, and opportunities.

  • Use quantitative and qualitative data for prioritisation.

  • Decide whether features should be:

    • Improved

    • Promoted

    • Simplified

    • Repositioned

    • Retired

AI Product Development

  • Help shape Zylu's AI-first product experience.

  • Build experiences around:

    • AI automation

    • Conversational AI

    • AI agents

    • Intelligent recommendations

    • AI-powered workflows

  • Identify workflows where AI creates meaningful customer value.

  • Avoid adding AI simply for the sake of having AI.

  • Work with Engineering to make AI experiences simple, useful, reliable, and measurable.

  • Stay current with relevant AI product developments.


Product Launches

  • Own product launches with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

  • Define the customer problem, value proposition, and expected outcome.

  • Ensure internal teams understand new capabilities.

  • Coordinate:

    • Release communication

    • Product documentation

    • Internal enablement

    • Adoption initiatives

  • Measure launch performance and iterate based on results.

What We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of relevant product experience.

  • Significant hands-on Product Management experience in SaaS or technology.

  • Experience owning products or major product areas end-to-end.

  • Strong experience across:

    • Discovery

    • Prioritisation

    • Requirements

    • Execution

    • Launch

    • Adoption

    • Measurement

    • Iteration

  • Demonstrated ownership of measurable outcomes such as:

    • Activation

    • Adoption

    • Engagement

    • Retention

    • Conversion

    • Expansion

    • Revenue

  • Strong customer discovery and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making ability.

  • Good commercial understanding.

  • Ability to connect product decisions with customer value and business outcomes.

  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering and understanding technical trade-offs.

  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

title: Head of Manufacturing Analytics
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at .
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do

CoreWeave’s Hardware Quality organization is responsible for product enablement, factory operations, hardware reliability, and global manufacturing excellence across our supply base and fleet. We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own and lead the strategy and technical architecture connecting supplier data, manufacturing analytics, and product reliability into a single, coherent system of insight.

About the Role

This is a hands-on strategic role. You will define how supplier and factory data flows into decision-making, build the analytical backbone for manufacturing quality and reliability, and shape how reliability modeling informs product lifecycle strategy from NPI through EOL. You will operate at the intersection of hardware engineering, data architecture, and supply chain, translating fragmented supplier and factory signals into a unified quality and reliability narrative used by engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders.

In this role, you will:

Manufacturing Analytics

  • Define and drive the strategy for capturing, standardizing, and integrating quality and process data from OxMs and component suppliers.
  • Establish data contracts, quality gates, and integration patterns with suppliers to ensure timely, trustworthy, and actionable data flows.
  • Architect an end-to-end analytics strategy spanning supplier, factory-floor, and field data, moving Hardware Quality from siloed reporting to a unified quality and reliability data platform.
  • Enable the operating framework and modeling that connects supplier, manufacturer, and fleet insights into a unified, collaborative solution.
  • Create scalable solutions and set technical direction in partnership with Supply Chain Transformation and Data Enablement teams.

Reliability Modeling

  • Own the technical approach to reliability modeling across hardware components and systems, including failure-rate prediction, MTBF/MTTF analysis, Weibull analysis, and other lifetime distributions.
  • Translate field and factory failure data into predictive reliability models that inform design margin, burn-in strategy, and warranty and spares planning.
  • Define how quality, reliability, and supplier data inform decisions at each stage of the product lifecycle, from NPI readiness criteria through sustaining engineering, end-of-life, and cold-spares planning.
  • Partner with PLM, engineering, and program management to embed data-driven gates and reliability checkpoints into lifecycle-stage transitions.

Leadership & Influence

  • Serve as a senior technical voice for Hardware Quality, setting direction that other engineers and analysts execute against.
  • Communicate complex technical strategy clearly to executive stakeholders, framing quality and reliability work in terms of business impact, including revenue protection, customer satisfaction, and cost avoidance.
  • Mentor senior- and staff-level engineers and raise the technical bar for data and reliability work across the organization.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in hardware quality, reliability engineering, manufacturing analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated Principal- or Staff-level scope.
  • Deep expertise in reliability modeling and statistical methods, including Weibull analysis, MTBF/MTTF, accelerated life testing, and DPPM and yield analysis.
  • A track record of building or architecting manufacturing and quality analytics platforms, not just using existing BI tools.
  • Experience working directly with OxMs and component suppliers on data integration and quality data contracts.
  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management concepts, including NPI, ECR/ECO, sustaining, and EOL, and how data should inform lifecycle gates.
  • Comfort operating without a fully built system; you can define the strategy, data model, and roadmap and influence others to build it.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive-level narrative.

Preferred

  • Experience in high-density compute, GPU, or data center hardware environments.
  • Familiarity with PLM platforms.
  • Background in statistical software and tooling, including Minitab, JMP, or Python/R for reliability analysis.
  • Experience with cold-spares planning or hub-and-spoke supply chain models.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You’re curious about how data, hardware engineering, manufacturing, and reliability come together to improve products at scale.

Come join us!

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

title: SDE II, Ship With Amazon, Ship With Amazon
description:
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.

We have built a highly respected software engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.

You will be working with senior SDEs and principals to solve problems of scale, improve existing services & build new ones, and work on deep and complex algorithms to improve the experience of our customers globally while optimizing network operations.

In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the safety and regulatory compliance of our crop protection products in the European market. You will manage human toxicology technical project inputs into multidisciplinary EU teams, interpret complex scientific data, and provide expert guidance on regulatory requirements for active substances, metabolites, and product registration processes.

  • Lead toxicology project data management and strategy development for EU project teams

  • Provide technical training and contribute to best practices within the EU toxicology team
  • Participate in industry task forces and working groups as required
  • BSc, MSc/Ph.D. or equivalent in Toxicology or closely related field ideally with a minimum of 3 years of experience in regulatory toxicology, preferably in the agrochemical industry
  • Extensive knowledge of EU regulatory frameworks for plant protection products
  • Proven track record in managing complex toxicology projects and regulatory submissions
  • Strong scientific writing and data interpretation skills
  • Experience in risk assessment and safety evaluation of chemical substances
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders

  • Demonstrated abilities in strategic thinking and problem solving
  • Familiarity with current trends and emerging issues in toxicology and risk assessment
  • Active participation in professional societies and industry working groups is preferred
  • Ability to utilise and deploy digital skills would be an advantage

Jealott's Hill International Research Centre UK is situated in pleasant semi-rural surroundings between Bracknell and Maidenhead and is the place of work for approximately 800 Syngenta scientists and support staff. Jealott’s Hill is one of the main global research and development sites and key activities include research into discovery of new active ingredients, new formulation technologies, product safety and technical support of our product range.

title: Workplace Planning Lead
description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

Our offices need to keep pace with the speed at which we grow. As Workplace Planning Lead, you will shape how our global office footprint evolves, translating headcount plans into seating, space and capacity models across Munich, Berlin and our wider network of sites. You will guide decisions on expansions, relocations and consolidations, partnering with Workplace Managers, Real Estate colleagues and senior stakeholders so that teams always have the space they need to deliver. This is the first global planning layer within our Workplace team, so you will also define the standards, data and ways of working that the function will scale with over the coming years.

The day-to-day

  • Build seat, space and capacity planning models that keep every office aligned with headcount growth, and deliver space changes at pace across existing locations

  • Forecast workplace demand across all sites, setting the workplace standards, seating strategies and design principles that teams plan against

  • Shape real estate decisions on lease renewals, expansions and consolidations, supplying the occupancy data and capacity insights that inform negotiations and location strategy

  • Plan and deliver new office openings, relocations, fit-outs and closures together with Workplace Managers, so that transitions happen with minimal disruption to teams

  • Create occupancy dashboards and planning models that give leadership a clear view of utilisation, and surface opportunities to use space more efficiently

You should apply if you

  • Have planned workplace capacity, workplace strategy, corporate real estate or facilities across a growing organisation

  • Have delivered office expansions, relocations or workplace transformations from planning through to occupation

  • Translate business growth and headcount forecasts into practical space requirements, using data and simple models to support decisions

  • Work effectively across multiple locations and with stakeholders at every level, communicating clearly in German and English

  • Make well-evidenced decisions quickly, and adjust plans as priorities shift

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Have applied LLMs or AI-enabled workflows to corporate real estate, planning or operational tasks

  • Have a background in interior architecture or space planning tools such as AutoCAD, gained in a high-growth or technology environment

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regularly company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to serve as the dedicated owner of cloud security remediation and hardening across our environment.

Our organization already has an established security team that identifies risks and issues recommendations. This role does not sit on that team. Instead, you are the engineer who turns those recommendations into durable, well-architected fixes—and, just as importantly, makes sure the same findings don’t come back.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an advisory one. Success means a measurably more secure environment, a shrinking backlog of recurring findings, and security controls that are enforced by design rather than by manual effort or one-off patches.

What You’ll Do

Remediation & recurrence prevention (the core of this role)

• Own the full lifecycle of security findings and recommendations—whether they come from the security team, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or other tooling—through triage, remediation, verification, and closure.

• Root-cause recurring issues and implement systemic fixes (policy-as-code, automated guardrails, secure baselines) so the same findings don’t reappear quarter after quarter.

• Track remediation SLAs and report on risk reduction and posture trends over time.

Identity & authentication

• Secure and govern modern authentication flows across the estate: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, JWT validation and handling, and mTLS.

• Administer and harden Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Entra): app registrations and Enterprise Application permissions, consent governance, service principals and managed identities, credential and secret hygiene, and least-privilege scoping.

• Design, implement, and continuously tune Conditional Access policies.

Cloud security engineering & governance

• Build and enforce guardrails using Azure Policy and Terraform; maintain secure-by-default infrastructure-as-code baselines and detect/remediate configuration drift.

• Operate Microsoft Defender for Cloud—drive secure-score improvement, remediate recommendations, and manage cloud security posture (CSPM).

• Contribute to security governance: standards, control definitions, exception handling, and audit evidence.

Admin portal & privileged access security

• Secure all cloud and SaaS administrative portals—Azure and other admin consoles (e.g., Microsoft 365 admin, identity providers, and any additional cloud platforms in use).

• Strengthen privileged access: MFA enforcement, Privileged Identity Management (PIM) / just-in-time elevation, role minimization, and break-glass procedures.

AI security

• Apply security controls to AI workloads, services, and AI agents: agent and workload identities, tool and permission scoping, data-exposure and prompt-injection risk, and emerging AI security best practices.

What You Bring (Required)

• 5+ years in cloud security or security engineering, with deep, hands-on Azure experience.

• Strong, hands-on Microsoft Entra ID expertise: app registrations, Enterprise Apps, permissions and consent, and Conditional Access.

• Solid working knowledge of modern authentication: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 / PKCE, JWT, and mTLS.

• Proficiency with Terraform and Azure Policy for policy-as-code and automated guardrails.

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and cloud security posture management.

• A demonstrable track record of root-causing and permanently closing security findings—not just patching them.

• Working understanding of AI, AI agents, and AI security considerations.

Nice to Have

• Multi-cloud exposure (AWS, GCP).

• Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-100, AZ-500, SC-300; CISSP).

• Experience with CI/CD pipeline security, secrets management, and SIEM/SOAR.

• Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python).

• Hands-on experience securing LLM-based or agentic systems in production."

title: Redaktör till Svensk Byggtjänst
description:
Är du en nyhetsdriven journalist med stark nyhetsnäsa och känsla för det svenska språket? Gillar du att bevaka samhällsfrågor, hitta relevanta nyheter och göra komplexa frågor begripliga? Då kan detta konsultuppdrag som redaktör på Svensk Byggtjänst vara något för dig!

Svensk Byggtjänst är en etablerad aktör inom samhällsbyggnadssektorn och söker nu en redaktör till sin nyhetstjänst Byggkoll. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med journalistik som hjälper yrkesverksamma att hålla sig uppdaterade om vad som händer i deras bransch – med fokus på relevanta nyheter, politik, lagar, regler och samhällsbyggnadsfrågor.

Om rollen

Som redaktör blir du en del av Svensk Byggtjänsts oberoende redaktion med sex redaktörer. Du arbetar nära erfarna kollegor i en miljö där journalistiskt hantverk, läsarnas behov och hög kvalitet står i centrum. I rollen ansvarar du för att bevaka relevanta källor, identifiera nyheter och hålla läsarna uppdaterade. Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med redaktionen där ditt fokus blir anläggning och infrastruktur.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

  • Ansvara för löpande omvärldsbevakning och bevaka ett antal relevanta källor
  • Identifiera, värdera och prioritera nyheter utifrån läsarnas behov
  • Skriva artiklar och notiser samt genomföra intervjuer och bildsätta artiklar, inklusive enklare redigering i Photoshop
  • Förbereda och färdigställa nyhetsbrev
  • Utifrån läsardata välja ut innehåll till nyhetsbreven
  • Publicera artiklar och innehåll på webben

Rollen passar dig som tycker om kombinationen av att vara på tårna efter nästa nyhet och samtidigt arbeta noggrant med språk och innehåll. Du kommer att få möjlighet att bidra med egna erfarenheter och perspektiv i en etablerad redaktion, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett team där man hjälper och stöttar varandra. Du rapporterar till chefredaktören som även är ansvarig utgivare för Byggkoll.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är journalist i grunden och som har en stark känsla för vad som gör en nyhet relevant och intressant. Du har journalistutbildning på högskolenivå eller motsvarande och erfarenhet av journalistiskt arbete, helst från nyhetsmedia, exempelvis dagstidning eller inom B2B. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och är trygg i att skriva och bearbeta texter på ett korrekt, tydligt och engagerande sätt.

Du har vana av webbpublicering och nyhetsbrev och trivs med att arbeta snabbt och effektivt utan att tumma på kvaliteten. Intresse för samhällsbyggnadsområdet är meriterande. Har du arbetat i EPI, HubSpot eller Adobe-programmen, framför allt Photoshop, är det ett plus.

Som person är du noggrann och ansvarstagande. Du är effektiv och kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya ämnen. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och mån om att bidra till ett gott samarbete. Du är stolt över ditt arbete och vill leverera journalistik av hög kvalitet.

Om Svensk Byggtjänst

Svensk Byggtjänst bildades 1934 och ägs av landets centrala organisationer inom samhällsbyggnadssektorn. I dag är vi drygt 100 kollegor som strävar mot ett helt hållbart samhällsbyggande. Det gör vi genom att vara ett neutralt nav för kunskap och samverkan. Ett arbete som utgår från vår gemensamma värdegrund: att med tydlighet och välvilja ta framtidsansvar. Svensk Byggtjänst omsätter drygt 220 MSEK och har cirka 100 anställda.

Vill du veta mer?

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag som ersätter en föräldraledighet och uppdraget sträcker sig över cirka sex månader. Du blir anställd som konsult hos OnePartnerGroup och kommer att arbeta i en hybrid arbetsmodell hos Svensk Byggtjänst.

Tillträde sker omgående, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Vi går igenom kandidater löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum.

Med hänsyn till GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via mejl. Har du frågor om tjänsten eller vill veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta Josefine Blomkvist på josefine.blomkvist@onepartnergroup.se (mailto:josefine.blomkvist@onepartnergroup.se) eller Christina Stenbeck på christina.stenbeck@onepartnergroup.se (mailto:christina.stenbeck@onepartnergroup.se).

När du blir en av oss

Som konsult på OnePartnerGroup omfattas du av kollektivavtal med bland annat försäkringar, tjänstepension och fackliga relationer. Du har också regelbunden kontakt med din konsultchef. Hos oss får du möjlighet att testa nya utmaningar och utvecklas under trygga förhållanden.

På OnePartnerGroup arbetar vi med rekrytering och bemanning med en tydlig drivkraft – att se dig lyckas och nå dina mål på både kort och lång sikt. Med lokal förankring på ett 50-tal orter, från Malmö i söder till Kalix i norr, finns vi nära dig.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Butikssäljare 50%, vikariat, Stadium Outlet Skövde
description:
Vill du jobba i ett team med engagerade kollegor, fyllt med energi? Ser du dig själv som driven, serviceinriktad och flexibel? Toppen, då kanske du är vår nästa stjärnspelare! Vi söker en butikssäljare till vårt lag.

Stadium Outlet vill göra sport och sportmode tillgängligt för alla. För att lyckas med vårt uppdrag måste alla våra medarbetare har roligt på jobbet och drivas av samma sak som oss: att aktivera världen – vad är din drivkraft?

Vad innebär det att vara butikssäljare?Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna hos oss, de ska bli inbjudna till en kundupplevelse i hela butiken. En upplevelse som kännetecknas av service i världsklass. Som butikssäljare skapar du förutsättningar för våra kunder att hitta de produkter de söker. Detta innebära att du fyller på varor och ser till att butiken är inspirerande och attraktiv, välfylld med våra produkter. Du ser till att ge våra kunder bästa möjliga personliga service genom att hjälpa dem vid behov och ta emot dem i kassan.

Vem är du?Vi tror att du delar vår inställning och övertygelse när det gäller att se varje utmaning som en möjlighet. Du trivs med att ha mycket ansvar och vill växa och utvecklas i rollen som butikssäljare. För att jobba på Stadium måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Butikserfarenhet är ett plus.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?Läs mer om vårt lag på vår Karriärsida, på Instagram WorkatStadium eller på Linkedin.

Klicka på länken här för att komma till våra poddavsnitt och på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium.

Varaktighet/arbetstid Tjänsten är på 50% och avser perioden från 2 november 2026 till 6 juni 2027.

Ansökan Som en del i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du att få en inbjudan till din e-mail till att besvara ett personlighetstest. Det tar ca 15 minuter att besvara testet. Vi kommunicerar mestadels genom mail så se till att hålla koll på din inkorg, håll även koll på skräpposten för säkerhets skull.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Come join the movement!

Tycker du också att livet är roligare när det rör på sig?

Hos oss på Stadium jobbar lagspelare som brinner för försäljning, sport och sportmode. Energi, mod och laganda är några av de grundstenar som gjort att det lilla familjeföretaget från Norrköping blivit en av Nordens största sportkedjor. Men vi stannar inte där. Genom innovation och enkelhet fortsätter vi att utvecklas med nya koncept, fler produkter och varumärken på marknaden. Tävlingsandan och passionen genomsyrar allt vi gör och vår mission är att inspirera och ge fler människor möjlighet till ett aktivt liv.

Join the movement.

title: Ohjaaja (AMK), Aurinkolahden ryhmäkoti
description:
Hei Sosiaalihuollon ammattilainen, oletko kiinnostunut vaativista kehitysvammapalveluista ja niissä tehtävästä moniammatillisen tiimityön jalkauttamisesta? Avaamme uudelleen peruuntumisen vuoksi ohjaaja- amk haun Aurinkolahden ryhmäkotiin.

Aurinkolahden ryhmäkoti tuottaa vaativaa ympärivuorokautista palvelua yli 18-vuotiaille erityistarpeisille henkilöille. Asiakkaiden erityistarpeissa korostuvat kehitysvammaisuuden, psykososiaalisen tuen ja autismikirjon tarpeiden ymmärtäminen. Aurinkolahden ryhmäkodin asiakkailla voi olla kehitysvamman tai muun tuen tarpeen lisäksi neuropsykiatrisia, mielenterveyteen tai autismikirjoon liittyviä ongelmia tai haastavaa käyttäytymistä. Ryhmäkodissa tuotetaan pitkäaikaisen asumisen palveluja sekä jaksotyyppistä vaativaa moniammatillista tukea helsinkiläisille asiakkaille. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä vaativan moniammatillisentuen yksikkö Siltamäen kanssa, tarvittaessa henkilöstömme liikkuu yksiköiden välillä.

Ohjaajana olet tiiviisti mukana asiakkaan arjessa, vastaat asiakkaiden yksilöllisen kuntoutuksen toteuttamisesta ja elämänhallinnan taitojen kehittymisestä sekä tuet muuta työyhteisöä erilaisten toimintamallien käyttöönotossa sekä osallistut asiakkaan ohjaus- ja arviointityöhön. Varmistat ja valmennat muuta työyhteisöä laadukkaassa dokumentoinnissa sekä kannat kokonaisvastuun dokumenttien ajantasaisuudesta.

Lisäksi vastaat vaativan moniammatillisen tuen jaksojen asiakaskohtaisesta prosessista yhdessä kahden muun amk-ohjaajan kanssa. Työ sisältää runsaasti verkosto- ja omaisyhteistyötä. Työvuorot painottuvat aamu- ja iltavuoroihin, sisältäen myös viikonloppuja.

Aurinkolahden moniammatilliseen työyhteisöön kuuluu amk-ohjaajien lisäksi lähihoitajia, sairaanhoitajia, johtava ohjaaja ja palveluyksikön päällikkö. Lisäksi kehitysvammapoliklinikan asiantuntijoiden; kuten lääkärin, psykologin ja toimintaterapeutin sekä asiakkaan sosiaalityöntekijän palvelut ovat käytettävissä.

Toivomme sinulta:
Työssä menestymiseen auttaa arvioiva ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote, paineensietokyky, kokonaisuuksien hallinta ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot. Arvostamme puhetta tukevien- ja korvaavien menetelmien käytön osaamista ja kehitysvammapsykiatrian tuntemusta. Asenteeltaan positiivinen lähestyminen arjen ongelmatilanteisiin auttaa työtehtävässä onnistumiseen ja työssä jaksamiseen.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn lisäksi laajat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea vuokra-asuntoa Auroranlinnalta, jonka asunnot ovat markkinatasoa edullisempia ja työntekijöidemme asuntohakemukset etusijalla. Meillä maksetaan hyvästä työsuorituksesta kertapalkkioita, jotka ovat suuruudeltaan 100-500€.

Koska elämä ei ole pelkkää työtä, meillä huolehditaan myös työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainosta. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden sisältäen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Etua voi saada korkeintaan 550 euroa kalenterivuodelta. Käytettävissä oleva saldo määräytyy työsuhteesi pituuden perusteella. Lisäksi käytettävissäsi on lounasetu. Saat käyttöösi henkilöstöetuna myös kaupunkipyörän ja voit halutessasi vierailla kaupungin työntekijöiden omalla virkistyssaarella.

Kelpoisuusehto:

Sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilölain 817/2015 (8§) mukainen sosiaalialalle soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (esim. sosionomi, geronomi tai kuntoutuksen ohjaaja) tai terveydenhuollon ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (esim. sairaanhoitaja) tai aikaisempi sosiaali- ja terveysalan opistoasteinen tutkinto.

Tehtävään on kelpoinen myös henkilö, joka on ennen 1.8.2005 suorittanut tehtävään soveltuvan sosiaali- ja terveysalan amk- tutkintoa edeltäneen amk-tutkinnon, opistoasteisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuoltoalan ammatillisen tutkinnon esim. sosiaalikasvattaja, sosiaaliohjaaja, kehitysvammaisten ohjaaja, sosiaalialan ohjaaja, sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja jne.

Tehtävässä edellytetään rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (ent. Valvira) ammattihenkilörekisteriin.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja tyydyttävä ruotsin kielen suullinen taito.

Lisäksi edellytämme:

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsuhteen alkamista esitettävä työnantajalle huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

Ennen valintapäätöstä hakijan on esitettävä työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa työhön kuuluvia tehtäviä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Tehtävässä edellytetään vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

LoveLop tai Love minilop lääkelupien hyväksyttyä suorittamista koeajan aikana.

Henkilökohtaista soveltuvuutta tehtävään.

Luemme eduksi:

Erityisen vaativan vammaispalvelujen kokemuksen esim. kehitysvammapsykiatria tai vammaisten ympärivuorokautinen asuminen, verkosto- ja omaisyhteistyön kokemuksen, sosiaalihuollon Apotti osaamisen sekä osaamisen palvelujen toteuttamisen dokumentoinnista.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta työyhteisöissämme. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolia olevia, vammaisia sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- ja muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Pyrimme varmistamaan esteettömän ja saavutettavan rekrytointiprosessin kaikille hakijoille. Jos tarvitset hakuprosessin aikana mukautuksia tai sinulla on esteettömyyteen liittyviä toiveita, voit olla yhteydessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen sotepe.monimuotoinen.rekrytointi@hel.fi. Viestit käsitellään erillään rekrytoivasta yksiköstä, eikä yhteydenottoja välitetä rekrytoivalle esihenkilölle ilman hakijan suostumusta.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer ( Labs)
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role:

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer III (Full Stack) to join our Labs team. Labs is the platform that powers how HighLevel ships new features to production — controlling staged rollouts, feature flags, and experimentation across the platform, and closing the loop with in-product customer feedback.

Today, every new capability shipped across HighLevel's platform passes through Labs' feature-flag and rollout infrastructure, spanning 100K+ agencies and the 2M+ businesses they serve. The systems we build directly shape how safely and quickly the rest of the engineering org can ship — enabling gradual rollouts, targeted enablement at the company and location level, and fast, safe rollback when something goes wrong.

The team builds and scales core capabilities across feature flag management, staged feature rollout, and customer feedback collection. These systems let product and engineering teams control exactly who gets a feature and when, monitor adoption and health in real time, and gather structured feedback directly from agencies and locations to inform what ships next.

As an SDE-3, you'll play a key role in building and evolving these systems across the frontend and backend, while contributing to technical architecture and engineering decisions. You'll work on challenges involving high-throughput flag evaluation, scalable APIs and services, distributed systems, and data architecture — with a strong focus on reliability, low latency, and correctness, since every other team's shipping velocity depends on this platform working correctly.

You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers across the org to take features from requirements and technical planning through implementation and production, while contributing to technical decisions and continuously improving the systems you own.

Responsibilities

  • Own and contribute to the architecture, design, and development of key product areas across Feature Flags, Staged Rollouts, and Customer Feedback within the Labs platform.
  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations, working across internal microservices and third-party platforms such as Statsig, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and performance.
  • Build performant and scalable frontend experiences for feature flag management, rollout configuration, and feedback collection workflows using modern frontend frameworks and component-driven architecture with strong state management practices.
  • Drive technical decisions, identify risks and trade-offs, and independently own complex features from technical design through production.
  • Leverage AI-first development practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve development, testing, debugging, and refactoring while maintaining strong quality and security standards.
  • Design data models and build efficient queries and caching strategies across data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, optimized for low-latency flag evaluation at scale.
  • Participate across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and technical design to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Write clean, efficient, secure, and testable code with appropriate unit and integration test coverage.
  • Build and maintain effective observability through logs, metrics, monitoring, and tracing to improve system reliability and enable faster production issue resolution — critical given that other engineering teams depend on Labs to ship safely.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, incident resolution, and operational support, including on-call responsibilities where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Follow engineering best practices around security, scalability, maintainability, testing, documentation, and production readiness.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling robust backend systems and high-performance frontend applications.
  • Strong backend engineering skills with hands-on experience in Node.js, TypeScript, API development, data modeling, and system design. Experience with NestJS is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, distributed systems, and cross-service communication.
  • Hands-on experience working with data stores such as MongoDB and Redis, with a strong understanding of data modeling, query design, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to AI/LLM application development, such as integrating LLM APIs, prompt/context design, or building AI-assisted product workflows.
  • Good frontend development experience with modern frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular, with Vue.js preferred, along with a good understanding of component-driven architecture and modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS or Bootstrap.
  • Experience with frontend state management patterns and libraries such as Vuex/Pinia, Redux, MobX, or similar solutions.
  • Good understanding of production observability and debugging, including logging, monitoring, tracing, error tracking, and performance profiling using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with modern SDLC practices, Agile development methodologies, Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with specialized data platforms such as ClickHouse and Elasticsearch, and an understanding of when to use document databases, analytical/columnar databases, and search engines.
  • Familiarity with modern developer productivity tools, including hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate issues across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and distributed services.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to drive technical discussions, make sound engineering trade-offs, and mentor other engineers.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive complex engineering problems and deliver high-quality solutions.

Why Choose Fitch

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Managed Services team, based in India and working aligned to US/UK business hours. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to help lead the shift from manual Linux operations toward automated, code-reviewed DevOps practices across a large-scale, always-on managed services environment supporting enterprise financial services clients.

Core Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of Python-based tooling and Ansible/Puppet Enterprise playbooks that automate patching, server builds, and other repeatable operational tasks.

- Help design and implement GitLab CI pipelines that bring version control and peer review to infrastructure changes.

- Own day-to-day RHEL 8 administration across physical and virtualized infrastructure — patch management, performance troubleshooting, and configuration management.

- Administer and maintain monitoring, security, and compliance tooling, including Zabbix, SolarWinds, Nessus, and CimTrak.

- Support system hardening, security updates, and vulnerability remediation across the estate.

- Participate in, and help mature, change management processes for infrastructure changes.

- Participate in an on-call rotation, responding to production incidents and escalations.

- Mentor engineers and help build automation and scripting capability across the team.

- Maintain clear technical documentation, procedures, and operational runbooks.

- Work closely with architects, engineers, and support teams to ensure service reliability and availability.

Skills & Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in Linux administration, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, ideally in a managed services or enterprise environment.

- Solid Python programming experience — scripting, automation, API integration.

- Hands-on experience with Ansible and/or Puppet (Puppet Enterprise) for configuration management.

- Familiarity with GitLab (or a similar platform) and CI/CD pipeline concepts.

- Comfortable working US business hours from India, including participation in an on-call rotation.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

- Clear, proactive communicator across a distributed, cross-time-zone team.

Desired Experience (Not Essential)

- Exposure to enterprise storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale/Isilon.

- Familiarity with monitoring/security tools such as CimTrak, in addition to Zabbix, SolarWinds, and Nessus.

- Strong understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, and firewalls.

- Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere.

- Familiarity with LDAP, Kerberos, SSSD, and NFS.

- Understanding of ITIL processes, change management, and incident management.

- Experience working in environments aligned with ISO 27001 or similar security standards.

- Strong ownership mindset with a track record of leading technical initiatives.

- Positive, collaborative approach to mentoring engineers.

- Communicates confidently and professionally with customers, building trusted relationships through clear, effective engagement.

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, covering identity, network, data, workload, and platform security.

  • Define and maintain cloud security architecture standards, reference patterns, baselines, and guardrails aligned with industry frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST, and the Cloud Security Alliance.

  • Operate and mature Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP), and Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) tooling, including detection, prioritization, and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.

  • Partner with engineering, DevOps, and platform teams to embed security into Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines, container, and Kubernetes deployments through automation, policy-as-code, and shift-left practices.

  • Lead investigation and response to cloud-related security incidents in coordination with the SOC, incident response, and platform teams, and drive root-cause analysis and preventive improvements.

  • Manage cloud identity and access security, including IAM hardening, privileged access controls, federation, secrets management, and continuous review of entitlements and permissions.

  • Support audit, regulatory, and compliance activities by maintaining evidence of cloud control design, configuration, monitoring, remediation outcomes, and continuous improvement actions.

  • Maintain awareness of evolving cloud threats, attacker techniques, and platform changes affecting AWS, Azure, GCP, and SaaS services relevant to the organization’s operating footprint.



👉 What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including a track record of leading cloud security initiatives or technical teams.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, identity and access management, network security, encryption, data protection, and workload security in public cloud environments.

  • Hands-on experience with CSPM, CWPP, or CNAPP tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code security (Terraform, CloudFormation), and container or Kubernetes security.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate cloud risks into clear technical recommendations, remediation plans, and architecture decisions for engineering, leadership, and business audiences.

  • Strong written and verbal English proficiency to support multinational stakeholders and present cloud security topics to technical and executive audiences.



👉 Preferred Skills

  • Professional certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer or Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CCSP, CCSK, CISSP, or equivalent senior cloud or security credentials.

  • Experience leading cloud security in regulated environments such as financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, or critical infrastructure.

  • Experience in the gaming or interactive entertainment industry, including familiarity with platform security, player data protection, anti-fraud, and high-availability online service environments.

  • Exposure to multi-cloud security tooling, SIEM and SOAR integration of cloud telemetry, cloud-native logging (CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs, GCP Audit Logs), and threat detection at scale.

  • Experience implementing Zero Trust architectures, secure landing zones, cloud detection engineering, and DevSecOps practices at enterprise scale.

  • Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework for cloud, cloud-specific threat actor techniques, and emerging attack patterns against SaaS and cloud workloads.

  • Understanding of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other regulations relevant to cloud workloads in Malaysia and Southeast Asia.

  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, alerting, metrics, and distributed tracing for production services
  • Understanding of software design principles, common design patterns, clean code, code quality, and maintainable architecture
  • Basic working understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, data privacy, governance, and enterprise compliance concepts

Preferred Qualifications:
