title: Director, Field Operations, Delivery & U4B and High Risk Escalations
description:
About Uber

Uber is a technology company that is changing the way the world thinks about transportation. We are building technology people use every day. Whether it's heading home from work, getting a meal delivered from a favourite restaurant, or a way to earn extra income, Uber is becoming part of the fabric of daily life.

We're making cities safer, smarter, and more connected. And we're doing it at a global scale — energizing local economies and bringing opportunity to millions of people around the world.

Uber's positive impact is tangible in the communities we operate in, and that drives us to keep moving forward.

About the Role

Customer Advocacy and Solutions (CAS) is pioneering how Uber interacts with customers around the globe. The Customer Advocacy and Solutions team's vision is to earn customer trust through effortless experiences, proactive advocacy and relentless innovation. The Field Operations (FieldOps) organization is the arm of CAS that runs Uber's in-house frontline operations organization across 13 Centers of Excellence and 50+ onboarding centers globally.

FieldOps supports all Uber businesses — including Mobility, Delivery and Autonomous Vehicles — across customer support, Trust & Safety, onboarding, compliance, B2B support, payments and risk operations. FieldOps vision is to become a tech-first, high-impact, customer-centric organization that powers the business through insight generation, incubation, and best-in-class operational standards.

We are seeking a senior leader responsible for our Delivery, Uber for Business (U4B), and High Risk Escalations activities worldwide.

  • Delivery and U4B teams focus on B2B support and engagement with our merchant partners and Uber for Business clients.
  • High Risk Escalations teams focus on executive escalations and social media.

This leader will directly oversee large frontline teams supporting Delivery, Uber for Business (U4B), and High Risk Escalations globally. In addition, they will provide regional leadership for APAC-based operations, ensuring alignment, operational consistency, and effective collaboration across all teams based in the region.

FieldOps is undergoing a large-scale transformation to become an AI-first, high-impact organization that does more than resolve individual customer issues. Teams use customer and frontline insights to identify and address root causes, improve products and processes, and continuously raise the bar for the end-to-end support experience.

This leader will play a critical role in that transformation by evolving support from a reactive, volume-driven model into a strategic, tech-enabled function that drives customer insights, influences product and customer experience, and enables scalable growth. They will own the end-to-end workflows and continuous improvement roadmap for Delivery, Uber for Business, and High Risk Escalations. They will drive automation and the adoption of AI across these workflows, identifying opportunities to simplify operations, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and deliver more consistent, high-quality experiences at scale.

Success will require close partnership with Customer Experience, program teams, and technology teams focused on agent platforms, automation, and AI.

The role is both strategic and operational, focused on shaping the next generation of support through customer insight, root-cause resolution, technology, automation, and scalable execution. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering exceptional experiences for customers and employees, brings strong operational rigor, and has the influence and thought leadership to drive meaningful change across the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Set the Vision: Define and drive the multi-year strategy for the Delivery, U4B, and High Risk Escalations organization, aligned with the broader FieldOps transformation toward a tech-first, high-impact operating model.
  • Lead Operations at Global Scale: Oversee globally distributed operations across multiple centers, ensuring consistent service quality, operational excellence, business continuity, and cost efficiency across multiple lines of business and support models.
  • Build the Future Operating Model: Design and evolve a robust, scalable, and adaptable operating model capable of supporting different operational requirements across B2B support, merchant operations, executive escalations, and social media.
  • Transform Operations Through a Tech-First Approach: Drive workflow redesign, automation, GenAI adoption, and operational simplification to improve productivity, quality, and customer experience while enabling faster and smarter support operations.
  • Develop Future Leaders and Culture: Build and mentor high-performing leadership teams, strengthening accountability, strategic thinking, operational rigor, and continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Partner and Influence Across the Business: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Program, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to address root causes, improve tools and workflows, and ensure customer and frontline insights shape business decisions and product evolution.
  • Champion the Voice of the Customer: Establish strong mechanisms to surface and operationalize customer, merchant, business-client, and frontline insights, helping FieldOps become a strategic partner to the broader organization.
  • Measure What Matters: Define and manage the key operational and business KPIs that matter most — including quality, efficiency, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, productivity, and compliance — using data to drive accountability and decision-making.

What You Need

  • Proven Global Leadership: 15+ years of experience leading large-scale, multi-region operations with measurable results in customer experience, efficiency, and organizational transformation.
  • B2B Support Operations: Proven experience leading and scaling B2B support operations, serving business customers and partners through complex, high-volume service environments.
  • Operational Excellence: Expertise in building and scaling global service networks with a data-driven, continuous improvement mindset.
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to translate vision into action, balancing long-term innovation — including AI, automation, and digital workflows — with near-term operational realities.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Strong track record of driving alignment and collaboration across Product, Engineering, Operations, and business teams in complex, matrixed environments.
  • Product-Minded Operator: Ability to identify operational pain points, frame clear problem statements for Product and Engineering teams, and drive automation and product-led improvements.
  • People Leadership: Deep experience developing senior leaders and high-performing teams that thrive through change and deliver outsized impact.
  • Customer and Service Mindset: A passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and elevating service as a competitive advantage.
  • Tech Fluency: Strong understanding of AI, automation, digital workflows, and operational technologies, with the ability to translate emerging technology capabilities into scalable operational improvements and business impact.
  • Change Leadership: Proven ability to lead large-scale organizational and cultural transformation, driving adoption, alignment, and execution in complex, fast-changing environments.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Discipline Lead Ports and Geotech

As part of our growth ambitions, we are looking to strengthen our Ports and Geotechnical business with a dedicated leader. We are seeking an experienced Ports engineer with a strong background in the design and delivery of port and marine projects to strengthen our team. You will play a central leadership role in business development, project delivery, project management, and client acquisition within a dynamic consulting environment.

Your team
You will lead WSP Denmark's Ports and Geotechnics team, currently comprising approximately 10 highly skilled engineers and specialists working across port infrastructure, marine engineering, coastal and geotechnical disciplines. The team delivers projects ranging from feasibility studies and concept development to detailed design and construction support for some of Denmark's most important infrastructure assets. Based on the original team setup within the Transport & Infrastructure division.
As Discipline Lead of Ports and Geotech, you will have overall responsibility for the team's performance, development, and growth. A key objective of the role is to expand the team's capabilities and market presence in line with WSP's strategic ambitions, creating leading Ports and Geotechnics practices.

Working closely with colleagues across Transport & Infrastructure, Environment, Water, Energy, and WSP's global Ports, Marine and Geotechnical networks, you will ensure that our clients have access to the best expertise from across the business while providing attractive career opportunities for our people.

Your Responsibilities
At WSP, we are committed to providing opportunities that support both your professional and personal development. You will work alongside experienced colleagues who support and challenge one another.

You will be responsible for:

  • Leading business development and client engagement activities within Ports and Geotechnics

  • Driving bid management and proposal development for new projects and framework agreements

  • Building and leading the Ports and Geotechnical team, including recruitment and talent development

  • Providing technical leadership in the planning and design of port and marine projects

  • Managing projects with responsibility for schedule, budget, resources, and quality

  • Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders across disciplines and geographies

  • Ensuring compliance with applicable standards, regulations, and client requirements

  • Contributing to the strategic growth and market positioning of WSP's Ports and Geotechnics business

Your Skills and Qualifications
Your background may vary, but it is essential that you have a proven track record of leading complex bids, developing client relationships, and driving business growth. You are curious, commercially minded, possess strong industry insight, excellent communication skills, and have a passion for strategic development.
You must be fluent in Danish and able to prepare high-quality proposals and technical documentation. You should also expect that part of our business development and proposal work will be carried out in English.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with specialization in Geotechnical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Port Engineering

  • Extensive experience within consulting engineering, focused on marine and port projects

  • Proven leadership experience, including project and people management

  • Demonstrated success in business development, client acquisition, and proposal management

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills

  • Ability to maintain structure and oversight in complex projects and business environments

What's in It for You
We are committed to supporting individual needs and recognize the value of different perspectives, backgrounds, and strengths.

While we are passionate about our work, we also recognize that life extends beyond the workplace. We offer flexibility regarding remote working and working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.

We prioritize a positive and inclusive working environment and offer a variety of employee benefits, including social clubs, employee events, a high-quality canteen, pension scheme, health insurance, and more. It matters to us that you enjoy coming to work. We foster a friendly and inclusive culture built on mutual respect, diversity, and equal opportunities.


How to apply
Please send your CV and motivational letter through our portal as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We are looking forward to hearing from you.

About WSP
WSP is one of the world’s leading professional services firms, bringing together expertise in engineering, science, and infrastructure to help shape stronger and more sustainable communities.From our local roots to our global presence today, WSP operates in more than 50 countries and is home to approximately 83,000 talented professionals, whom we call Visioneers. Together, we challenge the status quo, develop groundbreaking solutions, and deliver innovative projects across transportation, infrastructure, environment, property and buildings, energy, water, and mining and metals. title: GK POS Developer
description:
Summary:

The organization is seeking a GK Developer who will be responsible for the design, development, and support of our GK POS (Store Commerce) platform across our retail store network.

As a part of the technology team, this role involves working closely with business stakeholders, store operations, and software team members in designing, implementing, and supporting point-of-sale solutions that support our retail, ecommerce, and store operations.

Responsibilities

• This individual will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and supporting our GK POS / GK Retail Store Commerce platform, ensuring reliable point-of-sale operations, integrations, and production support across our retail store network

• This is a full-time, hands-on technical role requiring strong knowledge of retail POS systems, store operations, and production support processes

• Design, develop, and maintain GK POS / GK Retail Store Commerce solutions supporting transaction processing, payments, returns, promotions, and receipts

• Lead production support efforts, including incident management, major incident handling, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management

• Develop and maintain integrations between GK POS and ERP, OMS, payment gateway, and eCommerce platforms

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, store operations, and engineering teams to identify and document requirements for system enhancements and integrations

• Troubleshoot complex production issues through log analysis and system diagnostics

• Coordinate with vendors, architects, and engineering teams, and manage escalations with clear communication during critical incidents

• Drive operational excellence, SLA adherence, RCA quality, and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field is required.

• 5+ years of experience in Retail/QSR POS systems and store operations is required.

• Strong GK POS/ Other POS technical and functional expertise, with hands-on experience in GK POS / GK Retail Store Commerce/ Other POS, is required.

• Hands-on experience with Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, and SQL.

• Experience with Node.js is required to support and maintain our existing custom Node.js applications

• Deep understanding of POS architecture, transaction processing, payments, returns, promotions, receipts, and recovery workflows.

• Experience with POS integrations including ERP, OMS, payment gateway, and eCommerce platforms.

• Strong production support background, including incident management, major incident handling, root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and release/defect triage.

• Experience with Vue.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript for frontend development is a plus.

• Knowledge of omnichannel retail operations is a plus.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform cloud environments is a plus.

• Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk, or CloudWatch is a plus.

• Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and functional architecture is a plus.

• Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized application support is a plus.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Project Manager
description:
What You’ll Do

As a Project Manager at Smartly, you’ll play a key role in bringing high-impact digital campaigns to life. You’ll own the end-to-end delivery process, working closely with cross-functional teams and clients to ensure everything runs smoothly, from first brief to final optimization.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy connecting the dots, solving problems proactively, and making things happen in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and drive the end-to-end campaign delivery process, from briefing and production to QA, launch, and reporting/optimization
  • Oversee resource allocation and ensure efficient utilization across projects
  • Collaborate daily with internal teams including Production, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and other stakeholders
  • Ensure all activities follow best practices and standard operating procedures
  • Manage timelines and turnaround times (TAT), proactively flagging risks or delays to CSMs
  • Lead communication across stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency throughout project delivery
  • Conduct quality checks to ensure all creative outputs meet standards prior to final delivery
  • Partner with CSMs to build campaign structures (e.g., decision trees) and ensure alignment between media and creative strategies
  • Facilitate and establish efficient workflows and procedures
  • Validate that proposed creative strategies are feasible and delivered efficiently
  • Contribute to ideation using industry and platform knowledge
  • Support ongoing campaign optimization based on performance insights

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is organized, proactive, and thrives in a collaborative, client-facing environment.

You’ll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of experience in project management within digital advertising
  • Are a strong communicator: clear, confident, and able to navigate complex stakeholder conversations
  • Knowledgeable in creating project timelines with respect to the SLAs and client requirements
  • Can balance multiple priorities and stay on top of deadlines in a fast-moving environment
  • Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional teams (e.g., developers, QA, creatives)
  • Have a sharp eye for detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work
  • Are solutions-oriented and confident in managing expectations, even in challenging situations
  • Are highly organized, self-driven, and proactive in your approach to work
  • Have working knowledge of Google Workspace, including basic Google Sheets formulas
  • Bring a positive, team-first mindset and enjoy collaborating with others
  • Are flexible to work across global shifts (UK, EMEA, APAC, US, AU)

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

title: Measurement Sciences Intern (R&D) 2027
description: Overview We are currently on the lookout for a Laboratory intern to join our R&D team based in Little Island, Cork. In this role, the successful applicant will join PepsiCo’s Measurement Sciences team which provides analytical testing support for PepsiCo’s Beverage manufacturers globally as part of the company’s QA and innovation agendas. The team operates under an ISO17025:2017 accredited quality management system and utilises various analytical test methods for the analysis of analytes in finished product beverages (CO2 analysis, Brix analysis, TA, Torque, TDS, UPLC) and water (Wet Chemistry, IC-MS/MS, ICP-MS, GC-MS), to ensure that all PepsiCo beverage products meet the highest possible regulatory and quality standards. PepsiCo is a global organisation, situated in 15 locations across 8 countries offering careers in various functions from Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, R&D, HR and IT. We want team members who can collaborate in our fast-paced global organisation and are passionate about creating and delivering much-loved household brands to markets across the world. Responsibilities Complete assigned project work Support the Lab by maintaining GLP, preparing samples and finding samples for repeat analysis, as required Prepare lab solutions, reagents, and controls as necessary for completing analysis and running instrumentation Perform accurate analysis of analytical samples in compliance with PepsiCo global procedures and standards Develop reference files, quality control charts, and graphs on laboratory data Review and interprets test results Support test method investigations where required Use laboratory business information and reporting systems (LIMS) Adhere to ISO 17025:2017 and A2LA policies for the laboratory Adhere to site Health & Safety and Good Laboratory Practice policies and procedures Qualifications A can-do, positive attitude with a willingness to take on new challenges Passion for investigating and solving new analytical problems Active listening skills and is flexible regarding priority changes Good organization, time management, and teamwork skills Ability to analyse and interpret data Excellent written and oral communication skills - ability to communicate confidently and effectively in a timely manner Knowledge of analytical techniques (e.g. Titration, Chromatography, etc.) Knowledge of quality assurance activities and quality management systems

title: Teknisk Ingenjör till NG Nordic Sweden
description:
Teknisk Ingenjör till NG Nordic Sweden

Vill du kombinera teknik, problemlösning och utveckling i en spännande industrimiljö?

Vi söker en hands-on Teknisk Ingenjör som vill vara med och utveckla vår verksamhet inom IBA & Ashes, Metal Refinery.

I den här rollen får du en bred och varierad vardag där du kombinerar automation, underhåll, industriell IT/OT, tekniska projekt, aktiviteter kopplat till produktionen och förbättringsarbete. Du blir en viktig teknisk resurs i verksamheten och får stora möjligheter att påverka hur vi utvecklar vår produktion framåt.

Om rollen

Som Teknisk Ingenjör arbetar du nära produktion, underhåll, engineering, IT/OT och externa samarbetspartners. Du blir en problemlösare och teknisk specialist som bidrar till att vår anläggning fungerar säkert, stabilt och effektivt.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Leda och delta i tekniska projekt och förbättringsinitiativ.
  • Arbeta med PLC, HMI och industriell automation.
  • Optimera mjukvaruinställningar och justera parametrar i styrsystemet.
  • Felsöka och utveckla automations- och produktionssystem.
  • Utveckla strategier för förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll.
  • Stödja verksamheten vid produktionsstörningar och tekniska problem.
  • Arbeta med industriell IT/OT, nätverk, servrar och fjärråtkomst.
  • Ta fram tekniska lösningar och konstruktioner i CAD.
  • Samordna entreprenörer, leverantörer och tekniska samarbetspartners.
  • Delta i driftsättning och optimering av ny utrustning och nya processer.
  • Genomföra grundorsaksanalyser och driva långsiktiga förbättringar.
  • Följa och analysera tekniska och produktionsrelaterade data för att öka driftsäkerhet och effektivitet.
  • Provtagning, mätning, analysering och uppföljning av material för att säkerställa kvalitén.
  • Bidra till ett systematiskt arbete inom arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och miljö.

Du fungerar som teknisk expert och stöd för produktion och underhåll och får även möjlighet att dela din kunskap genom utbildning och introduktion av kollegor.

Vi tror att du har

  • Utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom teknik, automation, el, mekatronik eller mekanik.
  • Erfarenhet av industriellt underhåll och driftsäkerhet.
  • Kunskap inom PLC, HMI och industriell automation.
  • Erfarenhet av industriella nätverk och IT/OT-miljöer.
  • Erfarenhet av CAD, exempelvis Autodesk Inventor.
  • Erfarenhet av tekniska projekt och/eller samordning av entreprenörer.
  • God problemlösningsförmåga och ett analytiskt tänkande.
  • Ett strukturerat, praktiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt.
  • Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från processindustri, metallindustri eller annan komplex produktionsmiljö.

Vi erbjuder

En bred teknisk roll

Du får arbeta med allt från automation och IT/OT till produktion, underhåll, konstruktion och tekniska projekt.

Möjlighet att påverka

Dina idéer och lösningar får direkt betydelse för anläggningens säkerhet, driftsäkerhet, effektivitet och utveckling.

Teknisk utveckling

Du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera teknikområden och arbeta med modern industriell teknik.

Nära verksamheten

Du arbetar nära produktionen och ser konkret resultat av dina insatser.

Varierad vardag

Här är ingen dag den andra lik. Du får kombinera strategiskt förbättringsarbete med praktisk problemlösning och dagliga situationer som dagligen uppstår i produktionen.

Är du vår nästa tekniska problemlösare? Om du gillar att förstå hur tekniska system fungerar, hitta lösningar på komplexa problem och samtidigt vara med och utveckla verksamheten, kan det här vara rätt roll för dig.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Information och ansökan

Vi värdesätter mångfald och välkomnar alla kvalificerade sökande.

  • Omfattning: Heltid
  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning
  • Placering: Norrsundet, Gävle
  • Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, 2026-11-09.

Vi vill att vår rekrytering ska vara rättvis och inkluderande. Därför ber vi inte om bilder eller långa ansökningsbrev. I stället använder vi frågor i ansökningsprocessen som gör det lättare att jämföra kandidater och säkerställa rättvisa. Vi ber om könsuppgift för att kunna främja en god könsbalans i vår rekryteringsprocess.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet ahkera ja oma-aloitteinen tekijä, joka tarttuu työhön reippaalla otteella ja on valmis työskentelemään joustavasti sää- ja työtilanteen mukaan. Hyvä fyysinen kunto on tehtävässä tärkeää, sillä työ on aktiivista ja ulkona tapahtuvaa.

B-ajokortti ja oma auto katsotaan eduksi, sillä työkohteet sijaitsevat eri puolilla Espoonlahden ja Finnoon aluetta.

Fluent Finnish is required for this position.

Mitä työ tarjoaa?

Työ alkaa perehdytyksellä marraskuun alkupuolella, ja lumityövuoroja on tarjolla talvikauden aikana sään ja työtilanteen mukaan. Työssä toimit osana tiimiä, jossa tehtyä työtä raportoidaan ja dokumentoidaan. Saat käyttöösi laadukkaat työvälineet, joiden asianmukaisesta käytöstä ja huolenpidosta vastaat.

title: Laserhitsaaja, koulutetaan tehtävään
description:
Laserhitsaaja – mahdollisuus oppia uusi ammattitaito


Etsimme asiakkaallemme laserhitsaukseen tekijää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävä sopii hyvin metallialan koulutuksen suorittaneelle henkilölle, joka haluaa aloittaa työuransa käytännön metallitöiden parissa ja oppia uuden hitsausmenetelmän.


Aikaisempi kokemus laserhitsauksesta ei ole välttämätöntä – tehtävään perehdytetään. Tärkeintä on kiinnostus metallialan töihin, huolellinen työote ja halu oppia.

Työskentelet laserhitsauksen parissa osana metallialan tuotantoa. Työssä korostuvat tarkkuus ja huolellisuus sekä kyky tehdä työtä annettujen ohjeiden mukaisesti.


Tehtävään kuuluu esimerkiksi:

* laserhitsaukseen liittyviä tuotannon työtehtäviä
* kappaleiden valmistelua ja käsittelyä
* työn laadun tarkistamista
* muita metallialan tuotannon tehtäviä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?


Voit olla jo kokemusta omaava metallialan tekijä tai urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva osaaja. Erityisesti arvostamme:

* metallialan koulutusta, esimerkiksi metallialan perustutkintoa
* kiinnostusta hitsaukseen ja metallialan tuotantotyöhön
* tarkkaa ja huolellista työotetta
* hyvää oppimiskykyä ja halua kehittyä
* reipasta ja motivoitunutta asennetta työntekoon
* valmiutta työskennellä tarvittaessa 2-vuorotyössä
* erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa


Laserhitsauksen aikaisempi osaaminen katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole edellytys. Tehtävään saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja mahdollisuuden oppia laserhitsauksen käytännössä.


Mitä tarjoamme?

* vakituisen kokoaikaisen työsuhteen
* mahdollisuuden oppia laserhitsauksen osaajaksi
* perehdytyksen tehtävään
* käytännönläheisen työn metallialalla
* mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi
* työn, jossa osaaminen karttuu tekemisen kautta


Palkka on alkuun noin 12 €/h, osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.


Jos olet esimerkiksi juuri valmistunut metallialan koulutuksesta ja etsit ensimmäistä vakituista työpaikkaasi metallialalta, tämä voi olla hyvä mahdollisuus päästä aloittamaan ura käytännön tuotantotyössä.


Kiinnostuitko?


Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi lyhyesti koulutuksestasi, mahdollisesta metallialan työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, miksi laserhitsaus kiinnostaa sinua.


Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att leda en verksamhet där ingen dag är den andra lik och där utveckling står i fokus.

Din roll

Som apotekschef på Vargen har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamheten, medarbetarna och resultaten. Du leder och utvecklar apoteket med kvalitet, patientsäkerhet och kundens behov i centrum. Genom ett närvarande och engagerat ledarskap skapar du förutsättningar för att teamet ska trivas, utvecklas och fortsätta leverera hög service varje dag. Detta ligger i linje med Apotekets chefsroll där fokus ligger på att utveckla både verksamhet och människor.

Vad du kommer att göra hos oss

Som apotekschef kommer du att utveckla verksamheten och stärka teamets fortsatta framgång. Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Leda, coacha och utveckla teamet med fokus på engagemang, samarbete och arbetsglädje.

  • Säkerställa hög kvalitet, patientsäkerhet och en god kundupplevelse.

  • Driva apotekets utveckling och verksamhetsförbättringar, både operativt och strategiskt.

  • Skapa goda förutsättningar för kompetensutveckling och lärande i teamet.

  • Samarbeta med kollegor och funktioner inom Apoteket för att utveckla verksamheten och möta framtidens behov.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad farmaceut och har minst tre års erfarenhet som apotekschef. Du är en trygg och tydlig ledare som skapar engagemang, bygger förtroende och får människor att utvecklas tillsammans mot gemensamma mål.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

  • har erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team i en verksamhet med högt tempo

  • är trygg i att fatta beslut och hantera komplexa situationer på ett professionellt sätt

  • har förmåga att skapa struktur, tydlighet och arbetsglädje även när förutsättningarna förändras

  • har god förmåga att bygga samarbete och skapa engagemang i team med olika perspektiv och erfarenheter

  • kombinerar ett starkt verksamhetsfokus med ett genuint intresse för människor och deras utveckling

Vi erbjuder...

• Friskvårdsbidrag: 5 000 kr per år.

• Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.

• Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.

• Förmånsportal (Benify): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.

• Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.

Om oss

Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3 000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården, alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.

Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.

Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.

Det här är en roll för dig som motiveras av ledarskap på riktigt. Du ser möjligheten i att leda ett erfaret team, skapa tydlighet när det behövs och bygga en kultur där både människor och verksamhet utvecklas.

Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse. Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet så att du får en tydligare bild av uppdraget. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev. Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.

Välkommen till Apoteket!

title: Software Engineer I: Payload Engineer
description:
About Lodestar

Lodestar's mission is to develop the first "Protect and Defend" capability for high-value space assets in orbit. Our flagship product MITHRIL is the critical hardware & software necessary to augment any off-the-shelf spacecraft with the ability to autonomously detect, characterise, and reversibly neutralise orbital threats. By building on the proven space heritage of our best-in-class satellite-bus partners and fully integrating MITHRIL as a single platform, we deliver a fully autonomous end-to-end protection spacecraft service.

About the Job

As a Payload Engineer I at Lodestar, you'll be joining the payload team as a primary delivery engineer on CORONA, a SpaceWERX Direct-to-Phase-II program to take an integrated autonomous sensing and effector payload from laboratory breadboard to qualified engineering model.

You'll help design, build, integrate and test the payload across optics, mechanical, avionics and software. Working alongside the Founding Engineer and senior systems, GNC, electronics and optics engineers, you'll take the engineering model through 18 months and nine milestones, with design reviews in front of USSF, Space Systems Command and AFRL at each gate.

This is an early-career role with a deliberately broad scope. We're looking for hands-on building experience and fast learning rather than a long track record, and you'll own the engineering model from day one with the support to grow into it.

We proudly have an "extreme ownership" oriented engineering culture.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the payload engineering model day to day, end to end: requirements, design, build, integration, test and write-up
  • Develop payload, autonomy, effector, power, thermal and pointing requirements, and the ICDs between payload, avionics and spacecraft bus
  • Prepare SRR, PDR and CDR packages, and keep the verification matrix and risk register current between gates
  • Integrate the engineering model: effector subsystem, edge-compute avionics, and a multimodal sensor suite (optical, LiDAR, radar)
  • Carry out optical alignment and performance verification, and feed corrective design iterations back into the build
  • Run hardware-in-the-loop testing in the Void Lab, closing the loop from perception through to pointing against simulated orbital targets
  • Support environmental qualification (TVAC, launch vibration, EMC/EMI), including pre- and post-test functional testing and the anomaly and corrective-action trail
  • Deliver an end-to-end ground demonstration on a payload-in-the-loop testbed
  • Produce customer-facing documentation: test reports, qualification dossier, and final performance assessment against KPPs

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Physics, Optics or Photonics, Robotics, Computer Science, or demonstrated equivalent knowledge
  • 0–2 years of professional experience. Early-career candidates, including recent graduates, are encouraged to apply
  • Hands-on evidence of building something real and making it work, such as a university cubesat or rocketry team, research lab, Formula Student, a hardware internship, or a project taken from nothing to working. We weight this far above grades
  • Working proficiency in Python

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Space exposure in any form: cubesat program, hosted payload, space or defense internship, or a space-focused Master's project
  • Optics and photonics bench work (laser safety experience, e.g. ANSI Z136, a plus)
  • Computer vision
  • Closed-loop pointing and control
  • Environmental test and integration
  • Systems engineering practice
  • Embedded or real-time software

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay Range for this role:
    • (P1) Entry: $99,000 - $133,000 / year
  • Meaningful equity incentives as part of our employee option pool
  • Flexible PTO with generous paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
  • Comprehensive medical, dental & vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Los Angeles

Additional Information

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options , and access to medical, vision and dental coverage, as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

Lodestar is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Lodestar is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Regulatory & Governance Support

Compliance Programme Support

Regional Compliance Support

Nice to Have

title: Team Leader, ICE Climate Operations
description:
Job Purpose

ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform.

Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities.

The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data-related queries with increasing independence.

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership and delivery management
    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
    • Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change.
    • Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions.
    • Conduct regular one-to-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness.
    • Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts.
  • Physical risk project and product support
    • Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private-company asset classes.
    • Coordinate delivery with Product and R&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development.
    • Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on-demand QA or updates for client-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure.
    • Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams.
  • Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance
    • Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators.
    • Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources.
    • Review complex or high-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
    • Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due-diligence standards.
    • Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable.
  • Data, reporting, and operational governance
    • Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance.
    • Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
    • Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve.
    • Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations.
  • Process improvement, automation, and capability building
    • Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality.
    • Promote responsible use of AI-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions.
    • Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms.
    • Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data-intensive operational environment.
  • Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research-based verification.

title: Commercial Director (ML)
description:
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Commercial Director to lead and develop Meaningful lives devision's commercial strategy and business development activity. The post-holder will be responsible for supporting sustainable organisational growth, strengthening stakeholder and commissioner relationships, identifying new business opportunities and ensuring commercial decisions align with the organisation’s values, quality standards and strategic objectives. This role requires strong commercial leadership, sound knowledge of health and social care markets, and the ability to balance growth, financial sustainability and positive outcomes for people supported.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and visible commercial leadership across the organisation, ensuring business development activity supports organisational values, service quality and long-term sustainability.

  • Develop and implement the commercial strategy, business development plan and growth objectives in line with organisational priorities and market opportunities.

  • Identify, evaluate and pursue new business opportunities across adult social care, complex care, supported living, community care and related regulated services.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local authorities, NHS organisations, integrated care systems, commissioners, housing providers, healthcare professionals and other strategic partners.

  • Lead the preparation and submission of tenders, bids, expressions of interest, framework applications and contract proposals, ensuring high-quality and commercially viable submissions.

  • Monitor commissioning trends, competitor activity, regulatory developments and changes in health and social care markets to inform commercial planning and service development.

  • Work closely with operational, finance, quality and clinical colleagues to assess the feasibility, risks, costs and benefits of new services and commercial opportunities.

  • Develop pricing strategies, financial models and commercial proposals that support value for money, service quality and sustainable margins.

  • Lead contract negotiations, renewals and variations, ensuring agreements are commercially sound, clearly documented and aligned with regulatory and operational requirements.

  • Oversee contract mobilisation and implementation activity, ensuring new services are launched effectively, safely and in accordance with agreed specifications.

  • Monitor commercial performance against revenue targets, budgets, key performance indicators, contract requirements and organisational objectives.

  • Prepare regular commercial reports, market analysis, forecasts and recommendations for senior leadership and governance meetings.

  • Support the development of compelling service propositions, marketing materials, presentations and communications for commissioners, partners and other stakeholders.

  • Ensure all commercial activity reflects CQC requirements, safeguarding responsibilities, contractual obligations, information governance and relevant health and social care legislation.

  • Identify and manage commercial, financial, contractual and reputational risks, escalating concerns and implementing appropriate mitigation plans.

  • Contribute to organisational strategy, mergers, acquisitions, partnerships and service development initiatives where appropriate.

  • Promote equality, diversity and inclusion throughout commercial activity, ensuring proposed services reflect the needs, rights and aspirations of the people supported.

Person Specification

  • Substantial senior commercial, business development or strategic partnerships experience within health, social care, supported living, healthcare or another regulated service environment.

  • Demonstrable experience of developing and delivering commercial strategies, growth plans and new business opportunities.

  • Strong understanding of adult social care commissioning, local authority and NHS procurement processes, contract management and competitive tendering.

  • Proven track record of preparing successful bids, tenders, framework applications and commercial proposals.

  • Experience of negotiating and managing contracts, service-level agreements, partnership arrangements and complex commercial terms.

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience of pricing, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and assessing return on investment.

  • Knowledge of CQC requirements, safeguarding, health and social care legislation and the quality standards relevant to regulated care services.

  • Excellent relationship-building, influencing, negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and commissioners.

  • Strong analytical and market research abilities, including the capacity to interpret data, assess risk and make evidence-based commercial decisions.

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce persuasive bids, reports, proposals and board-level documentation.

  • Strategic, entrepreneurial and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to identify opportunities while maintaining appropriate commercial and regulatory oversight.

  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and projects while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Collaborative leadership style, with the ability to work effectively across operational, finance, quality, clinical and corporate functions.

  • Proficient in using IT systems, CRM platforms, Microsoft Office applications, financial tools and data analysis systems.

  • Commitment to person-centred care, ethical business practice, equality, inclusion and positive outcomes for all people supported.

  • Willingness to undertake an enhanced DBS check and provide satisfactory references as part of pre-employment checks.

  • Flexible approach to working, including travel between services and occasional evening or weekend availability when commercially or operationally required.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay commensurate with experience and responsibilities.

  • Contributory pension scheme.

  • Comprehensive induction, ongoing training and leadership development opportunities.

  • Supportive organisational culture and access to an Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Opportunities to shape the future growth and development of Yorkshire Community Care.

  • Opportunities for career progression within Yorkshire Community Care and across our services.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Staff Software Engineer (IC4) on AI-Native ITSM designs, builds, ships, and operates capabilities whose core behavior is model-driven rather than explicitly authored—agentic and conversational experiences that interpret an IT operator's or end-user's intent, reason over incident, request, change, and knowledge contexts, invoke tools and workflows, and act on the user's behalf across the incident-to-resolution and request-to-fulfillment lifecycles. An agent operating on incidents and requests touches SLA compliance, incident classification accuracy, knowledge fidelity, and user trust—a confidently wrong diagnosis is not a suggestion, it is a failed resolution. At IC4 the engineer owns AI design decisions across the domain, not within a single feature, and owns the correctness of what ships whether a person or an agent produced it. #### What You Do - Build AI-native capability across the IT service management: Design and ship features built around agentic behavior—intent interpretation, multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and action on the user's behalf—together with the data models, integrations, and channels that make them usable in production. In AI-Native ITSM this spans guided request categorization and routing, natural-language incident description and classification, conversational incident status and in-flight updates, intelligent assignment and routing, knowledge article recommendation and summarization, and auto-remediation orchestration. - Design AI-driven autonomous workflows: Decompose ITSM processes into the steps and decision points an agent can execute—determining where autonomy is appropriate, where a checkpoint with a person is required, and how exceptions, retries, and hand-back are handled. The design must make that distinction structural rather than advisory. - Author and maintain agentic instructions as engineering artifacts: Write, structure, and version the system instructions, role definitions, tool descriptions, guardrails, and escalation paths that govern agent behavior in the domain—under code review, source control, and regression coverage. Own the shared instruction and tool-description surface that adjacent teams build against. - Build automated evaluation and test non-deterministic behavior: Design and operate the evaluation that makes change safe—golden datasets, multi-turn conversation suites, model-as-judge scoring calibrated to human review, CI gates, and drift detection—plus adversarial, jailbreak, grounding, and tool-selection testing. - Design conversational experiences across channels: Build experiences that hold context across turns, hand off cleanly between automated and live agents, and behave consistently across chat and voice—accounting for what voice imposes: latency budgets, barge-in, speech recognition error, disambiguation, and explicit confirmation before consequential actions. - Specify precisely and direct AI coding agents: Convert requirements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent-sized tasks; supervise several workstreams in parallel; and review agent output for correctness, spec adherence, security, and maintainability. You own the result regardless of what produced it. - Own quality, safety, and reliability in production: Monitor conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool-selection error, and unsafe or unauthorized action. Defend against prompt injection and data leakage across integration surfaces. Maintain reasoning-trace observability and model rollback mechanisms, and feed production failures back into specifications and evaluation sets. Lead root-cause analysis when agentic behavior deviates from intent. - Ground it in solid full-stack delivery: Build the application, APIs, data models, and integrations around these capabilities—front-end experiences for IT operators and end-users, server-side logic, and the connections to knowledge, asset, change, and fulfillment systems—with the CI/CD, observability, and upgrade-safe extensibility expected of production software. - Collaborate across product, design, and engineering: Partner with product managers, designers, conversation designers, and engineers to define success criteria and communicate capability and risk clearly. Mentor IC1 to IC3 engineers, and raise the team's practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use.

Required Experience and Skills - Production track record: A demonstrated record of building, shipping, and operating production software, including hands-on delivery of AI-native application features that real users depend on. Depth and demonstrated judgment matter more than tenure; typically around 9+ years of relevant software engineering experience. - Agentic delivery experience: Direct experience authoring agentic instructions and prompts, designing AI-driven autonomous workflows, and building the evaluation and testing that verifies them. This is required, not preferred. - Production AI integration: Experience integrating large language model APIs and retrieval-grounded features, including agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement. - Domain ownership: Demonstrated ownership of a complex domain or subsystem end-to-end, including the architectural decisions, migrations, and operational consequences. - Engineering fundamentals: Strong command of data structures, algorithms, system design, APIs, data modeling, and testing. Proficiency in front-end development with a modern component framework, server-side development, relational data modeling, and REST and GraphQL API design. - Applied machine learning literacy: A working command of the concepts that govern how these systems behave—evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic output and failure modes of modern models—sufficient to reason about, debug, and verify model-driven behavior in production. - Accountable use of AI coding agents: Current, effective use of AI coding assistants and agents with evidence of accountable delivery: precise specification, critical review of generated output, and verification harnesses. - Operational experience: Hands-on CI/CD, containerized workloads, and observability experience, plus direct on-call and incident-command experience with customer-facing systems. - Mentorship: Demonstrated mentorship of less-experienced engineers and a record of raising quality through code review. - Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Experience - ITSM domain depth: Incident management, request fulfillment, change management, problem management, knowledge management, or SLA-driven operations at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it. - Evaluation and observability tooling: Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for model-driven applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale. - Conversation design partnership: Working alongside conversation or content designers on dialogue flow, tone, and error-recovery design. - Forward-deployed delivery: Building against a customer's data, integrations, and ITSM tooling, and tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment. - Platform depth: ServiceNow ITSM experience including scoped applications, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Automated Test Framework, and upgrade-safe extension patterns.

title: Myyjä 22,5h/vko, Nissen Jumbo
description:
Optisen alan parhaat näkymät odottavat sinua Instru Optiikalla – nyt on mahdollisuutesi liittyä osaksi tiimiämme!

Optisena myyjänä kohtaat jokaisen asiakkaan ilolla ja ammattitaidolla ja työskentelet määrätietoisesti myyntitavoitteita kohti yhdessä tiimisi kanssa. Tarjoat asiakkaillemme laadukkaimmat tuotteet ja palvelut, kuten All Inclusive, laajat kuvantamismahdollisuudet, etänäöntutkimukset, kuivasilmäklinikat sekä EssilorLuxottican huikean brändivalikoiman.

Miltä työpäiväsi meillä näyttää?

Optisena myyjänä vastaat ensiluokkaisen asiakaskokemuksen luomisesta myymäläkäynnin alusta loppuun saakka. Otat asiakkaat vastaan, suoritat heille esitutkimukset ja ohjaat heidät optometristin näöntutkimukseen. Näöntutkimuksen jälkeen tarjoat asiakkaille optometristin suosituksiin pohjautuen laadukkaimmat linssit, parhaat piilolinssit sekä tietysti kaikkein tyylikkäimmät kehykset. Kun kaupat on tehty, tilaat asiakkaalle räätälöidyt tuotteet tilausjärjestelmämme kautta. Luovutat valmiit tuotteet asiakkaille, varmistat niiden täydellisen istuvuuden ja opastat tuotteiden käytössä.

Me odotamme sinulta

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityöstä esimerkiksi myymäläympäristössä

- Halua tehdä tuloksellista myyntityötä yhdessä tiimisi kanssa

- Kykyä vaihtaa sujuvasti tehtävästä toiseen pitäen kuitenkin asiakkaan aina etusijalla

- Motivaatiota omaksua uutta tietoa ja kehittää omaa osaamista optisella alalla

- Hyviä digitaalisia ja järjestelmäteknisiä taitoja

Vaikka tehtävää ja tapahtumaa onkin paljon, saat asiantuntevilta kollegoiltasi kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi. Huolehdimme ammatillisesta kehittymisestäsi kuukausittaisilla koulutuksilla ja vuosittaisilla koulutustapahtumilla. Meillä on hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet ja tuemme sinua kasvamaan urallasi.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja töiden aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on 22,5 h/viikko ja työvuorot sijoittuvat [myymälän aukioloaikojen](https://www.nissen.fi/myymala/jumbo?gad_campaignid=14580905948&gad_source=1&gbraid=0AAAAADMswz3POf9YNZ5bW84Pmg4oJsmuc) puitteisiin.

Noudatamme Kaupan alan työehtosopimusta, jolloin palkkaukseen vaikuttaa mm. aikaisempi kokemus myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutehtävistä. Lisäksi hyvästä suorituksesta on mahdollista ansaita provisioita. Instrulaisena saat myös tuntuvat alennukset laajasta tuote- ja palveluvalikoimastamme kattavaa työterveyshuoltoa ja liikunta- ja kulttuurietua unohtamatta.

Olemme osa EssilorLuxotticaa

EssilorLuxottica on maailmanlaajuinen edelläkävijä silmälasilinssien, kehysten ja aurinkolasien suunnittelussa, valmistuksessa ja jakelussa. Toimimme yli 150 maassa ja tarjoamme näönhuollon ammattilaisille pääsyn laadukkaisiin tuotteisiin ja palveluihin – aina Essilorin tunnetuista linssibrändeistä (Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest ja Transitions) kuluttajien rakastamiin ikonisiin kehysmerkkeihin (Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear ja Costa). Liity osaksi maailmanlaajuista, yli 190 000 työntekijän yhteisöämme ja ole mukana muovaamassa näönhuollon tulevaisuutta.

Monimuotoisuus, tasa-arvo ja osallisuus

Olemme sitoutuneet luomaan osallistavan ympäristön kaikille työntekijöille. Juhlistamme monimuotoisuutta ja tarjoamme yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet kaikille – riippumatta sukupuolesta, etnisyydestä, uskonnosta, vammasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai mistä tahansa muusta ominaisuudesta, joka tekee meistä ainutlaatuisia.

Instru Optiikka Oy

Me Instru Optiikka Oy:ssä tarjoamme sinulle mahtavan työyhteisön, joka toivottaa uudet työntekijät lämpimästi tervetulleiksi. Olemme vakaa, jo 130 vuotta alalla toiminut, ihmiskeskeinen työnantaja. Toimintaamme ohjaa halu toimia markkinoiden johtavana näönhuollon ammattilaisena ja asiakkaiden ykkösvalintana. title: AI Product Engineer (senior)
description:
Be part of Europe’s first AI-powered food-tech platform.

We are a tech-first company rethinking dining and delivery, including drone delivery, among the first in Europe. Backed by General Catalyst, Lifeline Ventures and more.


TL;DR

  • Own AI end to end: find the problem, design the solution, ship it with the team

  • Focus on agentic systems and AI integrations across our products and operations

  • We run a live platform across many brands and locations. Your job is to make it smarter: optimization and operational problems solved with AI

  • Top-of-market compensation in Helsinki, attractive equity, hybrid work

  • Modern Stack: Go, Python, TypeScript/React, GCP, Kubernetes on GKE, GitHub Actions

  • AI-native workflow: Claude Code and Copilot are part of our daily development work

Why Huuva, why now

Huuva brings the most loved city-center food brands closer to suburban communities through multi-brand kitchens.

We have grown fast since 2021 and are now scaling to new cities. We believe the winner in this space runs on AI. We want you to build that.

What you'll work on:

  • Find the problems. Work with ops, product, and business teams. Spot where AI creates real value and where it does not.

  • Design the solutions. Agents, workflows, retrieval, or plain code. Pick the simplest thing that works.

  • Ship with the team. Production services in Go, Python, and TypeScript on GCP and Kubernetes. Own reliability, cost, and evaluation.

  • Build agentic systems and AI integrations into our existing products and operations.

  • Set the standard for AI-assisted development across the team.

  • Measure impact. Evals, monitoring, business metrics. Kill what does not work.


Your toolbox (today)

Go, Python, TypeScript/React, GCP, Kubernetes on GKE, GitHub Actions, Vercel, BigQuery, Claude Code, Copilot.

What we're looking for:

  • Solid software engineer first. You have shipped and run production systems end to end.

  • Comfortable across the stack: Go or Python, TypeScript, GCP, Kubernetes.

  • Hands-on with LLMs in production: agents, tool use, RAG, structured outputs, evals.

  • You think in business outcomes, not demos.

  • Ownership mindset. You have led initiatives from scoping to rollout.

  • Pragmatic. You know when AI is the wrong tool.

  • Located in EU/EEA with the right to work, willing to be in Helsinki regularly.

  • Not a fit if you want a research role, a pure prompt-engineering role, or ticket-based execution.


Benefits:

  • Top-of-market compensation in Helsinki plus attractive equity

  • Hybrid: remote flexibility plus an office in central Helsinki

  • A close-knit team with a supportive culture

  • Strong tooling, CI/CD, and engineering standards

  • Time allocated for quality and experiments

Our interview process:

1. Intro call

2. Tech assignment & interview with an AI solution design challenge on a real Huuva problem

3. Culture interview

4. Decision

Sounds like you? Let's connect.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: Osa-aikainen Myyjä Seinäjoelle
description:
Etsimme nyt Seinäjoen myymälään

osa-aikaista myyjää

Myyjän työtehtävät Puuilossa sisältävät muun muassa

  • Asiakaspalvelua Myyjät ovat Puuilon kasvot arkisissa asiakaskohtaamisissa. Asiakaskunta on laaja ja moninainen, joten työpäivä sisältää erilaisia asiakaskohtaamisia ja -tilanteita. Asiakkaamme arvostavat auttamishalua ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä jokaisessa tilanteessa.

  • Kassa- ja infotyötä Työpäivät sisältävät niin kassa- kuin infotyötä. Infotyöskentelyyn kuuluu asiakkaiden reklamaatioiden käsittelyä, mahdollisten ongelmien ratkaiseminen sekä peräkärryjen vuokraaminen.

  • Hyllyttämistä ja esillepanoja Yksi myyjän tärkeimmistä tehtävistä on varmistaa, että kuormat puretaan hyllyyn asiakkaiden saataville. Esillepanojen avulla varmistetaan, että ajankohtaiset tuotteet ovat helposti asiakkaiden näkyvillä ja saatavilla.

  • Monipuolisia asiakaspalvelutilanteita ja työtehtäviä Puuilon myyjien työtehtävät ovat hyvin monipuolisia sisältäen muun muassa verkkokauppakeräilyä, maton ja metritavaran leikkaamista, kaasujen vaihtoa sekä tuotteisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä auttamista.

  • Siivousta Puuilossa myymälähenkilökunta huolehtii oman myymälänsä siisteydestä. Kerran viikossa on siivouspäivä, minkä lisäksi henkilökunta huolehtii päivittäin yleissiisteydestä asiakas- ja henkilökunnan tilojen osalta.

Puuilossa piisaa vauhtia ja radiopuhelimen rätinää, jotka ovat suuri osa Puuilon kulttuuria. Haluat tehdä kaikkia myyjän työtehtäviä ja nautit siitä, että työsi on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Olet valmis hyppäämään välillä trukin puikkoihin nostaaksesi asiakkaalle tupauunin auton kyytiin tai ajamaan siivouskoneella myymälässä.

Mitä Puuilo tarjoaa Sinulle?

  • Vakituisen työsuhteen ja osa-aikaisen työsuhteen (20h/vko)

  • Iloisen ja osallistavan työympäristön

  • Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työnkuvan

  • Laadukkaat työvaatteet ja Sievin turvakengät skannatuilla pohjallisilla

  • Henkilöstöedut (ePassi ja henkilöstöetujärjestelmä)

  • Palkkaus TES:n taulukkopalkkaluokka B:n mukaan, jolloin palkka sijoittuu välille 11,16€/h-15,64€/h. Palkan määräytymiseen vaikuttavat aikaisempi työkokemus ja koulutus. Lisäksi maksetaan TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja viikonloppulisät.

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen

” Minulla oli aivan ihanat perehdyttäjät ja ylipäätään koko työtiimi loistava, sain kaiken tarvittavan neuvon ja avun.” – Myyjä, kesätöissä 2025 Puuilossa

  • Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet

”Etenin myyjän tehtävistä apulaismyymäläpäällikön tehtävien kautta myymäläpäällikön tehtäviin” – Myymäläpäällikkö, töissä Puuilossa 6 vuotta

Mitä toivomme Sinulta?

  • Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

  • Paineensietokykyä, sillä työ on ajoittain hektistä

  • Kohtuullista tai hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työ on hyvin fyysistä ja askeleita tulee työpäivän aikana runsaasti, jopa 15 000 askelta

  • Kiinnostusta Puuilon tuotteita kohtaan, saatat itsekin nikkaroida silloin tällöin

  • Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja kykenet toimimaan erilaisissa tilanteissa

  • Kaupan alan kokemus katsotaan eduksi, muttei ole pakollista.

  • Mahdollisuutta työskennellä aikavälillä 6-20 arkisin sekä viikonloppuisin

Tuemme tavoitetta savuttomasta Suomesta 2030, emmekä käytä työaikana mitään tupakkatuotteita.

Olisitko Sinä Seinäjoen Puuilon uusi työkaveri?

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten oheisesta linkistä. Myy itsesi meille

  • Vapaamuotoisella hakemuksella

  • CV:llä

  • Vapaaehtoisella videoesittelyllä

Hae viimeistään sunnuntaihin 11.10.2026 mennessä. Seinäjoen myymäläpäällikkö Marika Partala puh 040 1530 512 kertoo tarvittaessa lisää meistä, avoimesta tehtävästä ja myymälästään arkisin klo 9-15.

title: Teamledare till kund i Gnosjöregionen
description:
*

Är du en trygg och ansvarstagande person som trivs med att arbeta nära produktionen och samtidigt leda andra? Vi söker nu en Teamledare till en växande kund inom teknisk tillverkningsindustri i Gnosjöregionen.

Om tjänsten

Som Teamledare har du en viktig roll i den dagliga produktionen och arbetar nära teamet för att skapa struktur, engagemang och ett bra arbetsflöde. Du ser till att rätt personer är på rätt plats, följer upp produktionen och fångar upp sådant som behöver hanteras i vardagen. Tjänsten är en inhyrning via Montico med start omgående och arbetstid på dagtid. För rätt person finns möjlighet till fortsatt anställning hos kunden.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Du kommer bland annat att: *Planera och prioritera det dagliga arbetet tillsammans med teamet. *Samordna bemanning och arbetsrotation för att skapa ett bra produktionsflöde. *Leda teammöten och se till att viktig information når ut till medarbetarna. *Följa upp produktion, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö och agera när något behöver justeras. *Vara med och driva förbättringar inom exempelvis 5S, Lean och arbetssätt. *Vara ett stöd för medarbetarna i det dagliga arbetet och bidra till en positiv teamkänsla. *Följa upp tid och produktion samt hålla ansvarig chef uppdaterad kring läget i teamet.

Vi söker dig som

Vi söker dig som är trygg, ansvarstagande och strukturerad och som trivs med att arbeta nära produktionen. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra, är tydlig i din kommunikation och tycker om att ta ansvar för att arbetet flyter på. Du behöver inte ha haft en formell ledarroll tidigare, men du känner dig bekväm med att samordna andra och bidra till en bra teamkänsla. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från tillverkande industri, exempelvis som montör, och har förståelse för produktionsflöden, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av förbättringsarbete som 5S eller Lean är det meriterande. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du: *Har erfarenhet av arbete inom tillverkande industri. *Har erfarenhet av att leda, samordna eller fördela arbete *Har god systemvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya arbetssätt. *Är lösningsorienterad och tycker om att driva förbättringar. *Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift samt har grundläggande kunskaper i engelska. Erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365/D365 eller produktionsrapporteringssystem är meriterande. Låter det här som nästa steg för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Säljare HemmaPartner - Uppsala!
description:
Vill du tjäna bra pengar och ha ett roligt jobb där ingen dag är den andra lik? Då är det här jobbet för dig!

💡 Hos oss får du:

Vi ger dig en komplett säljutbildning direkt från start, så du behöver ingen tidigare erfarenhet av varken försäljning eller produkten. Våra erfarna chefer, med lång bakgrund inom försäljning och ledarskap, ger dig alla verktyg du behöver för att lyckas.

Garantibonus + provision utan tak – här finns ingen gräns för din intjäning! (Snittlön 35 000 kr/mån).

Möjlighet att växa internt – alla börjar som säljare och kan via internrekrytering bli teamleader eller ta nästa steg i karriären.

Ett fantastiskt team och arbetsmiljö.

Möjlighet till tjänstebil.

💼 Din roll:

Som säljare hos oss träffar du kunder i deras hemmamiljö och erbjuder tjänster utifrån deras behov. Här har du verkligen produkten vid din sida och får arbeta med tjänster som är väldigt eftertraktade på marknaden!

Tjänsterna vi arbetar med är främst inom ventilation, som rengöring av ventilationskanaler och service som ger hemmet ett hälsosamt inomhusklimat. Efter avslutad försäljning skickas en av våra ventilationstekniker ut för att utföra arbetet.

Du kommer arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med ditt team, där ni gemensamt driver resultat och skapar långsiktiga relationer.

👉 Arbetstider: Måndag–fredag 12:00–21:00 (inga tidiga morgnar!)

👉 Inga tidigare erfarenheter krävs: Vi utbildar dig direkt från start.

Haemme yksikköömme säännöllisesti uusia, ammatistaan innostuneita ja ammattilaisuuttaan jatkuvasti kehittämään pyrkiviä osaajia, joille tarjoamme kansainvälisen yrityksen koulutus- ja urapolkumahdollisuudet. Meillä voi kouluttautua vaikkapa insinööriksi omassa korkeakouluohjelmassamme!



Haemme nyt projektitiimiimme, kansainväliseen datakeskusympäristöön Haminaan kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista LVI-projektipäällikköä. Tehtävä on kokopäiväinen, vakituinen ja vaatii päivittäisen läsnäolon kohteessa.
ISS Capital Projects-yksikkö on osa liikevaihdoltaan mitattuna yhtä suurinta liiketoimintayksikköämme, teollisuus ja tekniset palvelut, ja tuottaa asiantuntijapalveluita asiakkaidensa kriittisten toimintaympäristön kehittämiseen. Palvelun laadun varmistaa yrityksemme vahva osaaminen, joka kattaa kiinteistön koko elinkaaren. Organisaatiomme sisäinen yhteistyö mahdollistaa asiakkaallemme toimitilajohtamisen kokonaispalveluratkaisut joustavasti toteutettuna.
Tässä roolissa johdat mielenkiintoisia ja monipuolisia rakennusprojekteja erityisessä ja kriittisessä ympäristössä. Sinulla on kokonaisvastuu projektin onnistumisesta. Johdat projektejasi ammattimaisesti tiiviissä yhteistyössä monien kansainvälisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja toimit kohteemme projektitiimin LVI-osaamisen erikoisasiantuntijana. Projektipäällikkönä sitoudut tarjoamaan korkealaatuisia projekteja suunnittelusta toteutukseen vastuullisella asenteella. Sinulla on mahdollisuus tuoda esiin visioitasi ja ideoitasi sekä olla mukana kehittämässä toimintaamme paikan päällä.
Onnistuaksesi tässä tehtävässä tulee sinulla olla aiempaa työkokemusta projektinjohdosta sekä tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutustausta (insinööri tai DI). Sinulla tulee olla vahva LVI-puolen kokemus ja osaaminen. Olet osoittanut kykysi saattaa projektit alusta loppuun määritellyn laajuuden, budjetin ja aikataulun mukaisesti. Olet työskentelytyyliltäsi dynaaminen, joustava ja tulosorientoitunut, ja pystyt käsittelemään nopeasti muuttuvia ja haastavia tilanteita. Työskentelyotteesi on aikaansaava, ennakoiva ja järjestelmällinen. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja mukava työkaveri. Kommunikoit ja viestit sekä kansainvälisten että kotimaisten sidosryhmien kanssa luontevasti, tehokkaasti ja selkeästi englannin ja suomen kielellä. Käytät tehokkaasti työssäsi Google Workspace-työkaluja.
Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisia ja mielenkiintoisia projekteja tässä erityisessä ja kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, osana erinomaista, osaavaa ja mukavaa tiimiä. Työskentelet yhdessä tiimin kanssa laadukkaan palveluorganisaation sopimuksen mukaisesti, joka on tiiviisti integroitu asiakkaan päivittäiseen toimintaan ja mukautuu jatkuvasti ja asiakaslähtöisesti sen tarpeisiin ja vaatimuksiin.
