title: Finance Officer
description:
Location: Aylesford / Hybrid

Salary/package: £27,642 - £33,098 per annum (pro rata)

Contract type: Up to 18 month fixed term contract (maternity cover)

Hours: Full time, 37 hours per week

Do you have experience working in school finance and want to be part of a team that makes a real difference to schools across Kent?

As a Finance Officer, you'll join a supportive and well-established team, using your existing school finance experience to support a range of financial activities for our education customers. You'll work closely with colleagues and schools, helping to ensure financial processes run smoothly while continuing to develop your expertise.

Due to the nature of work being carried out a full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle is essential for this role.

Who we are

The Education People, part of Commercial Services Group, have been supporting people to deliver the things that matter to the lives of children for many years and can proudly say that each of our education services is brought to you by experts in their field.

Our expertise ranges from safeguarding to equality & inclusion, from financial management to professional development alongside a whole range of other areas. Wherever it’s possible to provide education support services, we are committed to doing just that - whether it’s expert training, online education events or downloadable resources.

Why this role matters

The Finance Officer supports schools and academies with day‑to‑day financial tasks, helping with financial planning, monitoring and compliance activities. The role involves working closely with schools to provide practical support and reliable financial services, contributing to their overall financial stability. This support helps schools focus on delivering quality education.

What you’ll be doing

  • Provide on-site support to schools by assisting with processing, budget preparation, monthly monitoring and year end account closure, with guidance and support from the wider team.

  • Escalate any contracts to the Senior Contracts Officers regarding all financial issues in schools and academies.

  • Assist schools and academies with the day-to-day use of their financial and management accounting systems. This will include helping to gather information and support the preparation of statutory and ad hoc financial returns, as well as assisting with basic checks and submissions under the supervision of more experienced team.

  • Work on the helpdesk to provide remote support to schools and academies.

  • Support the delivery of all business requirements of Schools Financial Services.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in schools finance role. (essential)

  • Knowledge of finance systems and accounting software.

  • Ability to work alone and as part of a team.

  • Strong customer relationship skills.

  • Research, analytical and interpretive skills.

  • Full UK Driving Licence and access to your own vehicle.

What you’ll get in return

  • Salary of £27,642 - £33,098 per annum (pro rata for duration of contract)

  • 25 days annual leave, rising to 27 after four years (pro rata for duration of contract)

  • One concessionary day during the Christmas period

  • Pension scheme with 4% employer contribution

  • Life assurance cover

  • Hybrid working

Why CSG?

CSG is the UK’s largest local authority-owned trading company (LATCO), generating over £800 million in revenue per annum and supporting more than 16,000 education and public sector customers globally.

We are growing through a combination of organic development, acquisitions and strategic partnerships. Our businesses deliver services across education, IT, HR, legal, energy, procurement and more, all focused on delivering meaningful impact.

As a locally owned organisation, we take pride in reinvesting a significant proportion of our profits into frontline services, helping strengthen the communities we serve.

Inclusion & Accessibility

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from suitably qualified people of all backgrounds.

As a member of Inclusive Employers and a Working Families Employer, we are actively building an environment that supports inclusion, flexibility and belonging for all colleagues.

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout our application and interview process; please let us know if you require any.

title: Director of Operations | Rhode Island
description:
About the Organization

Our client is a behavioral health treatment organization serving individuals navigating substance use disorders, mental health conditions, and related behavioral health needs.

The organization believes strong treatment programs depend on engaged operational leadership, responsive teams, accountability, and an environment where patients and employees feel supported.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead the day-to-day operations of a behavioral health treatment facility in Providence, Rhode Island.

This is a highly involved facility leadership position for someone who understands the operational realities of behavioral healthcare and is comfortable stepping into different areas of the program as needs arise.

The Director of Operations will have direct responsibility for several functions central to the patient experience and facility performance, including intakes, staffing and scheduling, utilization review coordination, admissions, discharges, and AMA situations.

This is not a behind-the-desk management role. This leader will be expected to maintain a strong understanding of what is happening throughout the facility, identify problems early, support the team, and step in when necessary to keep operations moving.

Who Thrives Here

The strongest fit is someone who genuinely cares about recovery and behavioral healthcare and brings energy, accountability, and a willingness to work alongside the team.

You understand that strong facility operations require attention to both people and performance. You can hold employees accountable while maintaining a positive culture, communicate effectively across admissions and clinical teams, and recognize operational problems before they become larger issues.

Whether the need involves an intake, staffing challenge, utilization review issue, difficult discharge, referral relationship, or patient experience concern, you are comfortable getting involved and helping find a solution.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the day-to-day operational functions of the facility
  • Conduct the majority of patient intakes
  • Maintain direct responsibility for facility staffing and scheduling
  • Manage and coordinate utilization review activities
  • Maintain operational oversight of admissions, discharges, and AMA situations
  • Communicate closely with admissions, clinical, and operational team members
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with referral sources and facility partners
  • Identify operational problems early and implement practical solutions
  • Step into different areas of facility operations when additional support is needed
  • Hold staff accountable while contributing to a positive workplace culture
  • Support census, patient retention, and the overall patient experience
  • Partner with organizational leadership on facility performance and improvement initiatives


Requirements

Required:

  • Direct professional experience within substance use disorder and/or mental health treatment
  • Operational or leadership experience within a behavioral health treatment environment
  • Working knowledge of behavioral health facility operations and relevant levels of care
  • Experience with core operational functions such as patient intake, admissions, utilization review, staffing, scheduling, discharges, census management, or patient retention
  • Ability and willingness to maintain an active, visible presence in day-to-day facility operations
  • Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively across admissions, clinical, and operational teams
  • Commitment to behavioral healthcare, recovery, and a strong patient experience

Preferred:

  • Previous Director of Operations, Executive Director, Program Director, or comparable behavioral health leadership experience
  • Experience coordinating utilization review and insurance authorization processes
  • Experience managing admissions, discharges, and AMA situations
  • Experience managing behavioral health staffing and scheduling
  • Experience supporting census growth and patient retention

Benefits

Compensation and Schedule

  • Salary: $90,000–$100,000 annually, commensurate with directly relevant experience
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–4:30 PM
  • Location: Providence, Rhode Island
  • Travel: None required

Additional Benefits

  • Employer contribution of toward health insurance premium
  • Performance incentive opportunities available after 90 days
  • Hands-on leadership role with meaningful ownership of facility operations
  • Opportunity to work closely with organizational leadership
  • Opportunity for continued professional growth

This confidential opportunity is posted by Atlantic Health Strategies on behalf of a behavioral health treatment organization.

title: Määräaikainen varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomi
description:
Määräaikainen varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin tehtävä lapsiryhmässä tiimin jäsenenä.

Haemme sensitiivistä, vahvasti pedagogiikkaan suuntautunutta, innostuvaa sosionomia positiiviseen, iloiseen työyhteisöömme ajalle 12.10.2026 - 31.5.2027.
Tehtävän ensisijainen sijoituspaikka on Kalevanniemen Aurinkometsän päiväkodin vuorohoitoryhmä.

Päiväkotimme työtapa on yhteisöllisyyttä ja inklusiivisuutta korostava. Lasten yksilöllinen ymmärtäminen perheiden lähtökohtia kunnioittaen on vahva arvomme.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomi toimii kasvatusvastuullisena kasvattajana lapsiryhmässä. Sosionomi osallistuu lapsiryhmänsä toiminnan suunnitteluun, toteutukseen, arviointiin ja kehittämiseen varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman mukaisesti yhdessä muun ryhmän henkilöstön kanssa. Sosionomi toimii asiantuntijana perheiden kanssa tehtävässä yhteistyössä lapsen ja perheen hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi.

Toivomme sinulta itseohjautuvaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä positiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä asennetta. Arvostamme haluasi työskennellä yhteisöllisesti, vuorovaikutteisesti ja rakentavasti, yhdessä uusia asioita kokeillen.

Tarjoamme innostavan työyhteisön sekä hyvän ammatillisen tuen. Naantalin kaupunki tarjoaa muun muassa Edenred liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä oman palkitsemisohjelman.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 mukainen varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin pätevyys. Huomioimme haussa myös sosionomiksi valmistuvat sekä kelpoisten hakijoiden puuttuessa huomioimme myös ei-kelpoiset hakijat.

Sosionomin tehtävään kuuluva KVTES:n mukainen tasopalkka vuorohoidossa on 3 044,49 € kuukaudessa, sekä mahdollinen työkokemuslisä aiemman palveluajan mukaan. Lisäksi käytössämme on henkilökohtainen lisä, joka määräytyy ammatinhallinnan ja työssä suoriutumisen perusteella.

Valitun henkilön tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikostaustaote lasten kanssa toimimiseen (504/2002).
Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (3) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tervetuloa iloiseen ja ammattitaitoiseen joukkoomme!

title: Senior Software Engineer Id87667

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

Strong judgment around security, reliability, and auditability matters for enterprise customers.

  • Develop reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, context management, memory, and multi-agent collaboration.
  • Use agentic coding tools throughout the development lifecycle, including planning, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation.
  • Integrate agents into software development, testing, deployment, support, and operational workflows.
  • Establish standards for agent evaluation, observability, reliability, security, and governance.
  • Prototype new agentic capabilities and turn successful experiments into production systems.
  • Build complete, usable products—not just demonstrations or isolated model integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and product delivery through agentic development.
  • Mentor engineers and help shape an agentic-first technical strategy across the organization.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering leaders to connect agentic capabilities to meaningful outcomes.
  • Design agentic applications around real user needs, including intuitive experiences, reliable workflows, permissions, audit trails, and meaningful error handling.
  • Move agentic solutions from prototype to production by addressing performance, scalability, security, monitoring, evaluation, cost, and ongoing maintenance.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience in a software product development environment
  • Strong proficiency with Java and Spring Boot
  • Strong proficiency with Relational Databases
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents, tool-using LLM applications, or orchestrated workflows

  • Experience with TypeScript
  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with RESTful APIs

  • Strong understanding of testing, observability, security, permissions, and failure recovery.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into practical, reliable technical solutions.
  • A product mindset: the ability to understand a problem deeply, make appropriate tradeoffs, and deliver a complete solution that customers can depend on.

NICE TO HAVES

PERKS AND BENEFITS

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Eestinkallion esiopetus
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa vakinaiseen tehtävään Eestinkallion esiopetukseen. Eestinkallion esiopetus toimii Eestinkallion koulun tiloissa, jossa meillä on 2 esiopetusryhmää, Tammet ja Vaahterat. Nyt haemme toista opettajaa Vaahteroiden esiopetusryhmään. Ryhmässä työskentelee kanssasi varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja ja lastenhoitaja. Ryhmät tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä keskenään, joten saat myös tukea toisen ryhmän opettajalta ja lastenhoitajalta.

Olemme pedagogisesti vahva yksikkö ja henkilökuntaamme yhdistää vahva ammattitaito ja ymmärrys esiopetuksen ja varhaiskasvatustyön merkityksellisyydestä.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana vastaat ryhmän pedagogiikan suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta ja arvioinnista yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Toimit lisäksi tiimisi tiimivetäjänä toisen opettajan kanssa. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myös yhteistyö perheiden kanssa. Meillä saat vaikuttaa omien työpäiviesi sisältöön ideoimalla yhdessä lasten ja tiimin kanssa.

Arjen työssä sinua tukevat esiopetusyksikön johtaja ja apulaisjohtaja. Meillä on selkeät palaverirakenteet ja käymme paikan päällä viikottain. Esihenkilösi on aina valmiina auttamaan ja tukemaan. Myös laaja-alainen varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja ja kieli- ja kulttuuriopettaja on aktiivisesti mukana esiopetuksen arjessa.

Eestinkallion koulu sijaitsee keskeisellä alueella hyvien julkisten yhteyksien päässä ja teemme viikottain retkiä luontoon. Käymme myös säännöllisesti liikkumassa lasten kanssa hype-areenalla ja retkillä kulttuurikohteissa. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä koulun kanssa ja käytössämme on koulun liikuntasali, kirjasto ja ruokailemme koulun ruokalassa. Osallistumme myös koulun tapahtumiin ja koululaiset käyvät esimerkiksi lukemassa eskarilaisille kirjoja yhteisillä tunneilla.

Tarjoamme sinulle mentorointiohjelmamme tuen aloittaessasi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan työt. Mentorointiryhmän tuella espoolainen varhaiskasvatus tulee sinulle tutuksi ja opit tunnistamaan omat vahvuutesi ja osaamisesi. Samalla saat aineksia omaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja työhyvinvointiin. Pääset keskustelemaan kokeneen mentorin kanssa uran alkuvaiheeseen liittyvistä iloista ja haasteista, ja tutustut myös muihin varhaiskasvatuksen opettajina aloitteleviin kollegoihin.

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Eestinkallion esiopetus, Viittakorpi 7, 02280 Espoo
Työaika: 38 h 15 min/viikko
Tehtävä on vakinainen 9.11.2026 alkaen.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Teemme valinnan heti kelpoisen, tehtävään soveltuvan henkilön löydyttyä. Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian!

Vähintään kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto, johon sisältyy varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan koulutus, tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (varhaiskasvatus) tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005).

Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

title: Signal Integrity Test Engineer
description:
The Signal Integrity Test Engineer is responsible for working in collaboration with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to own the development, deployment, and sustaining support of high-speed signal integrity test systems for cable assemblies and interconnect products — with particular emphasis on bit-error-rate performance and PRBS-based stress testing.


Responsibilities:


  • Define robust production test methods, limits, calibration requirements, correlation plans, and acceptance criteria for VNA, TDR, BERT, and oscilloscope-based measurements.
  • Perform empirical signal integrity evaluations of cables, connectors, and interconnect assemblies, correlating production measurements with customer data and reference equipment to ensure repeatable and defensible test outcomes.
  • Design and qualify high-volume BERT solutions, including pattern-generator and error-detector configurations, channel mapping, loopback methods, fixtures, adapters, equalization settings, test sequences, dwell time, guard bands, and pass/fail criteria.
  • Establish methods for BER floors, error-count limits, and confidence-based zero-error testing without compromising defect detection.
  • Provide expert troubleshooting for electrical and signal-integrity issues, diagnosing pattern-lock failures, loss of signal, lane-specific errors, jitter sensitivity, crosstalk, insertion-loss impacts, fixture degradation, and correlation gaps between test platforms.
  • Establish preventive maintenance, calibration, verification, and spare-parts programs for SI test assets; anticipate obsolescence and capacity needs and provide technical inputs for capital planning.
  • Collaborate with Process Engineering and Quality to improve FPY, RTY, scrap, retest rate, downtime, and test escape performance, analyzing BER by lane, data rate, pattern, fixture, and tester to optimize screening limits.
  • Create and maintain test specifications, work instructions, validation reports, correlation studies, equipment standards, and change-control records; train technicians and engineers on standardized test practices.
  • Support new product introductions, pilot builds, equipment installations, process validations, customer investigations, and global manufacturing-site deployments.
  • Prepare status reports and present test performance updates to leadership.


Experience:


  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience developing, validating, or sustaining high-speed signal integrity test solutions for cable assemblies, connectors, backplanes, or related interconnect products. MUST
  • Strong knowledge of signal integrity principles, including insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, impedance, skew, eye diagrams, jitter, equalization, and bit-error-rate performance.
  • Hands-on experience with BERT systems, pattern generators, error detectors, loopback configurations, and high-speed fixtures; must understand PRBS patterns, pattern lock, BER calculation, zero-error confidence testing, and interpretation of random, burst, and lane-specific errors.
  • Experience with BERT platforms such as Keysight, Anritsu, Tektronix, or equivalent is preferred; familiarity with PAM4 and NRZ signaling, bathtub curves, eye-mask testing, and test-automation scripting is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of high-volume cable assembly manufacturing and quality tools such as MSA, GR&R, SPC, FMEA, 8D, and Pareto analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite; equipment-control software, databases, Power BI, and MES are a plus.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on yield improvement and test escape prevention.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English and excellent communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Availability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.


If you meet the requirements and are ready for the challenge, we invite you to apply!


We look forward to meeting you soon and having you join our team to achieve new goals together!

title: Senior Executive IT Support
description:
Western Digital is seeking a highly experienced Senior Executive IT Support professional to deliver white-glove, highly responsive technology support to C-Suite executives and senior leadership based in Singapore.

This is a high-visibility, relationship-driven role that demands exceptional technical depth, executive presence, sound judgment, and an unwavering commitment to discretion and service excellence. As the primary IT point of contact for assigned C-Suite executives, you will serve not only as a hands-on technical resource but as a trusted technology advisor — anticipating needs, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring executives can operate at their highest level without technology friction.

This role is fundamentally built on trust. Technical skill alone is not sufficient. The ability to earn, maintain, and never compromise the trust and confidence of C-Suite executives is the single most critical success factor in this position. Candidates who cannot consistently demonstrate this quality will not succeed in this role, regardless of their technical credentials.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Executive Technology Support

  • Provide dedicated, white-glove IT support to C-Suite executives, resolving technology issues quickly, professionally, and with minimal disruption to their day
  • Serve as the primary IT point of contact and trusted technology advisor for assigned executives — a person they can rely on completely, every time
  • Establish and maintain strong executive relationships built on reliability, discretion, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through — without exception
  • Proactively identify technology risks, issues, and opportunities and recommend solutions that enhance executive productivity and user experience
  • Conduct yourself at all times with the professionalism, polish, and judgment expected at the C-Suite level — in person, in writing, and in every interaction

Device, Application & Collaboration Support

  • Support executive laptops, desktops, mobile devices, applications, peripherals, conferencing systems, AV equipment, and collaboration technologies
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Windows and macOS environments, including advanced configuration and recovery scenarios
  • Support and administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Webex, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, and SCCM
  • Provide both hands-on and remote support across corporate offices, executive home offices, and remote locations — including sites with limited or no dedicated on-site IT staff

Event & Meeting Support

  • Provide on-site IT and AV support for executive meetings, presentations, Board of Directors meetings, town halls, and other high-profile business events
  • Ensure technology reliability for high-stakes events with zero tolerance for failure — coordinating preparation, rehearsals, and real-time troubleshooting as needed
  • Collaborate with Communications, Facilities, Security, and external AV partners to deliver seamless event experiences

Infrastructure & Data Center Support

  • Provide hands-on technical support within data center environments, including hardware troubleshooting, equipment replacement, and coordination with infrastructure teams
  • Coordinate with internal IT teams and external vendors for escalations requiring specialized expertise

Security, Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain strong security practices and protect confidential executive, business, and corporate information at all times — treating all executive information with the highest level of care and confidentiality
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation of executive environments, support activities, and recurring issues
  • Operate in alignment with ITIL processes and team support frameworks, including escalation and RACI models

Availability & Travel

  • Maintain flexibility to provide early morning, evening, weekend, and global support coverage as business needs require
  • Travel between Singapore locations and internationally to support executives and critical business operations

PROBATIONARY PERIOD

This position includes a formal initial probationary period that is taken seriously and evaluated rigorously. Given the nature of this role — direct, daily access to C-Suite executives and exposure to sensitive business information — the probationary period exists to ensure the right person is placed in one of IT's most trust-sensitive positions.

The following dimensions will be formally assessed during the probationary period:

  • Technical Capability: Demonstrated ability to independently resolve executive technology issues accurately and efficiently
  • Executive Trust & Confidence: Evidence that assigned executives trust you, rely on you, and feel well-served by your support
  • Professionalism & Presence: Consistent conduct, communication, and appearance aligned to C-Suite expectations
  • Discretion & Judgment: Zero incidents involving inappropriate handling of confidential or sensitive information
  • Responsiveness: Executives receive timely, reliable responses — every time, without exception
  • Proactivity: Issues are identified and addressed before they impact executive productivity
  • Team Integration: Effective collaboration with global IT team members, vendors, and cross-functional partners

The executives you support are among the most senior leaders in the company. They operate in a high-pressure, high-stakes environment and have no tolerance for technology that fails them, support that is unreliable, or individuals who cannot be fully trusted. Once trust is lost with an executive, it is extremely difficult — and sometimes impossible — to recover.

Successful completion of the probationary period requires consistent performance across all dimensions above — not just technical proficiency. Candidates who demonstrate strong technical skills but fail to establish executive trust, maintain discretion, or meet the professional standards of this role will not successfully complete probation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in Executive IT Support, VIP Support, Desktop Engineering, Field IT, or a related enterprise IT role
  • Proven, direct experience supporting C-Suite executives, senior leadership, or other VIP users in a professional corporate environment
  • Exceptional customer-service orientation with a demonstrated ability to earn and sustain the trust and confidence of executive stakeholders — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement of this role
  • Advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and recovery skills across Windows and macOS platforms
  • Strong working knowledge of PC and Mac hardware, mobile devices, peripherals, and collaboration technologies
  • Demonstrated experience delivering both hands-on and remote support across multiple locations simultaneously
  • Experience supporting locations with limited or no dedicated on-site IT resources, operating with full autonomy and accountability
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of networking concepts and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with JAMF, Microsoft Intune, and SCCM for device management and provisioning
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Webex, AV systems, and executive conferencing environments
  • Experience or exposure to data center hardware, infrastructure, or hands-on technical support
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills — ability to translate complex technical issues into clear, concise language for non-technical executives
  • Exceptional discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential and sensitive executive, business, and corporate information
  • Polished, professional presence with the composure and effectiveness to perform in high-pressure, high-stakes situations
  • Highly responsive, proactive, organized, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required
  • Flexibility to support executives outside normal business hours when the business requires

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting executives within a high-tech, global, or multinational organization
  • Experience supporting VIP users across multiple locations, sites, and time zones
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Experience collaborating with data center, networking, infrastructure, security, or systems engineering teams
  • One or more relevant technical certifications:
    • CompTIA A+
    • Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator or equivalent
    • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP)
    • ITIL Foundation

Benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: RF Test Technician IV
description:
Job Summary:

The RF Test Technician will conduct RF measurements and mechanical assembly of semiconductor components such as amplifiers, switches, filters, mixers, multi-chip modules, and RF Modules that operate from DC to 40GHz +. The Technician will complete problem solving which will require an understanding of electronic standards and concepts and the ability to comprehend basic block diagrams, schematics, and device layouts. In addition, the Technician may be asked to prepare test reports and data in accordance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) and may help write Acceptance Testing Procedures.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Test, troubleshoot, and mechanically assemble RF components from 20MHz to 40GHz, including but not limited to, filters, mixers, switches, diplexers, multiplexers, filter-LNAs, amplifiers and RF modules
  • Perform RF/Microwave related tests utilizing laboratory equipment including network analyzers, signal analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes, function generators, high power amplifiers, noise meters, power meters, and multi-meters
  • Execute thermal and environmental tests, troubleshooting/problem solving, debugging moderate problems by using a variety of test equipment, including bus analyzers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers to ensure the highest quality of integrated and tested products
  • Setup test equipment for testing of production hardware independently
  • Work from schematics, work instructions, drawings and operating procedures
  • May assist engineers with new design and development activities including prototyping and first article units
  • Develop an understanding and familiarity of operation, and parametric behavior of RF components

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma
  • Typically requires 5+ years' experience in RF and Microwave component and/or module testing.
  • Deep comprehension of electronic circuits fundamentals, and RF measurement methods.
  • Thorough understanding of RF electrical measurements including but not limited to return loss, insertion loss, rejection, gain, noise figure, 1 dB compression, intermodulation, harmonics, spurious, etc.
  • Experience using lab test equipment including vector network analyzers, RF signal generators, spectrum analyzers, power meters, digital multi-meters, and basic electronic tools.
  • Experience in following test instructions and manufacturing procedures.
  • Experience working under a microscope including excellent hand-eye coordination.
  • Physical hand dexterity to perform all duties needed to complete the work (will require using small hand tools for prolonged periods).
  • Experience in Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in Electronics
  • Understand RF circuit concepts, such as filter topologies and impedance matching

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to:

Constantly move objects and use abdominal and lower back muscles to provide support over time without fatigue. Specific abilities required by the job include positioning oneself to lift or move objects weighing up to 40lbs.

Constant movement and use of limbs. Specific abilities required by this job include prolonged sitting, twisting and working under a microscope for long periods of time will be required. Occasional Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, climbing, and gripping is required daily.

Frequently observe, detect, discern, and convey information. Specific abilities required by this job include near, far and color vision acuity, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Requires good manual dexterity, coordination, and stamina. Ability to safely control surgical razor blades and small hand tools used to adjust RF gaskets under a microscope. Specific abilities required by this job include the frequent requirement of overtime work.

You may only access such information if you are a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. government."

The Data Center Security Risk & Assurance Senior Program Manager drives the maturity and execution of CoreWeave’s data center physical security controls compliance program. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Center Risk and Assurance, this role ensures that all Data Center Security designs, controls, and operational practices tied to the company’s audit and customer requirements across CoreWeave’s global data center footprint meet defined security standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational expectations. This role will also support new site selection, physical security due diligence, and initial risk evaluation for the EMEA region.

This Program Manager will own the Data Center Security-specific audit framework, oversee comprehensive risk and assurance audits within our operations sites, and partner closely with Security Design, Operations, Legal, and Engineering teams to validate adherence to CoreWeave and its partners’ security objectives. The role requires a strategic thinker with an understanding of physical and operational audit scope, an eye for control assurance, scalability, and strong cross-functional influence in a fast-growing, high-performance environment.

About the role:

  • Represent CoreWeave’s Data Center Security Operations team, ensuring all DC Security controls and processes align with internal standards, customer contractual requirements, and external regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, etc.).
  • Audit & Assessments: Plan and lead independent internal audits and control validations across CoreWeave’s data center network; deliver actionable findings and track remediation, ensuring timely treatment.
  • Operational Assurance: Partner with Data Center Operations, Security Design, Security Operations, and Technical Program Management teams to verify that physical security controls are implemented, maintained, and effective.
  • Site Selection Due Diligence: Conduct physical security due diligence for site selection, ensuring appropriate security requirements are included in Master Service Agreements and other lease contracts, collaborating with Site Selection and Legal teams.
  • Post Lease or Build Contract Execution: This role informs and collaborates with the Security Design and Security Operations teams to communicate site security requirements.
  • Metrics and Reporting: Ensure assessments and audit evidence are managed and reported in accordance with CoreWeave controls compliance mechanisms to track control health, audit outcomes, and risk trends.
  • Collaboration & Influence: Build strong relationships with internal partners, fostering a culture of accountability and proactive risk management throughout the data center lifecycle.
  • Emerging Risk Monitoring: Stay current with evolving threat landscapes, compliance standards, and industry best practices to ensure CoreWeave’s data center security programs remain resilient and forward-looking.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience in security risk management, compliance, or assurance functions, ideally within cloud, hyperscale, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Proven success leading risk audits and assurance programs in complex, high-growth organizations.
    Strong understanding of physical and logical security controls, risk frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, ISO22237, ISO22301, SOC 2, HITrust, FedRAMP), and data center operational security.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical security concepts into actionable business insights and governance structures.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Työnkuva

Hakemamme Yhteyspäällikön rooli sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy tulos- ja tavoite- sekä ihmisläheisessä työnkuvassa. Olet vastuussa omalta osaltasi myynnin rakentamisesta ja sen kasvattamisesta, uusien asiakkuuksien hankinnasta sekä olemassa olevien kehittämisestä

Tässä työssä et pärjää odottelemalla puhelinsoittoa vaan menestys vaatii oma-aloitteisuutta ja rohkeutta tarttua toimeen tapaamisten ja sitä kautta myynnin aikaansaamiseksi. Myyntityö tapahtuukin pääosin "kentällä" asiakkaiden luona, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on välttämätön ehto.

Pääpaino tässä tehtävässä on myynnissä, mutta myynnillisten tehtävien ohella sinun tulee pitää huolta jo olemassa olevista suhteista niin asiakkaisiin kuin työntekijöihinkin päin. Eli työnkuvaasi sisältyy myös henkilöstöhallinnollisia tehtäviä, kuten työsopimusten laatimista, ongelmatilanteiden selvittelyä ja työehtosopimusten syynäämistä.

Tarjoamme sinulle vapauden tehdä työtäsi ja joustavat työajat sekä etätyömahdollisuuden mutta toivomme, että viihdyt myös toimistolla, koska tätä työtä tehdään yhdessä muiden kanssa ja meillä toimistolla viihdytään ja työrauha on taattu.Lopullinen painotus toimenkuvan kaikkien vastuiden osalta on paljon kiinni tekijästä itsestään ja hänen tavastaan tehdä myyntiä ja hoitaa tätä kokonaisuutta kannattavasti.

Etsimämme henkilö

Etsimme lähtökohtaisesti jo henkilöstöpalvelualalta kokemusta kerryttäneitä henkilöitä, jotka tuntevat alan pelikentän ennestään ja omaavat vahvoja verkostoja. Odotamme hakijoilta erityisesti tiimityöskentelytaitoja, avointa asennetta, paksua nahkaa sekä periksiantamattomuutta sekä ymmärryksen B2B -kaupan lainalaisuuksista.

Etsimällämme henkilöllä on lisäksi tervettä kilpailuhenkisyyttä, kuitenkaan unohtamatta, että meillä kaikilla on yhteinen tavoite ja jokaisen onnistuminen on yhteinen onnistuminen.

Sinulta tulisi löytyä:

- Kokemusta tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä – suhtaudumme myyntiin kuin tulosurheiluun

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä – ratkaisemme jatkuvasti kimurantteja ongelmia

- Kykyä pitää monia lankoja käsissäsi – työssäsi hoidat useita asiakkuuksia ja työtehtäviä samanaikaisesti

- Sujuvat IT-taidot – työsi tapahtuu isolta osin CRM-järjestelmässä (Likeit)

Tarjoamme

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konserni on perustettu vuonna 2020 ja kehitystä on tapahtunut alusta asti huimalla vauhdilla. Tämä on sinun mahdollisuutesi päästä mukaan kokemaan ja rakentamaan hienoa kasvutarinaa, joka on jo hyvässä vauhdissa ja silti vasta aluillaan. Meillä et tule kuulemaan surullisen kuuluisaa fraasia: "koska niin on aina ennenkin tehty".

Toimitilamme sijaitsevat Tampereella Kalevassa, Turussa Hämeenkadulla ja Helsingissä Pitäjänmäessä. Saat oman työhuoneen ja kaikki tarvittavat työvälineet, jotta työskentelysi olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Jokaisella paikkakunnalla on useita osaavia ja mukavia kollegoita, joten yksin sinun ei tarvitse töitä tehdä.

Visio toimii usealla paikkakunnalla, joten yhteensä tulet saamaan noin 40 uutta työkaveria ympäri Suomen.

Palkkasi muodostuu pohjapalkasta sekä myyntiprovisiosta, jolle ei ole kattorajaa. Onnistumisten myötä myös vastuu, ansaintamahdollisuudet ja rooli yrityksessä voivat kasvaa merkittävästi. Esitäthän oman perustellun näkemyksesi sinulle sopivasta palkkauksesta hakemuksessasi, niin neuvotellaan vielä siitä, mitä tuot pöytään ja varmistetaan siihen nähden reilu ratkaisu.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Mikäli tähän asti lukiessa sinussa heräsi positiivisia tuntemuksia ja näkisit olevasi etsimämme tekijä, jätä meille ansioluettelosi sekä hakemuskirjeesi järjestelmämme kautta! Mitä pikemmin, sitä parempi, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Kerro meille, millaista tuloksellista myyntityötä olet aiemmin tehnyt ja mikä saa sinut syttymään myyntityössä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Yhteyspäällikkö" riku.rahikainen(at)visiohr.fi tai soittaa puh. 040 530 0426.

Arvostamme, jos olet yhteydessä vain asioissa, joissa voimme aidosti olla avuksi. Jätä siis esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen. Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

title: Johtava työfysioterapeutti
description:
Haluatko olla rakentamassa tulevaisuuden työterveyttä ja varmistamassa, että työfysioterapian osaaminen näkyy asiakkaidemme arjessa vaikuttavina ratkaisuina?

Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!


Mitä työ Johtavana työfysioterapeuttina pitää sisällään?

Etsimme nyt Johtavaa työfysioterapeuttia osaksi työterveyden valtakunnallista substanssiorganisaatiota. Tehtävässä varmistat, että työfysioterapeuttiammattilaisilla on käytössään laadukkaat, vaikuttavat ja yhdenmukaiset toimintamallit sekä osaaminen niiden hyödyntämiseen asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Johdat työfysioterapiapalveluiden sisällöllisen kehittämisen, vaikuttavuuden ja valtakunnallisen yhtenäisyyden kokonaisuutta. Vastaat siitä, että työfysioterapian palvelut, toimintamallit ja osaaminen tukevat asiakkaidemme työkykyä, hyvinvointia ja työssä onnistumista sekä työterveyden strategian toteutumista.

Toimit työfysioterapiaverkoston, työterveyden muun substanssiorganisaation, palvelutuotannon ja palvelukehityksen välisenä yhdistävänä voimana. Kehität yhteistyötä ja toimintatapoja, jotka yhdistävät työfysioterapeuttien asiantuntemuksen, asiakkaiden tarpeet ja liiketoiminnan tavoitteet.

Johtavana työfysioterapeuttina

- Vastaat työfysioterapiapalveluiden sisällöllisestä kehittämisestä, laadusta ja vaikuttavuudesta.
- Johdat työfysioterapian toimintamallien, palveluratkaisujen ja käytäntöjen kehittämistä sekä valtakunnallista käyttöönottoa.
- Varmistat, että työfysioterapian asiantuntemus huomioidaan palveluiden, asiakasratkaisujen ja toimintatapojen kehittämisessä.
- Kehität työfysioterapeuttien osaamista, työn sisältöjä ja ammatillisia käytäntöjä valtakunnallisesti.
- Toimit työfysioterapiaverkoston asiantuntijana ja yhteistyökumppanina sekä edistät osaamisen jakamista ja yhteisten toimintatapojen vahvistumista.
- Kokoat ja välität verkoston, asiakkaiden ja käyttäjien näkemyksiä palveluiden ja toimintamallien kehittämisen tueksi.
- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä palvelutuotannon, palvelukehityksen, muiden ammattiryhmien substanssijohtajien sekä työterveysverkoston kanssa.

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja toistaiseksi voimassa olevan tehtävän. Työskentelemme joustavalla hybridityömallilla. Tässä tehtävässä pääosa työstä onnistuu tarvittaessa etänä, mutta toivomme kuitenkin mahdollisuutta tavata sinua säännöllisesti myös Helsingin Kampin toimistollamme yhteistyön ja yhteisöllisyyden tukemiseksi.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suomalaisen työelämän ja työhyvinvoinnin tulevaisuuteen. Pääset työskentelemään työterveyden kehittämisen keskiössä yhdessä eri ammattiryhmien asiantuntijoiden kanssa ja saat näköalapaikan työterveyspalveluiden, asiakaskokemuksen ja työkyvyn tuen kehittämiseen. Työsi tueksi saat asiantuntevan ja sitoutuneen kollegaverkoston, joustavat työskentelymahdollisuudet ja modernit työvälineet. Tarjoamme lisäksi monipuoliset työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, kumppanialennuksia ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden ohella muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit sekä laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, kuten lyhytpsykoterapiaa.

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.


- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä.
- Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
- Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
- Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.
- Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta. Pohjoismaisten pörssiyritysten ylimmän johdon monimuotoisuutta tarkastelevan Nordic Business Diversity Index 2025 -tutkimusraportin mukaan Terveystalo on Suomen kolmanneksi monimuotoisin organisaatio keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Etsimme tehtävään henkilöä, jossa yhdistyvät vahva työterveyden ja työfysioterapiapalveluiden substanssiosaaminen, kehittämisote sekä kyky viedä muutoksia käytäntöön verkostomaisessa toimintaympäristössä. Innostut työfysioterapian palveluiden ja osaamisen kehittämisestä, yhdistät strategisen ajattelun käytännön toteutukseen ja haluat vaikuttaa työfysioterapian tulevaisuuteen valtakunnallisesti. Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian.

title: Supporttekniker IT
description:
Variation, utmaning och omväxling- En supportteknikers vardag vid Skövde Garnison. Hos oss får du möjlighet till utveckling och personlig stimans tillsammans med ett professionellt arbetslag.

Om enheten

FMTIS har fyra genomförandeenheter (GE) i Sverige som utför underhåll av Försvarsmaktens ledningssystem inom IT- och teleområdet, tjänsten är placerad vid GE Väst. Enheten arbetar med underhåll av Försvarsmaktens telenät, el/mek, radio-, sensor och bevakningssystem samt installation, drift och underhåll av en mängd olika IT-system. Avdelningen i Skövde består av tre sektioner, två tele-sektioner och en IT- sektion, totalt ca 30 anställda.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Som supporttekniker kommer du att ingå i en arbetsgrupp om ca 12 personer som svarar för IT-stödet i Skövde garnison. Arbetet består huvudsakligen av användarstöd och andra ärenden som inkommer via vårt ärendehanteringssystem, t.ex. beställnings- och incidentärenden. Uppgifterna består av driftsättning, felsökning och underhåll på IT-materiel och -system, inventering, att hantera återlämning och kassationer samt att redovisa pågående och avslutade arbeten i aktuella stödsystem. Arbetet utförs både enskilt och tillsammans med andra på plats i Skövde Garnison.

Typiska arbetsuppgifter

  • Installation och utställning av arbetsstationer
  • Konfiguration av nätverksskrivare och utställning av nätverksskrivare
  • Enklare felsökning

Vi erbjuder dig följande

I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Vi vill att våra medarbetare ska må bra, både på och utanför jobbet, därför har vi medarbetarnas framtid, hälsa och privatliv i omtanke och arbetar aktivt för att främja välmående och trygghet. Våra anställda har ett flertal olika förmåner, bland annat:

  • Kompetensutveckling utifrån verksamhetens behov och dina karriärsmål.
  • Tre timmar träning i veckan på arbetstid, på våra egna träningsanläggningar eller där vi har avtal.
  • Bra balans mellan arbete och fritid med flexibel arbetstid samt 28 - 35 semesterdagar beroende på din ålder.
  • Lönetillägg vid föräldraledighet och VAB.
  • Möjlighet att växla semesterdagar mot extra pensionsavsättning.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gymnasieutbildning med inriktning IT/data eller motsvarande kunskaper som av arbetsgivaren kan bedömas likvärdiga.
  • Erfarenhet av installation, underhåll, felsökning, optimering och konfigurering av hårdvara.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
  • B-körkort (manuell växellåda)

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och säkerhetsmedveten. Du tar gärna eget ansvar och ser till helheten såväl som detaljerna. Du skapar resultat, både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Dina sociala egenskaper är mycket goda då du kommer att träffa nya människor varje dag. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har gott omdöme med hög servicekänsla. Vidare är du lyhörd och delar gärna med dig av dina erfarenheter och kunskaper till dina kollegor. Vi lägger mycket stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Meriterande

  • Kunskap om och erfarenhet av Försvarsmaktens IT-system och- infrastruktur.

Övrigt

Civil tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning.

Arbetsort: Skövde

Tillträde: Snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.

I Försvarsmakten benämns befattningen Driftingenjör.

För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).

Upplysningar

Vill du veta mer om befattningen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Jani Into. För information om anställningsvillkor personalhandläggare Isabelle Wejdrup.

Samtliga nås via växeln på 019-393 500

Fackliga företrädare

SACO Agnetha Landquist

OFR/S Martin Sparr

SEKO-F Matz Felix

OFR/O Heikki Videll

Samtliga nås via växeln på 019-393 500

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-26. Din ansökan bör innehålla CV samt ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattning.

Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.

Information om Försvarsmakten och det rekryterande förbandet: Försvarsmaktens telekommunikations- och informationssystemförband, FMTIS, säkerställer Försvarsmaktens förmåga att kommunicera och leda - dygnet runt, året om. Förbandet har ett samlat ansvar för Försvarsmaktens tekniska ledningssystem som stödjer militära insatser till sjöss, på land och i luften – i Sverige och utomlands. Förbandet har närmare 2000 medarbetare på mer än 32 orter runt om i landet. Läs mer på https://jobb.forsvarsmakten.se/fmtis En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras samt att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Iekrāvēja vadītājs noliktavā
description:
Knauf - tā ir iespēja. Mēs zinām, ka iespēja katram cilvēkam šķiet savādāka, un esam lepni, ka ikvienā redzam iespēju. Šī aizraujošā loma noliktavas komandā varētu būt lieliska nākamā iespēja jums izveidot unikālu karjeru uz vērtībām balstītā kultūrā ar skaidru mērķi padarīt rītdienu par mūsu visu mājām.

Mēs esam pasaules mēroga būvmateriālu ražotājs. Mūsu 42 000 darbinieku 90 valstīs 300 vietās sniedz milzīgu iespēju ikvienam, kas ir ambiciozs un enerģisks. Mēs novērtējam ikviena ieguldījumu un lūdzam jūs iesaistīties darbā, lai turpinātu attīstīt biznesu, jo kopā mēs sasniedzam vairāk drošā un iekļaujošā vidē.

Mūs visus vada vienas un tās pašas pamatvērtības un ticam lielo uzņēmumu spēcīgajam potenciālam pozitīvi ietekmēt pasauli. Mēs šobrīd meklējam komandas darbinieku, kas mums pievienotos noliktavā kā iekrāvēja vadītājs.

Vai jūs varat atbildēt ar "Jā"?

  • Vai jūs izturaties ar cieņu pret kolēģiem?

  • Vai jūs vienmēr domājat par klientu?

  • Vai jūs rīkojaties, domājot par nākamajām paaudzēm?

  • Vai jums ir pierādāma pieredze rezultātu nodrošināšanā?

  • Vai jums patīk meklēt iespējas augt un attīstīties?

  • Vai jūs vēlaties piedalīties noliktavas procesu uzlabošanā?


Jūsu darba pienākumi:

Veikt preču pasūtījumu uzkraušanas darbus saskaņā ar kraušanas lapās uzrādīto informāciju.

Piedalīties preču pieņemšanas un to pozicionēšanas procesos noliktavā, izmantojot iekrāvēju.

Strādājot ar iekrāvēju, ievērot to ekspluatācijas, darba drošības noteikumus.

Piedalīties noliktavas procesu uzlabošanā, kā arī inventarizācijā.

Mēs vēlētos, lai jums būtu:

1. Auto iekrāvēja vadītāja pieredze un apliecība.

2. Valsts valodas zināšanas.

Mūs interesē jūsu personība - jūsu attieksme un vērtības. Ja vien jums ir vēlme apgūt visu, kas jums nepieciešams amatam, kas jums vēl nav, mēs labprāt ar jums sazinātos.


Ja jums ir pieredze šādās jomās, tad tā ir papildu priekšrocība:

Darba pieredze noliktavas darbinieka pozīcijā vismaz 1 gads.

Jūsu ieguvumi:

  • Darbs starptautiskā uzņēmumā ar spēcīgu un atpazīstamu zīmolu.

  • Mācību un attīstības iespējas.

  • Ērtu un sezonai pielāgotu darba apģērbu.

  • Ikmēneša atalgojums no 1590 līdz 1730 eiro bruto apmērā.

  • Veselības un dzīvības apdrošināšana (pēc pārbaudes laika).

  • Citus labbūtības bonusus (laulības reģistrācija, bērna piedzimšana, darba stāžs Knauf u.c.),

  • Piemaksa algas apmērā, sasniedzot komandas mērķus gada beigās.

title: Video Editor
description:
Dubai Media is looking for a creative Video Editor who knows how to turn raw footage into engaging stories that capture attention. From shaping the pace and visual style to adding the right effects, music, and sound, you’ll play an important role in bringing our content to life across television and digital platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit video content based on the creative direction of Producers and Directors.
  • Turn footage into engaging visual stories using professional editing techniques, effects, music, and sound.
  • Work closely with Producers, Directors, and creative teams to bring ideas from concept to final cut.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions while maintaining the creative vision and quality of the content.
  • Deliver high-quality edits within agreed timelines and production requirements.
  • Keep project files and workflows organized for smooth collaboration.
  • Explore new editing techniques, trends, and software to keep content fresh and impactful.
  • Contribute ideas that improve editing workflows and the overall quality of our content.
  • Follow relevant production, operational, health, and safety standards.

title: Freight Handler-CO0045
description:
Lockbourne, OH
10:00PM - Finish Sunday - Thursday
$700 - $9000 Weekly

People want to work at Capstone because of our high-performance culture. We build strong relationships, challenge the status quo, work hard to deliver results, and pay it forward in our communities. Through transparency and open lines of communication, we do the right thing and deliver on our promises. Think you have what it takes?

The Opportunity:

  • Warehouse Associates perform a variety of warehouse responsibilities including but not limited to loading, unloading, selecting, freight hauling, auditing, repacking, sorting, palletizing, clean up, housekeeping and other duties as assigned by site leadership.

Requirements:

  • High-energy individual with a strong work ethic, the work is fast paced and very physical
  • Lift and carry 25-75lbs, materials handled vary
  • Prior warehouse and/or equipment experience is preferred but we are willing to train the right candidate

Why you should work with us:

  • Get paid weekly

title: Software Engineer - Backend + AI
description:
Do you want to change the world? At Cabify, that's what we're doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we've still got a long way to go… fancy joining us?

Right now, we have more than 20 million users around the world. We work across 6 countries and 40 cities, adapting our product fast to be leaders in all those markets and taking care about sustainability.

The job

We are looking for Software Engineers (Backend) who are ready to embrace Agentic Development as part of how they build software. At Cabify, we use AI tools throughout the development lifecycle, to explore and understand systems, design solutions, implement and test them, and accelerate delivery, while engineers remain accountable for technical decisions, code quality, reliability, and production outcomes.

We're language agnostic - your team will primarily work with Go, Elixir or Ruby, but that doesn't mean your past experience needs to match. We rely on whatever tool fits the problem best, and you'll have the flexibility to draw on other languages and technologies across the stack when it makes sense. We believe that if you've worked in other languages like Java your whole career, you can still pick up Elixir or Go quickly, what matters most is being adaptable, curious, and quick to learn new tools, including AI-native ones.

Check our Public Tech Handbook >< to know a bit more about us!

At Technology you will

  • Collaborate with principal engineers on development planning and architecture design, including where AI-driven components fit into our systems
  • Design, build and maintain distributed, clean, testable, data-oriented applications, increasingly incorporating AI/LLM-powered services and features
  • Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow to move faster without compromising code quality
  • Improve service reliability, scalability and performance, including systems that integrate with LLM and AI model APIs.
  • Own your code all the way to production with a self-service continuous delivery pipeline and production infrastructure
  • Dive deep into host-level problem-solving and help improve detection methods
  • Play a vital role in nurturing our engineering culture, emphasizing quality through peer reviews, monitoring, on-call best practices, and responsible use of AI tooling
  • Mentor junior developers, including how to effectively pair with AI tools
  • Collaborate closely with the Data Science team on data

Our ideal candidate has

  • Great alignment with our principles (check out the handbook)
  • Solid knowledge of common algorithms & data structures
  • Experience developing medium/large-scale web applications and distributed systems in production
  • Experience with common design and architectural patterns
  • Comfortable with working with AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) as part of your daily process, with a strong ability to own the engineering decisions, validation, quality and production outcomes - bonus points if you’ve worked with agentic or RAG-based systems
  • Genuine curiosity about how AI is changing software engineering, and interest in experimenting with new tools and workflows
  • Ability to work independently while being a strong team player
  • Ability to understand and help make great product and business decisions
  • Ability to achieve results in a fast-paced, changing environment

What's it like to work at Cabify?

We're a company full of motivated people and we never want that to change. Here are some more reasons why it rocks to be part of our high-performance team.

  • 💶 Excellent Salary conditions: up to 72k
  • 🌍 Our office is located in Madrid (Calle de Pradillo 42, 28002) - this is a fully on-site role, based in our Madrid office
  • ⌚ Flexible work environment & hours

  • 📐 Coursera: your own license in Coursera to take as many courses as you wish and continue developing your skills

title: Deputy Director - Information Security Lead
description: Overview The Information Security Lead is a key member of the Business Information Security Office, serving as a trusted security advisor and change agent, enabling secure digital transformation across multiple enterprise business domains (e.g., Supply Chain & Operations, Consumer & Commercial, Finance, HR, Enterprise Platforms). This role partners closely with business, strategy & transformation leads, capability teams, IT, OT, and Cybersecurity stakeholders to embed security-by-design into large-scale transformation initiatives (e.g., AI adoption, automation, cloud, data platforms), while advancing BISO operating maturity, scalable security capabilities, and consistent risk outcomes. The role focuses on forward-looking initiatives, operating model evolution, and systematic risk reduction—complementing run-the-business BISO activities with a strong emphasis on transformation programs, pattern-based security solutions, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Transformation & Strategy Act as the security transformation lead for major business and technology transformation initiatives, ensuring security requirements are integrated early across strategy, planning, design, and execution phases. Partner with business and technology leaders to translate transformation objectives into actionable security strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. Shape and operationalize secure-by-design patterns for AI/ML, cloud, automation, data platforms, and domain-specific technologies. Drive alignment of transformation programs with enterprise security strategy, architecture standards, and risk appetite. Risk Management & Advisory Serve as a security coach and trusted advisor to global capability and transformation teams on risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk acceptance. Identify, assess, and report on systemic and transformational security gaps; develop prioritized remediation and maturity-improvement plans. Guide teams in adopting defense-in-depth controls and resilience principles within transformation delivery cycles. Advise leaders on emerging risks (e.g., AI risk, third-party risk, cloud concentration risk, data protection risk) relevant to the supported business domain. Operating Model & Enablement Advance the BISO operating model by developing repeatable processes, playbooks, metrics, and automation to scale security engagement across transformations. Create and deliver tailored security enablement content (briefings, playbooks, patterns, guardrails) for business, transformation, and engineering audiences. Identify and remove organizational friction, strengthening collaboration across Business, IT, Architecture, Risk, Privacy, and Cybersecurity teams. Support the adoption of Agile and product-centric delivery models while ensuring appropriate security governance. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Build strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and transformation leaders as a single point of security accountability for major initiatives. Influence decision-making by clearly articulating risk trade-offs in business terms, enabling informed and timely decisions. Present on Information Security programs, initiatives, incidents, threat trends, and risk posture as it relates to transformation. Incident Readiness & Learning Partner with incident management and recovery teams to support post-incident recovery and lessons learned, feeding insights back into transformation patterns and controls. Continuously deepen understanding of the business, technology, and threat landscape relevant to supported enterprise domains. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Advanced degree (Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science, or IT-related studies preferred). 6+ years of IT experience supporting enterprise business functions or platforms, with exposure to Supply Chain, ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, data/analytics, AI, automation, or domain-specific systems. 3+ years of Information Security experience (BISO, security architect, engineer, or risk leader experience strongly preferred). Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale digital or business transformations. Strong working knowledge of: NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST AI RMF CIS Critical Security Controls OWASP Top 10 and LLM/GenAI security risks Experience with Agile, product-centric delivery models, and modern program management practices. Professional security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, GIAC/GSEC) preferred. Written and spoken English proficiency. Skills & Core Competencies Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with executive presence. Ability to translate complex technical and security concepts into clear business language. Strategic, systems-oriented thinker with a transformation mindset. Innovative, collaborative problem solver with a strong bias for action. Ability to analyze, simplify, and automate processes for effectiveness and efficiency. Proven capability to manage multiple priorities across diverse organizations and geographies. High resilience and effectiveness in fast-paced, high-pressure transformation environments. Highly self-motivated, well-organized, and detail oriented. Dedicated, curious, and resourceful lifelong learner with a continuous-improvement mindset.

title: Senior MEP Design & Engineering Project Manager – Data Centres
description:
Senior MEP Design & Engineering Project Manager – Data Centres

Paris, France

Mission-Critical / Data Centre Projects

Mechanical / MEP Engineering Background

ECC Group is seeking a highly experienced Senior MEP Design & Engineering Project Manager to support the delivery of a portfolio of major projects in Paris and the wider French market.

This is a senior-level appointment for an accomplished engineering professional who can take ownership of MEP design and engineering coordination across multiple concurrent projects, working with clients, consultants, designers, contractors and specialist technical teams.

While the position covers the wider MEP environment, we are particularly interested in candidates with a strong Mechanical Engineering background and experience delivering technically complex, mission-critical facilities.

The Role

You will provide senior engineering and design leadership across multiple projects, ensuring that technical solutions are coordinated, buildable and aligned with programme, commercial and operational requirements.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and coordinating MEP engineering and design activities across multiple projects.
  • Providing particular oversight of mechanical systems and infrastructure.
  • Managing the design process from concept and detailed design through construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Reviewing technical designs, specifications, drawings and engineering submissions.
  • Challenging design solutions and identifying opportunities for technical improvement, risk reduction and value engineering.
  • Managing interfaces between Mechanical, Electrical, CSA, Controls and Commissioning disciplines.
  • Coordinating external consultants, design teams, contractors and specialist suppliers.
  • Ensuring engineering deliverables meet project programme, quality and technical requirements.
  • Identifying design risks, technical dependencies and potential programme impacts at an early stage.
  • Supporting technical workshops, design reviews and project meetings.
  • Working closely with project management, construction and commissioning teams to ensure effective transition from design into delivery.
  • Providing senior-level technical input to clients and key project stakeholders.
  • Maintaining engineering and design consistency across a portfolio of concurrent projects.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an established senior engineering professional with significant experience within MEP design, engineering management or technical project delivery.

You should ideally have:

  • A degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Extensive experience managing engineering/design on large, technically complex projects.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical building services, including cooling, HVAC, ventilation, chilled-water and associated infrastructure.
  • Broad understanding of electrical and wider MEP systems.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams and external engineering consultants.
  • Proven ability to operate across multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong design management, technical coordination and stakeholder-management capability.
  • Experience working through the full project lifecycle from design development through construction and commissioning.
  • The confidence and technical credibility to challenge consultants, contractors and engineering teams at senior level.
  • Excellent communication and client-facing skills.

Previous data centre or mission-critical project experience is highly desirable.

We are particularly interested in candidates who understand the technical requirements associated with high-availability environments, cooling infrastructure, resilience, redundancy, commissioning and integration of complex MEP systems.

Language Requirement

Candidates must be professionally fluent in both French and English.

The role will require regular communication with French project teams as well as international clients, consultants and stakeholders.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take a senior engineering position within a growing portfolio of complex projects in France.

Rather than being responsible for a single project, you will have visibility and influence across multiple major developments, providing engineering leadership and helping drive technical standards from design through delivery.

If you are a senior Mechanical / MEP Engineering, Design Management or Technical Project Management professional with experience in complex construction environments, we would be interested in speaking with you.

Location: Paris, France

Discipline: Mechanical / MEP Engineering & Design
