title: Breach Simulation Analyst
description:
At Provido, we’re more than a technology company. We are a global hub of innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence.

Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world.

As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact.
If you are motivated by challenge, inspired by technology, and ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, your journey starts here.

👉 Why We Need You

The Breach Simulation Analyst (Red Teamer) is responsible for planning, executing, and reporting on offensive security engagements that emulate real-world adversary behavior against the organization’s systems, applications, infrastructure, and personnel. This role supports proactive identification of exploitable weaknesses through penetration testing, red team operations, breach and attack simulation, adversary emulation, and authorized social engineering exercises aligned to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. The analyst will work alongside blue team, detection engineering, and incident response functions to validate detection coverage, test control effectiveness, and deliver actionable remediation guidance. The role requires strong technical depth, disciplined documentation, and the ability to coordinate with global security operations, defensive teams, and business stakeholders.

👉 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Plan, scope, and execute red team engagements, penetration tests, and breach simulation exercises across networks, web and mobile applications, cloud environments, endpoints, Active Directory, and internal infrastructure.

  • Emulate adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) aligned to MITRE ATT&CK to test detection and response capabilities of the SOC and incident response teams. • Conduct authorized social engineering exercises, including phishing, vishing, and where in scope, physical intrusion testing, to evaluate human and process controls.

  • Develop and maintain custom tooling, scripts, and payloads to support offensive operations, while operating strictly within authorized scope and agreed rules of engagement.

  • Identify, exploit, and document vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and control weaknesses, producing clear technical findings and executive-ready reports with prioritized remediation guidance.

  • Collaborate with blue team, detection engineering, and incident response on purple team exercises to validate and improve detection and response coverage.

  • Maintain accurate records of engagement scope, methodology, evidence, exploitation steps, escalations, and remediation tracking for audit, reporting, and continuous improvement purposes.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging offensive techniques, threat actor TTPs, vulnerability disclosures, and tooling relevant to the organization’s technology stack and operating environments in Malaysia, Southeast Asia, and across multinational footprints.

    👉 What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor's degree or completed studies in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, red teaming, breach simulation, offensive security, or a closely related technical role.

  • Working knowledge of common attack techniques across network, web application, Active Directory, cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and endpoint domains, including privilege escalation, lateral movement, and post exploitation.

  • Hands-on experience with offensive tooling such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Burp Suite, BloodHound, Impacket, Nmap, or equivalent commercial and open-source frameworks.

  • Scripting or programming ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar, sufficient to build custom tooling and automate offensive workflows.

  • Ability to scope engagements, document findings clearly, and translate technical exploitation into actionable remediation recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Strong written and verbal English proficiency to support multinational stakeholders and prepare clear engagement reporting.


👉 Preferred Skills

  • Professional certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, CRTP, GPEN, GXPN, GWAPT, CEH Practical, or equivalent offensive security credentials.

  • Experience supporting red team operations, purple team exercises, adversary emulation, breach and attack simulation programs, or managed offensive security service environments.

  • Exposure to breach and attack simulation platforms (e.g., AttackIQ, SafeBreach, Cymulate), command-and control frameworks, and EDR / AV evasion techniques.

  • Understanding of Active Directory attack paths, Kerberos abuse (Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, delegation attacks), lateral movement, privilege escalation, and post-exploitation tradecraft.

  • Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, cyber kill chain, threat actor emulation profiles, purple team methodology, and the intelligence-led offensive testing lifecycle.

  • Understanding of compliance-focused environments and the importance of documented methodology, rules-of-engagement adherence, data handling discipline, and audit support.

    👉 Why You’ll Love Working with Us

Du blir en del av Core-teamet i Technology som i dag består av 6 personer, og som har det overordnede ansvaret for det tekniske fundamentet i Nettbil.

Som Data Engineer vil du blant annet:

  • Ta eierskap til og videreutvikle den tekniske dataplattformen vår, som gir oss grunnlaget vi trenger for å håndtere over 2 000 bilsalg hver måned

  • Bygge innsiktsmotoren som ligger til grunn for Nettbils retning, slik at manglende innsikt aldri blir det som bremser oss

  • Utforske hvordan AI og maskinlæring kan skape nye muligheter for innsikt

  • Samarbeide tett med analytikere og utviklingsteam

Hvem er du? 🌟
Vi ser etter deg som liker å ta eierskap til det du bygger. Du ønsker å forstå hvorfor et problem er verdt å løse, ikke bare hvordan du kan løse det raskt. Kvalitet betyr mye for deg, fordi feil i beslutningsgrunnlaget vårt har store konsekvenser for både oss og kundene våre.

Du tar ansvar for kvaliteten på datagrunnlaget resten av selskapet bygger beslutninger på. Du er med på å forme både arkitektur og arbeidsmetoder i en dataplattform som er helt sentral for veksten vår. Du liker å bygge robuste systemer, men også å stille spørsmål ved dem underveis.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har flere års erfaring med den tekniske siden av en dataplattform, fra datakilde til beslutningsgrunnlag

  • Har relevant utdanning

  • Behersker norsk som arbeidsspråk

  • Kan møte opp på kontoret vårt på Økern

Teknologistacken vår 🚦

Nettbil er i rask vekst, og du blir med på å forme verktøykassa vår. Det er ikke nødvendig å være ekspert på hele stacken vi har i dag; det viktigste er en solid forståelse av grunnleggende prinsipper og gode tekniske ferdigheter.

Kodebasen består primært av TypeScript og Node.js, og du kan ellers forvente blant annet:

  • Databaser: PostgreSQL, MySQL

  • Datavarehus: Amazon Redshift

  • ELT: dbt, Python

  • Infrastruktur: AWS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu

  • Visualisering: Tableau

  • Produktanalyse: Amplitude, GrowthBook

Hva vi kan tilby deg 🌞

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og felles ambisjoner.

  • Scale‑up med trygghet: del av Vend‑konsernet med støtte i ryggen og langsiktig satsing, kombinert med farten til en scale-up

  • Høy tillit, korte beslutningsveier og stor frihet i hvordan du løser oppgaver

  • Moderne kontorlokaler på Økern Portal med treningssenter, takterrasse og flere lunsjsteder.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

Hos Nettbil blir du en del av et sammensveiset og engasjert miljø med rundt 100 kollegaer. Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes når mennesker med ulike erfaringer og perspektiver samarbeider, og legger derfor stor vekt på kunnskapsdeling, samarbeid og utvikling.

Vi holder til i toppetasjen på Økern Portal med utsikt over hele Oslo, takterrasse, treningssenter i bygget og flere gode lunsjsteder. Det er likevel menneskene som gjør arbeidsplassen vår spesiell. Vi har en kultur med lav terskel for å dele ideer, hjelpe hverandre og feire små og store milepæler. Enten det er sommerfest, felles lunsjer eller sosiale samlinger, ønsker vi å skape en ambisiøs arbeidsplass der det er både meningsfylt og hyggelig å være.

Slik søker du 🧰

Send oss CV og noen ord om deg selv og hva som motiverer deg for rollen. Søknader vurderes etter søknadsfristen som er 12 oktober. Har du spørsmål om stillingen eller ønsker en uforpliktende prat, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Martine Grønlund på martine.gronlund@nettbil.no.

⭐ Vi er stolte av tilliten kundene våre viser oss. Les gjerne hva kundene våre sier om oss på Trustpilot: no.trustpilot.com/review/nettbil.no

title: IAM Security Architect
description:
At Provido, we’re more than a technology company. We are a global hub of innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence.

Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world.

As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact.
If you are motivated by challenge, inspired by technology, and ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, your journey starts here.

👉 Why We Need You

The IAM Security Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and continuously improving the organization’s identity and access management security architecture, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. This role defines secure, scalable, and auditable identity patterns for workforce, privileged, application, and external access across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise environments. The architect will lead the design of Microsoft Entra ID capabilities including Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Governance, Identity Protection, access reviews, entitlement management, single sign-on, application registration governance, and hybrid identity integration. While awareness of other cloud platforms is expected, the role is primarily centered on Azure and Entra as the strategic identity control plane for Zero Trust, least privilege, compliance, and operational resilience.

👉 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and maintain enterprise IAM security architecture with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 identity integrations, and hybrid identity environments.

  • Architect and govern Microsoft Entra ID capabilities including Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, Access Reviews, Entitlement Management, and lifecycle workflows.

  • Define and enforce Zero Trust and least-privilege access models across users, administrators, service principals, managed identities, applications, groups, and Azure resources.

  • Lead secure design for authentication and authorization flows, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM provisioning, federation, single sign-on, and application access integration patterns.

  • Govern Azure application registrations, enterprise applications, API permissions, consent settings, secrets, certificates, service principals, and workload identities to reduce privilege escalation and OAuth abuse risks.

  • Design privileged access controls using Entra Privileged Identity Management, just-in-time elevation, approval workflows, break-glass account controls, privileged access reviews, and administrative role hardening.

  • Develop identity security standards, reference architectures, design patterns, roadmaps, and control requirements aligned with security policy, regulatory expectations, and audit readiness.

  • Partner with security engineering, cloud platform, infrastructure, application, GRC, SOC, and business teams to embed identity controls into projects, migrations, and operational processes.

  • Support identity risk assessment, control validation, incident response, and remediation activities involving compromised accounts, excessive privileges, risky sign-ins, misconfigured applications, or identity governance gaps.



👉 What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management, cloud security, security architecture, or infrastructure security, with significant hands-on experience in Microsoft identity platforms.

  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, Access Reviews, Entitlement Management, and identity lifecycle governance.

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, hybrid identity, Entra Connect or Cloud Sync, federation, directory synchronization, Microsoft 365 identity dependencies, and enterprise authentication patterns.

  • Experience designing SSO and application integration patterns using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, APIs, service principals, managed identities, and application registration governance.

  • Ability to translate business, regulatory, and security requirements into practical identity architecture, control standards, implementation roadmaps, and operational guardrails.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical teams, present architecture decisions, document standards, and engage senior stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting audit, compliance, control testing, access certification, identity risk remediation, and evidence generation for regulated or compliance-focused environments.



👉 Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert.

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or equivalent architecture, governance, or cloud security credentials.

  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Azure Key Vault, and identity-related detection or monitoring use cases.

  • Experience automating IAM and Azure security controls using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Azure CLI, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or CI/CD pipelines.

  • Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS benchmarks, least privilege, separation of duties, and privileged access governance.

  • Exposure to non-Microsoft cloud IAM capabilities such as AWS IAM or Google Cloud IAM is beneficial, but the role remains primarily focused on Azure and Microsoft Entra.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Data Connectivity
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

About the Team

The Data Connectivity team builds the products and technical foundations that enable healthcare organizations to securely connect and use data across organizations, workflows, and technology ecosystems while preserving privacy and trust.

At the center of this portfolio is a highly technical foundation spanning core data connectivity engines and SDKs, shared services, APIs, authentication, configuration, observability, and infrastructure. These components power the products and integrations our customers use across Datavant-owned applications, cloud and data platforms, and other healthcare workflows.

As our portfolio grows, we're investing in making these foundations increasingly reusable, scalable, reliable, and easy for other teams and products to build upon. We're also exploring how these foundations should evolve for an AI-native future—including making Data Connectivity capabilities easier for AI applications and agents to consume and using AI to materially improve how we build, test, operate, and evolve complex technical systems.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product strategy and evolution of the core technical foundations that power Datavant's Data Connectivity portfolio. You'll work closely with Engineering across our core engines, SDKs, APIs, shared services, and infrastructure—turning new capabilities and technical innovations into stable, reusable functionality that can be delivered across products and deployment models.

AI will be an important part of this evolution. You'll help determine how our APIs, SDKs, services, and developer experiences should evolve for AI-enabled and agentic consumption, while identifying opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, automation, observability, and operational workflows.

This role sits at an important intersection of Product and Engineering. You'll need enough technical depth to engage meaningfully in architectural discussions and identify opportunities for reuse, scalability, and simplification—while maintaining a strong product perspective on customer value, priorities, and investment tradeoffs.

You won't be expected to design the architecture or manage Engineering. You'll partner closely with senior engineers and Engineering leadership, bringing clarity to what problems we should solve, why they matter, what requirements and outcomes solutions need to satisfy, and where we should invest.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for core Data Connectivity engines, SDKs, APIs, shared services, and related technical foundations.
  • Translate customer, product, and internal developer needs into clear technical product requirements and priorities.
  • Productize new capabilities and technical innovations into stable, reusable functionality that downstream products and integrations can consume.
  • Drive the evolution of SDKs and APIs with a focus on usability, stability, extensibility, backward compatibility, and developer experience.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering to simplify architecture and duplication, manage technical dependencies, and create leverage across products and delivery modalities.
  • Evolve Data Connectivity interfaces and technical foundations for AI-enabled and agentic workflows, while identifying and measuring high-value applications of AI across developer tooling, software delivery, testing, observability, automation, and operations.
  • Shape shared services spanning areas such as authentication, configuration, observability, usage measurement, reliability, and deployment foundations.
  • Balance investments across new capabilities, scalability, reliability, security, technical modernization, AI enablement, and existing customer needs.
  • Partner with Privacy, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure technical foundations meet Datavant's privacy and security requirements.
  • Define measurable outcomes for technical investments, including reliability, performance, developer productivity, reuse, and speed of product delivery.
  • Determine when emerging technical innovations are ready to transition from experimentation into production, bringing structure and product judgment while Engineering owns technical implementation and architectural decisions.
  • Contribute to the broader Data Connectivity strategy and help shape how its technical foundations evolve as the portfolio grows.

About You

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Engineering, or a similarly technical product role, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical products.
  • You have strong technical fluency and can engage meaningfully with engineers on APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, services, infrastructure, data architecture, and system design.
  • You have experience building, managing, and evolving SDKs, APIs, developer tools, shared services, infrastructure, or other reusable technical products, including products whose users may be developers or other product teams.
  • You are a systems thinker who understands how decisions in one part of a technical ecosystem affect downstream products, users, and teams.
  • You are curious and pragmatic about AI. You actively use and evaluate emerging AI tools, understand where they can materially improve technical products and engineering workflows, and distinguish durable value from technology for technology's sake.
  • You understand the boundary between Product and Engineering: you provide clarity on problems, outcomes, priorities, and tradeoffs while partnering with Engineering on how those problems are technically solved.
  • You are excellent at translating complex technical concepts into clear product decisions and communicating them to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You are highly organized and comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure and momentum to complex technical initiatives with significant dependencies and evolving requirements.
  • You are proactive and independent, exercising sound judgment and making thoughtful recommendations with incomplete information.
  • You care about quality, reliability, security, and maintainability—not simply shipping new functionality.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience as a software engineer, data engineer, solutions architect, or other hands-on technical role.
  • Experience building AI-enabled technical products or applying AI to developer workflows, software development, testing, observability, automation, or technical operations.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, CI/CD, observability, authentication/authorization, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with data-intensive or privacy-sensitive products, particularly in healthcare or life sciences.
  • Familiarity with cryptography, identity resolution, privacy-preserving technologies, or healthcare data connectivity.
  • Experience modernizing complex technical systems while maintaining backward compatibility and existing customer commitments.

Why Join This Team?

Data Connectivity is foundational to how healthcare organizations responsibly use data together. The quality of the underlying technical foundation directly affects how quickly Datavant can innovate, how reliably customers can use our products, and how easily new capabilities can reach the market.

You'll have meaningful ownership of the technical products at the center of that system, working with experienced engineers and domain experts to translate emerging innovations into production capabilities and build foundations that create leverage across a growing portfolio. You'll also help define what an AI-native technical foundation for trusted healthcare data connectivity should look like—from how our capabilities are exposed to AI applications and agents to how AI changes the way complex systems are built, tested, operated, and improved.

As the Data Connectivity organization evolves, you'll have the opportunity to shape not just individual technical products, but how Datavant builds and scales Data Connectivity for the future.

Join Our Team at Datavant Ireland - A Galway-Based R&D Technology Center

Datavant Ireland is an innovative R&D technology center based in Galway, dedicated to solving complex technology challenges with a purpose. We are looking for talented technical professionals who are product-minded and eager to make an impact. If you are passionate about developing cutting-edge solutions and want to be part of a growing team, we invite you to explore the exciting career opportunities at Datavant.

Careers at Datavant offer the opportunity to apply your technology and problem-solving skills toward a vision that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

We're looking for collaborative problem-solvers, curious learners, and thoughtful builders who are excited to make an impact. We value diverse experiences, perspectives, and approaches to solving challenges, and we believe the best outcomes come from teams that learn from and support one another.

We provide team members with a robust total compensation package that includes:

  • Competitive, equitable salary.
  • Comprehensive benefits.
  • Pension contribution.
  • Flexible, Hybrid work environment.



We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavanters who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavanters belong and thrive.

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Datavant is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need an accommodation while seeking employment, please request it here, by selecting the ‘Interview Accommodation Request’ category. You will need your requisition ID when submitting your request, you can find instructions for locating it here. Requests for reasonable accommodations will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

title: Jeg søker flere gode støttespillere til hverdagen min i Ørsta
description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast deltid og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid i hverdager og noe helg

Hei!

Jeg er en rolig og trivelig mann som bor i Ørsta sammen med samboeren min. Nå ser jeg etter nye assistenter til BPA-teamet mitt – både en fast assistent og tilkallingsvikarer.

For meg er det aller viktigste at du er en trygg, omsorgsfull og tålmodig person som ser mennesket bak behovet for assistanse. Personlig kjemi betyr mye i denne jobben, og jeg ønsker å finne noen som jeg kan føle meg trygg sammen med, og som passer godt inn i hverdagen min.

Jeg har behov for hjelp til både praktiske oppgaver og personlig omsorg. Dagsformen min varierer, og jeg sliter også med fatigue, som gjør at energinivået kan være forskjellig fra dag til dag. Noen ganger har jeg behov for at det er stille og rolig rundt meg, og da er det fint om du kan ta deg av praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet eller bidra med tilrettelegging. Andre ganger har jeg overskudd til hyggelige samtaler eller små turer ut når formen tillater det. Derfor ser jeg etter en assistent som er rolig, fleksibel og flink til å lese situasjoner og tilpasse seg det jeg trenger der og da. Det viktigste er at du bidrar til en trygg og god hverdag, uansett hvordan dagen ser ut.

Jeg bruker stav innendørs og rullestol utendørs. Jeg liker å komme meg litt ut når formen tillater det, men det viktigste i denne stillingen er ikke aktivitetene i seg selv – det er at du er en person jeg fungerer godt sammen med.

Stillingen

Vi tilbyr i første omgang en fast stilling med to vakter i uken, seks timer per vakt. Det tilsvarer omtrent 12 timer per uke. På sikt vil det kunne være mulighet for en større fast stilling.

I tillegg søker vi tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov, for eksempel ved sykdom, ferieavvikling eller ekstra behov i perioder.

Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid i hverdager, vanligvis mellom kl. 08.00 og 14.00. Enkelte helgevakter kan forekomme.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personlig stell og praktisk bistand i hverdagen

  • Husarbeid og rengjøring

  • Massasje og gjennombevegelse (Jeg sliter med dårlig blodsirkulasjon og derfor er dette en viktig del av hverdagen)

  • Matlaging og andre praktiske gjøremål

  • Følge til avtaler eller aktiviteter ved behov

  • Bidra til trygghet, ro og en god hverdag

Personlige egenskaper

  • Omsorgsfull og trygg

  • Flink til å lese situasjoner og tilpasse seg skiftende behov og dagsform

  • Rolig, tålmodig og fleksibel

  • God til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B og tilgang til bil

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

  • Erfaring fra omsorgsarbeid er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hvorfor velge denne jobben?

  • Du får en meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell

  • Du blir en viktig og trygg person i hverdagen min

  • Du får mulighet til å bygge en nær og tillitsfull relasjon over tid

  • Du blir en del av et trygt arbeidsmiljø med tett oppfølging

  • Du får god opplæring og relevante kurs

Kvinner oppfordres spesielt til å søke.

Ved spørsmål om stillingen kan rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog kontaktes på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,4 kroner, kveldstillegg på 67 kroner og helgetillegg på 70kroner

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer og nettbutikker

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Tett oppfølging fra BPA-koordinator

  • Verdifull erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

title: Advanced Practice Provder-ENT-Sheboygan
description:
This position will work 32 hours per week
Advanced Practice Provider




Come work where we specialize in you! We have nearly 2,000 reasons for you to consider a career with Prevea Health—they're our employees. We're an organization that values kindness, responsibility, inclusivity, wellness and inspiration. At Prevea, we provide continuous education, training and support so every member of the team contributes to our success. Together we are the best place to get care and the best place to give care.

Job Summary
The Advanced Practice Provider at Prevea is an advanced practice nurse (NP) or physician assistant (PA) prepared to deliver health care services to patients, families and groups emphasizing the promotion of health and prevention of disease under direct supervision and responsibility of physicians. The scope of responsibilities includes collaborating and coordinating with physicians and other health professionals regarding clinical practice, education, consultation, research and program development.

What you will do

  • Provides assessment, evaluation, and management to patients with minor, acute, chronic, & episodic illness & injuries. Including performance of follow up exams if required.
  • Collaborates with patients to review their health background and determine physiological, emotional, and environmental needs, using this information to advise patients and their families on future health plans and illness prevention.
  • Provides case management services to assist clients and families with the arrangement for, or refer patients to needed services.
  • Conducts telephone calls back to patients requiring follow-up care or provide test results. Also provides health counseling and education to patients and their families about their healthcare and any follow-up instructions.
  • Provides services, which may include the ordering of appropriate diagnostic and laboratory tests, the prescription of pharmacological agents, and other non-pharmacological treatment modalities.
  • Maintains and reviews patient records, charts, and other pertinent information, documenting all details in the electronic medical record.
  • Collaborate with physicians and other providers to develop and implement patient care plans to ensure the best possible care and outcomes of patients.


Education Qualifications

  • Graduate of a master's level nurse practitioner program OR graduate from an accredited physician assistant program. Required

Experience Qualifications

  • 1-3 years work experience in a clinical setting within a health care organization Preferred

Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of the information and techniques required to diagnose and treat human injuries and diseases, including understanding symptoms, treatment options, drug properties and interactions, and preventive healthcare measures.
  • Demonstrate organizational skills that allow timely patient appointments and appropriate required follow up.
  • Presents a courteous and service oriented image through positive and helpful interaction with patients and families, physicians and co-workers.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and behaviors
  • Ability to form work/patient relationships with patients and peers.
  • Ability to prioritize work and meet changing demands.

Upon Hire Required
  • Physician Assistant: Licensed by the state of Wisconsin as a Physician Assistant. Certification from the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistant. Upon Hire Required
  • CPR/Basic Life support for Healthcare Providers certification from approved program. Required

title: Sjuksköterska till Avdelning 92 Rättspsykiatriska regionkliniken, Sundsvall
description:
Vi är en kraft som binder ihop, håller samman och utvecklar länet. Inom Region Västernorrland är vi alla en del av något större.

Om verksamheten

Rättspsykiatriska regionkliniken är idag en av landets största kliniker för vård av patienter enligt lagen om rättspsykiatrisk vård (LRV). Vi har också uppdrag att vårda särskilt vårdkrävande patienter enligt lagen om psykiatrisk tvångsvård (LPT).

Kliniken är mitt i en stor expansion med en nybyggnation för att slutligen få 10 vårdavdelningar och 135 vårdplatser.

Vi erbjuder dig en mycket god arbetsmiljö där arbetet är omväxlande, självständigt och ansvarsfullt. Du får patientkontakt och tillfälle att träffa många nya arbetskamrater. Hos oss kan du trivas och utvecklas. Vi använder oss av så kallat tvättstugeschema där vi erbjuder goda möjligheter för personalen att själva påverkar arbetstiderna. Vi söker nu en sjuksköterska som är intresserad av att komma till oss och arbeta med rättspsykiatrisk omvårdnad.

Tjänsten avser en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetsuppgifter

Inom RPK arbetar vi med kontaktmannaskap där sjuksköterskan har ett övergripande omvårdnadsansvar. Vi arbetar enligt en strukturerad vårdprocess i multiprofessionella team bestående av sjuksköterskor, skötare, läkare, psykologer, kuratorer och arbetsterapeuter. Du arbetar med avdelningens dagliga verksamhet och i arbetsuppgifterna ingår även att vara delaktig i vårdinsatser såsom:

  • samtal
  • behandlingsinsatser
  • ronder
  • journalföring
  • utvärdering och genomförande av omvårdnadsåtgärder
  • riskbedömningar
  • vårdplaneringar
  • funktionsbedömningar
  • läkemedelsadministration
KvalifikationerVi söker dig som
  • Är legitimerad sjuksköterska
  • Har goda kunskaper i svenska i såväl tal som skrift
Det är meriterande om du
  • Har erfarenhet av psykiatrisk vård och behandling
  • Har en vidareutbildning inom psykiatri
  • Har ytterligare språkkunskaper
  • Har B-körkort
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har dessa personliga egenskaper
  • Samarbetsförmåga
  • Personlig mognad
  • Initiativtagande
  • Självgående

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Som sjuksköterska hos oss är det viktigt att du har ett stort intresse för människor och att du har tålamod och förmåga att sätta dig in i andra människors situation.

Region Västernorrland

Med cirka 7000 medarbetare och över 200 yrken ansvarar vi på Region Västernorrland för flera av de verksamheter som är allra viktigast för invånarnas möjlighet att delta i samhället. Här gör din kunskap och ditt engagemang skillnad inom allt från hälso- och sjukvård till kultur, miljö och hållbarhet. Bli en del av ett lag där alla behövs. Tillsammans för ett växande Västernorrland.

Regionen arbetar sedan många år med att skapa förutsättningar för att bidra till friska och hälsosamma medarbetare. Att du mår bra och trivs är viktigt för oss. En av våra många förmåner är att vi erbjuder 5000 kronor per år i friskvårdsbidrag. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning enligt gällande kollektivavtal. Läs mer om Region Västernorrland, våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba tillsammans med oss: Region Västernorrland - Att jobba i Region Västernorrland (rvn.se).

Inom Region Västernorrland är ett antal tjänster placerade i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning kan därför komma att ske. Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster. Vi tillämpar registerkontroll av belastningsregister samt drogtest innan beslut om anställning.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Iltatyönjohtaja, Espoo
description:
Etsimme työnjohtajaa säännölliseen iltatyöhön asiakkaallemme Espooseen.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Tarve kohdistuu betoni- sekä infrapuolen hankkeisiin.

Päivittäinen työaika ma-pe on klo 16.00 – 24.00 tai klo 14.00 - 22.00. Tarvittaessa mahdollisuus tehdä myös viikonloppuvuoroja.

Työnjohtajana vastaat rakennusprojektin johtamisesta ja työmaan toiminnan sujuvuudesta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat työvaiheiden aikatauluttaminen, laadunvalvonta, työturvallisuuden varmistaminen sekä kustannusten seuranta omalla osa-alueellasi.

Työtehtävät ovat monipuolista ja itsenäistä – päivät voivat kulua toimistolla, työmaalla tai satunnaisesti asiakkaiden parissa.

Työsuhde solmitaan Vision kanssa - tämä ja tehtävän sisältö tarkentuu haastatteluissa ja haun edetessä.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat hyvinkin olla etsimämme henkilö

* kokemusta maanrakennus-, putkitus- ja/tai betonipuolen projekteista eli infrapuoli on sinulle tuttua
* ymmärrystä työmaaprosesseista, aikataulutuksesta ja kustannusten hallinnasta
* hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
* oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työasennettaAjokorttia ja valmiutta liikkua työmaiden välillä

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan
* vähintään 6 kk mittaisen työsuhteen, joka voi jatkua
* päivittäisen tuen työasioissa

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Lisätietoja saat soittamalla Visio Professionalin Sanna Majavalle puh. 045 8607 556 tai Tarja Laaksolle puh. 045 8588 441. Voit myös lähettää meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen professional@visiohr.fi <mailto:professional@visiohr.fi> . Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

title: Intern, Trade Finance Product Management
description:
ING WB Asia Internship Programme 2027


At ING, we're redefining what it means to be a bank, and we're looking for students who are curious, proactive, and eager to make a meaningful impact. If you're excited to learn, challenge the status quo, collaborate with diverse teams, and turn ideas into action, our internship programme offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience, develop your skills, and contribute to an international organisation that values continuous growth and innovation.

Department/Function: Transaction Services

Team: Trade Finance Product Management

Internship Period: 6 months; January -June 2027



About ING Bank


We began operating in Singapore in 1987 where we host the regional Asia Pacific headquarters. With over 300 financial experts, we are the largest wholesale banking branch in Asia. ING stands out in the Asia Pacific region because we go a step further for our customers. We look at things from the client’s perspective which allows us to construct tailor-made solutions to fit the needs of every company we serve. This mentality underpins all our client relations and has produced various prestigious awards.

Our internship programme offers more than just on-the-job experience. Through structured onboarding, development initiatives, cross-functional networking opportunities, project showcases and an intern alumni community, you'll gain valuable exposure, build meaningful connections and develop skills for your future career.


What does Trade Finance Product Management team do?


Owns a product or product range and is responsible for the profit and loss of the assigned product(s) as well as ensuring the product(s) remain within a given risk appetite.


Furthermore, it is responsible for optimizing the commercial performance by analyzing market and customer data, formulating long-term strategic views on the product proposition, translating those to requirements for product developments and maximizing business value by commercializing the enhanced proposition in alignment with internal and external stakeholders.


What would you be doing?


The intern supports the trade finance product management team in developing, managing, and enhancing trade finance solutions. This includes exposure to products like letters of credit, guarantees, supply chain finance, and working capital solutions. The role bridges product strategy, operational processes, and client needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Support & Development
    • Assist in designing and refining trade finance products and services.
    • Help prepare product documentation, training materials, and presentations.

  • Market & Client Analysis
    • Conduct research on market trends, competitor offerings, and client requirements.
    • Analyze customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Operational & Compliance Tasks
    • Support first-level checks for compliance with credit and regulatory standards.
    • Help maintain accurate records and reporting tools for trade finance transactions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with front office, operations, and risk teams to ensure smooth product delivery.
    • Participate in meetings and contribute to discussions on product rollout and enhancements.

  • Administrative & Project Work
    • Update Excel trackers, prepare reports, and assist in project coordination.


What qualities and skills are we looking for?


  • You should have legal work rights in the country of internship
  • Education: Typically pursuing a degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related fields.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with trade finance concepts is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving.
  • Mindset: Eagerness to learn, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and collaborative attitude.

What would you gain from this internship?


  • Exposure to global trade finance products and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience with compliance, risk management, and client servicing.
  • Networking with product managers and cross-functional teams.

title: Implementation Delivery Senior Associate
description:
Summary of Position

Pirum is seeking an Implementation Delivery Senior Associate to deliver the hands-on technical implementation of client onboarding — configuration, data mapping, inbound file analysis and testing — across the Pirum product suite. This a delivery role that works independently on standard engagements while escalating genuine complexity to senior specialists and the Programme Manager.

The role sits within the delivery team and pairs with a Programme Manager on active integrations, owning the technical build and the quality of the work while project governance is held elsewhere.

Pirum is building a structured knowledge and AI capability across the C-X group. Every role in the function both draws on that capability and contributes to it. We expect people to use AI tooling where it genuinely accelerates work, and to exercise judgement about where it does not.

Duties & Responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Configuration

• Configure services and relationship mapping on standard client engagements to a high standard

• Execute detailed file analysis independently; document gap analysis and resolution decisions clearly

• Use AI-assisted analysis for first-pass gap analysis and field mapping, then verify every finding against the load gates and the inbound schema

• Create new entities and manage users and contacts configuration without supervision

• Identify configuration risks and raise them proactively to the Programme Manager and senior team where appropriate

Testing & Quality Assurance

• Design and execute test scenarios for standard onboarding engagements independently

• Generate candidate test scenarios with AI tooling and apply judgement about coverage — what has been missed matters more than what has been produced

• Manage the UAT extract exchange process, with client coordination support from the Programme Manager

• Track and resolve defects through to closure independently; escalate only genuine blockers

• Produce clear, complete test evidence that meets audit requirements

Domain & Integration Knowledge

• Maintain solid working knowledge of the Pirum inbound data schema across key transaction types

• Record mapping decisions, gap analysis and resolution rationale in a form that is reusable by others and by AI-assisted retrieval, rather than only in the engagement it came from

• Understand the integration requirements of standard connectivity patterns (SFTP, MQ) and support connectivity testing

• Build and apply competence across vendor system landscapes and their typical integration patterns

• Handle routine data validation and inbound file analysis with full confidence

Engineering Collaboration

• Work with Engineers on new mapping and rule development; contribute effectively to development specification and verification

• Support bespoke development delivery; execute testing for bespoke builds to a high standard

• Participate meaningfully in code review; identify and raise quality issues before release

• Contribute to test tooling improvements

Success Measures

Performance in this role will be assessed against the quality and independence of technical delivery on assigned engagements, such as:

• Standard engagements configured, tested and delivered independently, with senior input reserved for genuine complexity

• Clean, audit-ready test evidence and defect resolution on every engagement

Skills, Knowledge & Attributes

Established in 2000, Pirum is a dynamic Fintech that provides a comprehensive set of SaaS based automation solutions facilitating pre-/post-trade processing, regulatory reporting and collateral management for the global securities finance industry. Pirum’s client base includes most of the top-tier financial institutions worldwide and the business is as recognised for its innovative solutions as it is for providing best-in-class customer service.

Headquartered in London, and with offices also in New York, Pirum is currently co-owned by two PE firms – Bowmark Capital (since 2019) and Hg Capital (since 2021/22). Under Bowmark’s and Hg’s ownership, Pirum has pursued an ambitious agenda of organic growth, with the investors’ financial services technology credentials and international footprints enabling Pirum to continue its global expansion and investment in additional innovations.

Pirum offers the opportunity to work inside a growing, collaborative and entrepreneurial company. Our skilled professionals act with integrity and deliver to the highest standards. title: Data Scientist Engineer
description:
Job Description


You will join our Data team, currently in its growth phase, with a twofold challenge: industrializing a platform able to absorb massive real-time volumes (1,000,000 events per second), and turning that critical mass of information into tangible product value.


This role deliberately straddles two worlds:


Within the Data team, you build and harden the pipelines that feed the entire company.


As reinforcement for our tech and product squads, you join pitches that call for genuine mathematical, statistical and algorithmic depth: designing, adapting and implementing the advanced algorithms behind the features we want to build and then shipping them to production
yourself.


This is a role for someone who dislikes the border between the notebook and the running service: you design the algorithm, you write it properly, you deploy it, you monitor it.


Your missions:


Build and operate the data platform (Data Engineer hat)


Design and implement in Python data processing workflows, from development to production.


Centralize and harmonize heterogeneous sources (Product, Finance, Marketing) to make data accessible and reliable for all Sekoia teams.


Develop, test, and orchestrate pipelines (via Airflow).


Act as a curator of the data, collecting and enriching the business data generated day after day by our automated sensors and our analysts.


Monitor and guarantee the quality and back-end performance of production.


Bring algorithmic value to the product squads (Data Scientist hat)


Join a squad for the duration of a pitch to own the data science / algorithmic building block of the feature.


Understand the business needs of our analysts and Product Managers, and translate them into an algorithmic methodology or a statistical learning model.


Select, adapt or design the right algorithm, including when the answer isn't an off-the-shelf model: heuristics, statistical methods, graph algorithms, anomaly detection, and so on.


Define the evaluation metrics and demonstrate that the solution genuinely answers the need, at our scale.


Ship it and keep it running (MLOps hat)


Deploy your algorithms to production for the long run, within a quality assurance process: automated testing, continuous integration, code review.


Industrialize the model lifecycle: packaging, reproducibility, versioning, retraining, monitoring and drift tracking.


Propose innovative solutions to ensure the resilience and performance of our processing under heavy load.


Empower your colleagues by providing the tools they need to leverage high-quality data independently.


Bring a critical eye and contribute to the team's growth (knowledge sharing, mentoring).


The position is ideally based in Paris, or can be based in Rennes, with up to 3 remote days per week.


Your profile:


We are excited to meet you if :


You hold a Master's-level degree or above (MSc, engineering school, PhD) and have 3 to 5 years of professional experience combining data science and software development — or a data engineering background with a genuine appetite for algorithms.


You are proficient in Python and its scientific ecosystem: pandas, scikit-learn, as well as SQL.


You have strong skills in algorithms, complexity classes, optimization, and machine learning: you can reason about an algorithm before implementing it, and estimate what it will cost at scale.


You are an engineer, not just a prototyper: you write tested, reviewed, maintainable code, and you are comfortable with continuous integration and software engineering best practices.


You are a proactive "doer": autonomous and mature, you take ownership of your subjects rather than waiting for instructions.


You are driven by efficiency and resilience, capable of building systems that stay performant under heavy loads.


You are deeply curious about new trends in the data ecosystem and about technological change.


You write and speak English fluently.


You have experience in cybersecurity


You are comfortable with Spark (PySpark).


You hold a PhD in computer science.


Are you interested in this job but feel you haven't ticked all the boxes? Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet!


Recruitment Process:


Here's what's in store for you if you apply :


HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')


Tech & Culture Fit with Sylvain, Data Ops, and Gildas, Head of Data (45')


Technical Interview with Gildas and/or Sylvain (~2h, on site)


Interview with Georges, CTO (60')


Our process usually takes about 3 weeks, depending on availability. It includes reference calls. The program: discussions rather than trick questions! These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!


Sekoia is an equal opportunity employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

title: Busschaufför Kalix
description:
Vill du bidra till att hålla människor i rörelse och få lokalsamhällen att blomstra?

Bakom varje avgång och ankomst finns våra kollegor som får allt att fungera – varje dag, året om. Nu söker vi fler som vill hjälpa oss med just detta.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta heltid men även dig som vill arbeta extra som busschaufför i Kalix.

Boreal Sverige värdesätter en positiv attityd och kamratskap. Vi strävar efter att vara en arbetsplats där människor mår bra och känner sig trygga. För oss kommer säkerhet först, sist och alltid; för dig, dina medarbetare, kunder och medtrafikanter.

Kvalifikationer och egenskaper

För arbetet krävs D-körkort samt YKB för persontrafik. Har du busskort men saknar YKB? För rätt person erbjuder vi alla fem YKB delkurser!

Som bussförare är det viktigt att du förmedlar en positiv känsla av att åka buss och att du tar ett stort eget ansvar. Du ska på ett säkert och behagligt sätt transportera våra kunder och hjälpa till vid frågor eller funderingar från dem.

Du känner igen dig i Boreals värderingar. Du är Närvarande i mötet med resenärer och kollegor, Pålitlig i sättet du tar ansvar och bidrar till en trygg resa, samt Framåtblickande genom att bidra till förbättringar och utveckling av verksamheten.

Du måste ha en positiv attityd och vara villig att behandla varje kund precis som du själv vill bli behandlad.

Du förstår och utrycker dig obehindrat på svenska.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som bussförare i Kalix kommer du att köra linjetrafik. I arbetsuppgifterna förutom körning så ingår även städning och dagligt underhåll av bussar samt fel- och skaderapportering. Arbetet är socialt och passar dig som tycker om service och kundkontakter.

Om oss

Boreal Sverige utför serviceresor, linje- och beställningstrafik samt skoltransporter. Vårt huvudkontor är i Skellefteå

Vi är en del av våra passagerares vardag och tillhandahåller hållbara, säkra och pålitliga transportlösningar i såväl tätorter som på landsbygden. Vår verksamhet är anpassad efter lokala behov och förutsättningar, med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och utmärkta kundupplevelser.

Vi ingår i Boreal koncernen som bedriver verksamhet inom buss, spårvagn, höghastighetspassagerarfärjor och bilfärjor.

Läs mer: http://www.boreal.se.

Ett samhälle blomstrar när människor kan vara en del av det. Genom att göra det möjligt för människor att känna samhörighet, delta, uppleva och resa håller vi lokalsamhällen levande – för både invånare och besökare. Varje dag knyter våra förare samman människor och ser till att de tar sig dit de behöver – till skola, jobb och vardagliga åtaganden, men också till familj, semester och nya upplevelser.

Det är därför vår vision är ”Vi tar dig dit”. För vi brinner för att hålla människor i rörelse och samhällen levande.

Tired of boring pipelines and clunky data tools? So are we.

title: Engineering Specialist
description:
Job Purpose

The Engineering Specialist with Weaving Process focus is responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing the technical execution of internal and customer funded projects directed toward developing, expanding, and maturing AEC’s family of technologies for manufacturing fiber reinforcements for use in advanced composite structures. These technologies currently include 3D Jacquard weaving, conventional 2D weaving, and a variety of special processes such as contour weaving, steered weaving and braiding. The Engineering Specialist is expected to provide technical leadership within the DFW facility, to serve as a technical consultant and to participate in technical reviews.

Job Responsibilities

In the performance of their respective tasks and duties all employees are expected to conform to the following values: Safety, Accountability, Integrity, Respect, Passion and Innovation. Put Safety first at all times, never compromise on safety for the obtainment of other objectives. Responsible for health and safety of themselves and coworkers.

  1. Develop novel preforming processes using a variety of textile-based and associated methods (e.g., weaving, tufting, braiding, fiber placement, etc.). These materials may include 2D and 3D woven textiles, uni-directional fabrics, preforms utilizing fiber placement, or any combination
  2. Lead the design, verification and validation process of new products, technologies and methods, including material and component fabrication and testing.
  3. Establish working relationships with Customer’s technical staff. Represent AEC’s technical position in meeting with Customers.
  4. Technical lead on proof-of-concept activities that may lead to new production opportunities. Perform risk assessments for these opportunities and develop roadmaps outlining work that must be performed to minimize those risks.
  5. Work closely with manufacturing engineers to identify opportunities for improving existing processes.
  1. Establish process and performance limits; create effective process window maps; distill into effective work instructions for shop floor personnel.
  2. Monitor the industry to identify new techniques and process that may be of interest to AEC.
  1. Provide engineering/technical project updates and communications as needed by internal and external customers.
  2. Provide mentoring and technical leadership to the engineering organization in relevant areas of expertise. Identify and support implementation of organizational process improvement initiatives.
  3. Support technology road-mapping activities.

title: Steward
description:
At Grand Hyatt Barcelona, one of the city’s newest and most prestigious luxury hotels, we are looking for a committed, proactive, and service-oriented Steward to join our Culinary team.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the cleanliness, organization, and availability of all crockery, glassware, cutlery, kitchen utensils, and equipment, supporting the smooth operation of our kitchens, restaurants, and banquet facilities.

This is a temporary position to cover a leave of absence. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, value teamwork, and take pride in maintaining the highest standards of hygiene and quality, this is an excellent opportunity to grow your career within a world-class hospitality brand.

About the Role

As a Steward, you will act as an ambassador of the Hyatt brand, ensuring that all kitchen areas and operational equipment are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and organization.

This is an operational position with a rotating schedule, including evening shifts, weekends, and public holidays according to hotel operational needs. You will work closely with the Culinary and Food & Beverage teams to ensure a smooth and efficient operation at all times.

Key Responsibilities

• Clean, sanitize, and properly store crockery, glassware, cutlery, pots, pans, and kitchen utensils.

• Maintain cleanliness and organization in kitchens, stewarding areas, storage rooms, and banquet back-of-house areas.

• Operate and maintain dishwashing and cleaning equipment safely and efficiently.

• Ensure clean equipment is readily available and properly organized for operational teams.

• Support cleanliness and order across all food production and service areas.

• Follow hygiene, food safety, and workplace safety procedures at all times.

• Report equipment malfunctions and maintenance needs proactively.

• Support waste management and recycling procedures according to hotel standards.

• Collaborate effectively with Culinary and Food & Beverage teams to ensure operational efficiency.

• Maintain a positive, professional, and team-oriented attitude.

title: Hatósági ellenőrzés szakértő
description:
Hatósági ellenőrzés szakértő

Dolgozz velünk a MOL Dunai Finomító Karbantartás szervezeténél a Műszaki Felügyelet csapatában, légy aktív tagja az ország legnagyobb és legkomplexebb ipari létesítmény üzemeltetésének, vegyél részt a több, mint 500 atmoszférikus tárolótartály, 3000 nyomástartó edény és a hozzá kapcsolódó csővezetéki rendszer megbízható működéséhez szükséges feladatok elvégzésében.

Vezető energetikai vállalatként a Karbantartás szervezetnél történő munkavégzés egyszerre jelent változatosságot és folyamatos kihívásokat.

Gyere hozzánk szakértőnek, ha\:

  • Ismerve a jogszabályokat, betartod és képes vagy betartatni azokat másokkal is
  • Érdekel a karbantartási nagyleállások világa, a berendezések állapota és szinten tartása
  • Képes vagy összefüggéseiben látni a berendezések állapotát befolyásoló folyamatokat
  • Szeretnéd megismerni / megérteni a vas és a közeg közti kapcsolatot
  • Képes vagy módszereket a valós helyzetre adaptálva alkalmazni
  • Egy új probléma neked kihívást és érdekes új feladatot jelent

A munkakör célja\:

A MOL Nyrt. tároló, termelő és szolgáltató üzemeinek műszaki biztonsági követelményeinek és rendelkezésre állásának biztosítása a jogszabályi, szabványi előírások alapján elvégzett időszakos vizsgálatokkal, az ezeket támogató szakértői szoftverek üzemeltetése, aktuálisan tartása.

Ezek a feladatok várnak Rád\:

  • Elvégzed a nyomástartó berendezések és az atmoszférikus tárolótartályok ellenőrzéseit üzemi környezetben, betartva/betartatva a jogszabályi, szabványi és egyéb előírásokat, ellenőrzöd a berendezések nyomáspróba vizsgálatait.
  • Felelős vagy a jogszabályokban előírt ellenőrzések szakszerű, reprodukálható, azonosítható és nyomon követhető dokumentálásáért, valamint az általad elkészített jelentések tartalmi, formai megfelelőségéért.
  • Részt veszel az AIM (Asset Integrity Management) rendszer implementációjában és működtetésében.
  • Együttműködsz a nyomástartó rendszerekhez és atmoszférikus tárolótartályokhoz kapcsolódó feladatok elvégzésében, a hatósági engedélyeztetési feladatok ellátásában.

Elvárások\:

  • Szakirányú (gépészmérnöki) egyetemi vagy főiskolai végzettség
  • Magabiztos MS Office ismeret
  • Felelősségtudat, önállóság, megbízhatóság, precizitás, csapatmunka
  • Érdekérvényesítő, jó kommunikációs képesség
  • Magas szintű tulajdonosi szemlélet
  • „B” kategóriás jogosítvány

Előnyt jelent\:

  • Nyomástartó berendezés vizsgálói képesítés
  • Tartályvizsgálói képesítés és vizuális anyagvizsgáló-2 képesítések megléte
  • AutoCad felhasználószintű ismerete
  • Olajipari/vegyipari rendszerek ismerete
  • Karbantartási területen szerzett tapasztalat

Amit ajánlunk\:

  • Versenyképes fizetés és kiemelkedő juttatási csomag, 13. havi fizetéssel
  • Évi bruttó 800.000 Ft cafeteria
  • Stabil munkahely, hosszútávú karrierlehetőségek
  • Komplex, kihívást jelentő munka egy profi csapat tagjaként
  • Szakmai és egyéb képzések biztosítása
  • Élet- és balesetbiztosítás a munkaviszonya teljes időtartama alatt
  • Egészségbiztosítás\: Széleskörű járóbeteg ellátás és alapvető éves szűrések alanyi jogon exkluzív magánklinikákon és egészségügyi intézményekben, támogatva a tudatos egészségmegőrzést.

A MOL Csoportnál tudjuk, hogy erősségünk a sokszínűségben rejlik. A kiválasztási eljárás során minden megfelelő képesítéssel és munkatapasztalattal rendelkező pályázónak egyenlő esélyeket biztosítunk az életkorra, nemre, fogyatékosságra, illetve megváltozott munkaképességre, szexuális irányultságra, vagy etnikumra való tekintet nélkül. A MOL Csoportnál mindenki számít.

Ha a toborzási folyamat bármelyik lépésénél a megváltozott munkaképességével kapcsolatos speciális igénye van, kérjük, jelezze ezt a toborzó csapatunknak! Szívesen segítünk.

title: Hemstädspersonal - Oxelösund
description:
Aleo Omsorg är ett familjeägt företag som erbjuder hemtjänst, boendestöd och hemservice. Vår vision är att skapa trygghet och självständighet för våra kunder, med omsorg från hjärtat. Hos oss får du arbeta i ett engagerat team med nära stöd, kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och moderna arbetsverktyg.

Har du erfarenhet av hemstäd eller lokalvård? Är du en person som trivs med att skapa ordning och bidra till en trivsam och ren miljö för andra? Då kan du vara den vi söker till vårt glädjefyllda team på Aleo! Just nu söker vi en flexibel och självgående städare till våra kunder i Oxelösund.

Tjänstgöring och anställningsvillkor

Tjänstgöring: tisdag till fredag
Tjänstgöringsgrad: Behovsanställning
Arbetstid: 08.00 - 16.45
Arbetsplats: du utgår från vårt kontor i Oxelösund

Arbetsuppgifter - Vad kommer du att göra?

I rollen som städare kan arbetsuppgifterna komma att variera utifrån kundens behov. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter som kan ingå:

  • Hemstädning - regelbunden städning i hemmet enligt schema.

  • Fönsterputs - rengöring av fönster.

  • Flyttstäd - grundlig städning av hela bostaden inför inflyt eller utflytt.

  • Social samvaro - vara ett socialt stöd för kunden.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har hjärtat på rätt ställe och trivs med att arbeta nära människor. För att passa hos oss ser vi gärna att du har följande egenskaper och kvalifikationer:

  • Erfarenhet inom städning - van vid hemstäd, flyttstäd eller fönsterputs.

  • Flexibilitet & pålitlighet - du kan hoppa in med kort varsel och är någon vi kan lita på i arbetet.

  • Servicekänsla & självständighet - du har ett varmt bemötande och god förståelse för kundens behov, samtidigt som du arbetar tryggt och effektivt på egen hand.

  • Noggrannhet & ansvarstagande - du tar ditt arbete på allvar, har öga för detaljer och ser till att arbetet blir ordentligt utfört.

  • Stresstålighet - du kan hantera pressade situationer med lugn.

  • Digital vana - du är bekväm med att använda mobiltelefon och andra digitala system i ditt arbete.

  • B-körkort - du är en trygg och van bilförare som kan orientera dig väl i trafiken.

  • Cykelvana - du är trygg och van cyklist.

  • Flytande i svenska - du behärskar svenska i både tal och skrift.

Vi tar ej emot ansökningar per mejl.

title: Optics Technician
description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Role Overview

Role:

At IonQ, we’re building quantum computers by combining trapped-ion technology with modern microwave engineering. In this role, you’ll contribute directly to the technical projects that support those systems.

We’re searching for a Technician to join our growing Optical Manufacturing team to provide assistance with the control of parts and hands-on building of our sub-assemblies. You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists and senior technicians supporting the logistics and assembly of our quantum systems.

Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for supporting our optics team with system builds, upgrades and ongoing research projects for our quantum computers.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include providing hands-on support through optical, mechanical and electrical assembly, ensuring a tidy and safe lab and workshop environment, as well as producing and maintaining technical documentation.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the optics team with system builds, upgrades and ongoing research projects for our quantum computers.
  • Providing hands-on support through optical, mechanical and electrical assembly.
  • Maintaining a tidy and safe lab and workshop environment.
  • Producing and maintaining technical documentation.

Requirements:

You will need practical technical skills and experience in a similar environment. Alongside hands-on skills, you should demonstrate a proactive approach, excellent attention to detail and a willingness to collaborate effectively within a technical team.

We’re looking for relevant industrial operations experience (approx. 3 years), experience following work instructions to complete advanced technical assembly tasks, and experience working in an assembly environment requiring personal protective equipment (PPE).

You’d be a great fit with:

  • Further qualifications such as an advanced modern apprenticeship (Level 3) in Engineering or equivalent industrial experience.
  • Experience working with fibre optics, optics, electronics or vacuum.
  • Experience assembling high-precision or delicate parts, handling optics and using lasers.
  • Previous experience assembling and testing scientific instrumentation.

The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Piha-, koti ja mökkitalkkari lisätulona - Helppo yrittäjämalli ilman kiinteitä kuluja
description:
Haluatko ansaita joustavasti ja tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Tarjoamme sinulle helpon yrittäjämallin, jossa voit toimia omassa kunnassasi tai lähialueellasi täysin oman elämäntilanteesi mukaan. Haemme yrittäjää Lohjalle ja Kirkkonummelle.

  • Ei aloituskustannuksia

  • Ei kiinteitä kuluja

  • Ei sitoutumista

  • Päätät itse työmäärän, hinnat ja aikataulut

Voit aloittaa kevyesti ja halutessasi laajentaa yrittäjyyttä - samalla auttaen perheitä ja senioreita arjessa.

Sopii sinulle, jos haluat:

  • lisätuloja työn, eläkkeen tai opiskelun rinnalle juuri sen verran kuin sinulle sopii

  • kasvattaa omaa asiakaskuntaa vähitellen ja päättää itse, paljonko teet töitä

  • aloittaa yrittäjyyden kevyesti ja ilman isoja alkuinvestointeja

  • täydentää nykyistä yritystoimintaa joustavalla lisäansaintamallilla

  • tehdä merkityksellistä työtä auttamalla senioreita ja perheitä omalla alueella

Mitä palveluita voit tarjota?

Voit tarjota asiakkaille laajastitalkkaripalveluita ja pihatöitä, kuten esimerkiksi:

  • pihanhoitoa ja lumitöitä

  • kiinnitys- ja asennusapua

  • huonekalujen kasausta ja pieniä korjaustöitä

  • kiinteistöhuoltoon liittyviä tehtäviä

  • terassin, pihakalusteiden ja rännien huoltoa

  • pieniä pintaremontteja (maalaus, tapetointi yms.)

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Valmiin ja helpon yrittäjämallin ilman kiinteitä kuluja

  • Sähköiset työkalut: ajanvaraus, verkkokauppa, automatisoitu maksuliikenne

  • Markkinoinnin tuki ja näkyvyys omalla alueellasi et jää yksin

  • Selkeät ohjeet ja jatkuva tuki aloittamiseen ja toiminnan pyörittämiseen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • halua auttaa asiakkaita, erityisesti senioreita ja perheitä

  • oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullista työotetta

  • sujuvaa suomen kieltä

  • kunnossa olevia luottotietoja

Aloittaminen on helppoa Aloitat silloin kun sinulle sopii täysin vapaasti ja ilman sitoutumista. Lähetä meille lyhyt viesti itsestäsi tai täytä hakemus. Voit tilata esitteemme, jos haluat ensin lisätietoa.

Tervetuloa mukaan auttamaan oman alueesi asiakkaita ja rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopiva yrittäjyys.

title: Lead Engineer till Arabelle Solutions
description:
Är du en erfaren ingenjör som vill vara med och forma framtidens energilösningar och verkligen göra skillnad?

Som Lead Engineer inom Repair & Development på Arabelle Solutions rapporterar du direkt till Core Service Generator Engineering Leader som sitter lokalt på kontoret i Västerås och ansvarar för ett team på ca 10 ingenjörer.

  • Leda ett tekniskt område, inklusive men inte begränsat till; statordesign, reparationer och statorunderhåll

  • Stödja säljteamet med teknisk expertis och delta i kundmöten för att identifiera och utveckla nya affärsmöjligheter
  • Bygga och utveckla starka relationer med både interna team och externa kunder, särskilt på lokala marknader
  • Säkerställa att hälsa, säkerhet och miljö alltid prioriteras i design- och underhållsprocesser
  • Delta i strategiska initiativ för att stärka vår position inom generatorservice

Vi söker dig som

  • Är utbildad Civilingenjör inom maskinteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande
  • Har minst 7 års erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion, gärna inom generatorer (drift, underhåll, tillverkning och design)
  • Har praktisk förståelse för material och materialval, samt kan bedöma tekniska alternativ
  • Dokumenterad förmåga att ta ledarskap, driva initiativ och fatta välgrundade beslut

  • Har erfarenhet av internationella och tvärkulturella projekt, gärna med distribuerade specialist- och tillverkningsteam.

Som person kan du beskrivas som kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du har både förmåga att förklara och förenkla komplexa tekniska ämnen, och pragmatisk inställning med starkt kund- och utvecklingsfokus.

Vill du vara en del av ett företag som bryr sig inte bara om morgondagen, utan också om framtida generationer? Då är detta din möjlighet!

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Winona och Arabelle Solutions önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten hanteras av vår konsult Sandra Isojärvi, ++sandra.isojarvi@winonagroup.com++, och Researchers Amanda Eneberg och Emeli Bergenhag, ++emeli.bergenhag@winonagroup.com++. title: Research Software Engineer
description:

At Mistral AI, we believe in the power of AI to simplify tasks, save time, and enhance learning and creativity. Our technology is designed to integrate seamlessly into daily working life. We democratize AI through high-performance, optimized, open-source and cutting-edge models, products and solutions.
