title: Skiftgående kontrollrumsingenjör
description:
Vattenfall Vattenkraft ansvarar för Vattenfalls 90 vattenkraftverk och ca 300 dammar i Norden. Vi är ca 580 medarbetare i Sverige och Finland med huvudkontor i Luleå. Vattenkraftens förnybara elproduktion är en förutsättning för att skapa ett klimatsmart samhälle där vi spelar en viktig roll som möjliggörare för framtidens hållbara energisystem. Vår produktion motsvarar ca 25 procent av Sveriges totala elbehov. För att leverera hög tillgänglighet i vår produktion behöver vi ständigt utmana oss själva, utveckla våra arbetssätt och ta tillvara digitala möjligheter.

Nu söker vi en skiftgående kontrollrumsingenjör till vår produktionscentral i Bispgården!

Hos oss kommer du att arbeta i händelsernas centrum. Från den här produktionscentralen ansvarar vi för fjärrstyrning och övervakning av Vattenfalls vattenkraftverk i Ångermanälven, Indalsälven, Gimån, Dalälven, Göta älv och våra småskaliga kraftstationer samt fiskodlingar.

Arbetet i en produktionscentral innebär att man hela tiden är involverad med olika parter, både internt och externt. Vi är en servicefunktion och navet mellan efterfrågan och leverans av fossilfri elproduktion från vattenkraft. Arbetet innebär mycket kommunikation via olika stödsystem, telefon och mail.

Vi är ett engagerat team som bemannar produktionscentralen dygnet runt. Vi arbetar både i team och på egen hand. Ensamarbetet ställer krav på att du är trygg i din roll och att du arbetar noggrant utifrån givna rutiner och instruktioner.

Som kontrollrumsingenjör arbetar du med att:

  • Fjärrstyra och övervaka vattenkraftanläggningar och tillhörande dammar
  • Säkerställa att verksamheten följer gällande vattenhushållningsbestämmelser
  • Agera driftledare för el- och vattenvägsarbeten inom angivna kopplingsgränser
  • Hantera driftorder och inkommande arbetsbegäran
  • Följa upp och rapportera produktionsstatistik för våra vattenkraftanläggningar
  • Bidra till utvecklingen av gemensamma arbetssätt och processer som stärker kontrollrumsverksamheten.

Vi erbjuder

Som ny medarbetare får du en grundlig introduktion med interna utbildningar och stöd från erfarna kollegor. Det hjälper dig att snabbt komma in i rollen. Introduktionen kan också omfatta besök vid vattenkraftanläggningarna i ditt ansvarsområde och vid vår produktionscentral i norra Sverige.

Kravspecifikation

Vi söker dig som är trygg, strukturerad och kommunikativ. Du kommer att arbeta med ett flertal olika system och hantera mycket information, det är därför viktigt att du har en bra IT- och telefonvana och att du kan behålla stabilitet och ordning kring ditt arbete, även i mer pressade lägen.

I grunden har du elkraftsteknisk utbildning, gärna på högskolenivå, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av produktions-/drifttekniskt arbete, elproduktion och vattenkraft. Erfarenhet av att arbeta som operatör eller ingenjör i driftcentral/kontrollrum är ett plus. Du talar och skriver både svenska och engelska. Du behöver B-körkort då resor i tjänsten förekommer.

Placeringsort

Bispgården i Ragunda kommun, arbetstiderna kräver att du bor inom pendlingsavstånd från produktionscentralen.

Kontaktpersoner

För frågor om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Elias Kelloniemi. Fackliga representanter är Anneli Jönsson Ledarna, Samuel Jernlif Unionen, Magnus Nilsson Akademikerna och Fredrik Lidholm SEKO. Alla nås via Vattenfalls växel, 08-739 50 00.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Ansök via vår annons på Vattenfalls karriärsidor senast 15 oktober, 2026. Du svarar på några inledande frågor och bifogar ditt CV, du behöver inte inkludera ett personligt brev. Inom rekryteringsprocessen kan tester förekomma.

På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här https://careers.vattenfall.com/se/sv/mangfald-jamstalldhet-inkludering

Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade och du kan komma att bli krigsplacerad. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.

title: Kallskänka till Brogyllen Hamngatan

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Want to build the cloud platform that powers digital access for hotels around the world?

Every day, hotels rely on secure digital access to manage guests, staff, and connected services. At ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions in Stockholm, our Hospitality R&D team develops the cloud-native platforms behind there experiences.

We are looking for you, who wants to take ownership, work close to the product, and build solutions used by hospitality customers across the globe. This is an opportunity to make a real impact while working in a collaborative team that values innovation and continuous development.

What you would do as our Backend Developer

You would help design, build, and evolve the cloud-based services that power digital access, permissions, and identity management across our Vostio hospitality platform. Your work would span software development, cloud infrastructure, production operations, and continuous improvement, giving you the opportunity to contribute to a critical product area. You would join a small, high-impact team responsible for the services, APIs, and integrations that enable hotels to manage access rights and user identities securely.

You would also:

• Build cloud-native backend services — Design and develop Kotlin-based services that support digital access, permissions, and identity management.

• Own core platform functionality — Deliver features that enable hotels to manage access rights, user permissions, and authentication capabilities from design through production.

• Build APIs and integrations — Create and evolve APIs, integrations, and microservice-based capabilities that connect products, customers, and internal systems across the hospitality ecosystem.• Design cloud-native solutions on AWS — Build scalable and resilient services using AWS, automation, and modern CI/CD practices.

• Take responsibility beyond coding — You would be involved in technical design discussions, production support, continuous improvement initiatives, and helping shape how the platform evolves over time.

The skills and experience you need

We are looking for someone with:

• Experience building backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or Golang.

• Hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating solutions in AWS.

• Experience with microservice-based, distributed, or integration-heavy systems, including strong API design skills.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and modern software engineering practices, combined with a pragmatic engineering mindset.

• The ability to simplify complex technical problems, communicate clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.

Nice to have: AWS services such as Cognito, ECS, SNS/SQS or CloudFormation; experience with SaaS platforms, or access management solutions.

Why developers join and stay

• Small team, meaningful impact. Every engineer contributes directly to product decisions, technical solutions, and delivery.

• End-to-end ownership. You'll work on features from idea through production and see the impact of your work firsthand.

• Modern technology stack. The role focuses on Kotlin, AWS, cloud-native services, microservices, and automation.• Product-focused development. Work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to solve real customer challenges.

• Stockholm-based team with global reach, the systems you build are used by hotels around the world every day.

What we offer

We're passionate about providing opportunities and benefits that support your development and long-term success. Here's what we have to offer:

• Learning and career development opportunities, whether through online learning, technical training, or new challenges.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• Hybrid working and a collaborative engineering environment.• The opportunity to contribute to innovative products used by customers around the world.

We review applications regularly, so don't wait

We are building diverse, inclusive teams and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us.

To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at lea.rein@assaabloy.com.

Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Principal Python + LangGraph Engineer
description:
Engagement context

We are partnering with a US-based health-tech company on the takeover of a production AI-powered mobile coaching platform. The platform is built around a Python AI core (atlas-ai) which runs:

  • A FastAPI chat surface with intent routing and tool-using agents
  • A LangGraph-based agent framework with multi-agent orchestration
  • A Celery + Redis task queue for asynchronous agent flows
  • MongoDB for fitness-plan storage, Redis for conversation state, Postgres for LangGraph checkpoints
  • Several agent personas: onboarding, chat, plan creation, in-workout smart adjust, plan smart adjust, habit formation
  • Direct OpenAI integration for the LLM layer

This is the product. If the AI core breaks, the product breaks. If LLM token cost runs away, our margin runs away. If the agent flows behave unpredictably under load, real users get bad coaching.

Role summary

As Principal AI Engineer you are the technical owner of the AI core. You lead the audit of the existing codebase, define the architecture we evolve toward, build the test and evaluation harness that lets us ship changes safely, and you are the engineer who is paged when the AI surface misbehaves in production.

You will be the deciding voice on whether we can responsibly take this service in our scope or whether we keep the client's original team embedded longer. The audit conclusions you write in the first 4 weeks will inform the contractual scope of the entire engagement.

Offer:

  • Location: 100% remote
  • Engagement: B2B
  • Rate: upt to PLN 180 p/h
  • Start: asap

Must-have skills

  • 7+ years Python in production at senior+ level
  • Deep LangGraph experience — state graphs, checkpoints, interrupts, multi-agent supervision, subgraphs
  • Strong LangChain ecosystem knowledge (chains, tools, memory, output parsers, callbacks)
  • Production FastAPI — streaming responses, dependency injection, middleware, async patterns
  • Celery + Redis broker in production — task ordering, retries, idempotency, priority queues, dead-letter handling
  • Concurrency in Python — asyncio (gather, structured concurrency, cancellation), threading boundaries, mixing sync and async code safely
  • Multi-datastore operations — MongoDB + Redis + Postgres in a single service, transaction boundaries across them
  • OpenAI API at scale — rate limits, retries with exponential backoff, fallback model routing, streaming, tool/function calling
  • Agent design patterns — ReAct, plan-and-execute, supervisor patterns, tool-use loops, multi-turn state, interrupt resumption
  • Prompt engineering with discipline — evaluation, A/B testing, version control of prompts, regression detection
  • Token cost optimisation — prompt caching (Anthropic-style), model tiering, context window trimming, summary memory
  • Production LLM observability — per-route token spend, prompt-level tracing, drift monitoring
  • Testing discipline — pytest (including pytest-asyncio), property-based testing, snapshot tests for prompts, eval-based tests for agents
  • Pydantic v2 fluency, type-hinted code throughout

Nice-to-haves

  • RAG production experience (vector stores: Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector)
  • Production incident command for LLM-powered systems
  • ML engineering background (model serving, feature engineering)
  • Anthropic / Claude API experience in addition to OpenAI
  • Data pipeline experience (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)
  • Domain knowledge in fitness / health / wearables
  • Experience working with cross-team JSI / native bridges (the Python core integrates with a mobile JSI layer)

title: Director of Operations | Naperville, Illinois
description:
Director of Operations | Naperville, Illinois

About the Organization

Forrest Behavioral Health is a growing behavioral health treatment organization serving individuals with substance use disorders, mental health conditions, and co-occurring diagnoses.

As the organization continues to expand, Forrest Behavioral Health is preparing to open its newest Illinois location in Naperville. The organization is focused on creating treatment environments where strong clinical care, thoughtful operations, accountability, and a positive patient and employee experience work together.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead the day-to-day operations of Forrest Behavioral Health Illinois South, our newest location in Naperville, Illinois.

This is a highly involved facility leadership position for someone who understands the operational realities of behavioral healthcare and is comfortable stepping into different areas of the program as needs arise.

The Director of Operations will have direct responsibility for several functions central to the patient experience and facility performance, including intakes, staffing and scheduling, utilization review coordination, admissions, discharges, and AMA situations.

As part of a new location, this individual will also play an important role in establishing strong operational practices, supporting the team, and helping ensure Forrest's existing operating model is implemented consistently from the start.

This is not a behind-the-desk management role. The person in this position will be expected to understand what is happening throughout the facility, identify problems early, support the team, and step in when necessary to keep operations moving.

Who Thrives Here

The strongest fit is someone who genuinely cares about recovery and behavioral healthcare and brings energy, accountability, and a willingness to work alongside the team.

You understand that strong facility operations require attention to both people and performance. You can hold employees accountable while maintaining a positive culture, communicate effectively across admissions and clinical teams, and recognize operational problems before they become larger issues.

You are also comfortable getting into the details. Whether the need involves an intake, staffing challenge, utilization review issue, difficult discharge, referral relationship, or patient experience concern, you are willing to get involved and help find a solution.

This is an opportunity for someone with directly relevant behavioral health experience who wants meaningful ownership of a facility's day-to-day success and the opportunity to help establish and grow a new location.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the day-to-day operational functions of the Naperville facility
  • Conduct the majority of patient intakes and help ensure a smooth transition into treatment
  • Maintain direct responsibility for facility staffing and scheduling
  • Manage and coordinate utilization review activities
  • Maintain operational oversight of admissions, discharges, and AMA situations
  • Communicate closely with admissions, clinical, and other facility team members
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with referral sources and facility partners
  • Identify operational problems early and implement practical solutions
  • Step into different areas of facility operations when additional support is needed
  • Establish clear expectations and help hold staff accountable while contributing to a positive workplace culture
  • Support census, patient retention, and the overall patient experience
  • Help ensure consistent execution of organizational policies, workflows, and operational expectations
  • Partner with organizational leadership on facility performance and improvement initiatives
  • Support the successful establishment and continued growth of Forrest Behavioral Health Illinois South


Requirements

Required:

  • Direct professional experience within substance use disorder and/or mental health treatment
  • Operational or leadership experience within a behavioral health treatment environment
  • Working knowledge of behavioral health facility operations and levels of care such as PHP, IOP, OP, residential, detox, or similar treatment settings
  • Experience with one or more core operational functions such as patient intake, admissions, utilization review, staffing, scheduling, discharges, census management, or patient retention
  • Ability and willingness to maintain an active, visible presence in day-to-day facility operations
  • Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively across admissions, clinical, and operational teams
  • Ability to hold team members accountable while contributing to a collaborative and positive workplace culture
  • Commitment to behavioral healthcare, recovery, and a strong patient experience

Preferred:

  • Previous Director of Operations, Executive Director, Program Director, or comparable behavioral health leadership experience
  • Experience supporting the opening, launch, or growth of a behavioral health treatment program
  • Experience coordinating utilization review and insurance authorization processes
  • Experience managing patient admissions, discharges, and AMA situations
  • Experience managing behavioral health staffing and scheduling
  • Experience supporting census growth and patient retention
  • Established understanding of referral relationships within behavioral healthcare


Benefits

Compensation and Schedule

  • Salary: $90,000–$100,000 annually, commensurate with directly relevant experience
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–4:30 PM
  • Location: Naperville, Illinois
  • Travel: None required

Additional Benefits

  • Employer contribution toward health insurance premium
  • Performance incentive opportunities available after 90 days
  • Hands-on leadership role with meaningful ownership of facility operations
  • Opportunity to help establish and grow Forrest Behavioral Health's newest Illinois location
  • Opportunity to work closely with organizational leadership
  • Mission-driven environment focused on both patient care and employee experience

This opportunity is posted by Atlantic Health Strategies on behalf of Forrest Behavioral Health.

title: Software Engineer – Query Engines
description:
A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world’s hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimized, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
You will own improvements from design through production, whether that means developing a planning rule, extending a native execution engine, or improving the way large tables are scanned and updated. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build. A change in a shared engine can benefit applications across the platform and the people who rely on them.
Join us if you want to advance the capabilities of modern data systems and apply that work to consequential problems.

Technologies We Use

  • Java, Scala, Rust, and Python
  • Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution
  • Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability
  • Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Cargo, and GitHub.

Core Responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing query planning and optimization capabilities that turn complex computations into efficient execution plans
  • Extending execution engines with new capabilities and improving query operators, parallelism, memory management, and data movement
  • Developing Foundry’s Iceberg catalog and engine integrations, including table metadata, transactions, and efficient reads and writes
  • Building shared transformation semantics and execution interfaces for workloads across Foundry’s products and platform services
  • Improving incremental processing so pipelines can reuse previous results and process new data efficiently while preserving correctness
  • Evaluating and integrating advances in open-source data systems, validating their behavior and performance against real-world workloads
  • Investigating correctness and performance issues across planning, execution, and storage, and building tests and benchmarks that prevent regressions
  • Working with product teams and customers to translate operational needs into engine capabilities that integrate with Foundry’s security, data management, and build infrastructure.

What We Value

  • Ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness. Our systems support decisions and operations that customers depend on.
  • Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimizers and execution operators to table formats and distributed processing.
  • Strong debugging skills and motivation to follow a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack.
  • A practical approach to performance, grounded in profiling, representative workloads, and measurable improvements.
  • Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who use and depend on our software.
  • Experience building or extending systems such as Spark, DataFusion, Iceberg, or comparable technologies, and an interest in learning across the stack.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and work effectively with the open-source projects we build on. Experience contributing to open-source projects is valued, but not required.

What We Require

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems.
  • Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in one or more languages such as Java, Rust, Scala, or C++.
  • Experience developing database engines, distributed data processing systems, storage systems, or comparable infrastructure, with depth in areas such as query planning, execution, or performance optimization.
  • Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency, with experience diagnosing correctness and performance problems in complex systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality.
Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 - $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Benefits

Life at Palantir

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. title: Direct Fulfilment Supervisor (Weekends)
description:
If you love beauty, you’re in the right place.

As the ultimate curator of over 100 of the most in-demand, highly innovative and boundary-pushing beauty brands, we are the go-to destination for worldwide beauty discovery.

Together through our neighbourhood stores, online presence and loyalty scheme, Space NK has built a flourishing community in which to discover beauty. The customer is at the heart of everything we do, and we will always endeavour to offer everything they need to help them explore, experiment, and enjoy our brands.

Direct Fulfilment Supervisor (Weekends)

  • Lead the weekend operation. Keep fulfilment moving. Build a team proud to deliver.

  • Location: Space NK Distribution Centre

  • Department: Distribution

  • Reports to: Direct Fulfilment Manager

  • Working pattern 37.5 hours across 4 days per week, including weekend working

The Role

The Direct Fulfilment Supervisor is a hands-on operational leader responsible for delivering safe, accurate and productive customer order fulfilment across picking, packing and dispatch. Leading a large team of operatives, you will turn the agreed plan into clear shift priorities, maintain pace throughout the day and ensure orders are completed to the required quality and service standards.

Working with a high level of autonomy at weekends, you will take ownership from the management handover, make sound operational decisions, resolve issues as they arise and provide a clear, accurate handback on Monday. Just as importantly, you will create an environment where people understand what good looks like, take pride in their work and are recognised for the energy and commitment they bring.

What you will be responsible for

· Lead the shift: Translate the operational plan and management handover into clear priorities, resource deployment and achievable team targets.

· Drive productivity: Maintain the pulse of the operation throughout the shift, using WMS data and floor observation to track progress, identify constraints and take timely action.

· Deliver service and accuracy: Ensure customer orders are picked, packed and dispatched accurately, safely and within agreed service commitments.

· Lead and engage people: Brief, coach and motivate a large team of operatives, setting clear expectations, giving regular feedback and recognising great contribution.

· Manage performance fairly: Address gaps in standards, attendance, conduct or capability promptly and consistently, escalating or partnering with management and People teams when required.

· Own weekend continuity: Operate confidently without close day-to-day supervision, protecting operational momentum and escalating material risks through the agreed channels.

· Manage handovers: Receive, clarify and act on the incoming handover, then provide a concise Monday handback covering output, backlog, people, stock, systems, incidents and required follow-up.

· Troubleshoot WMS and pick issues: Investigate failed or incomplete picks, stock or location discrepancies, scanner and workflow issues, resolving first-line problems and escalating effectively where needed.

· Apply sound stock-flow judgement: Balance workload across pick, pack and dispatch, working with Inventory, Administration and other DC teams to remove barriers and maintain flow.

· Plan resources: Allocate people to demand, flex the team as priorities change and ensure breaks, skills coverage and workload are managed effectively.

· Maintain standards: Ensure compliance with health and safety, security, loss prevention, housekeeping, quality and all relevant company procedures.

· Improve the operation: Identify recurring issues and practical opportunities to improve safety, accuracy, productivity, colleague experience and customer outcomes.

What success looks like

· A safe, well-controlled and visibly led shift.

· Customer orders delivered on time, in full and to the required quality standard.

· Productivity and workflow remain on track, with issues identified and acted on early.

· The team has clear direction, receives feedback and feels recognised for strong performance.

· Accurate, useful handovers enable continuity between weekday and weekend leadership.

· WMS, stock and process issues are resolved at the right level or escalated with clear facts and ownership.

Experience and Knowledge

· Previous experience as a Supervisor or experienced Team Leader in a busy medium-sized or large distribution centre, warehouse or fulfilment operation.

· Proven experience leading sizeable operational teams in picking, packing and outbound fulfilment.

· Experience in a blended manual and automated warehouse environment.

· Confident user of a Warehouse Management System, with practical experience resolving pick, stock-flow or system-related exceptions.

· Strong understanding of productivity, accuracy, service, labour deployment and shift management in a fast-moving operation.

· Good working knowledge of warehouse health and safety, security, housekeeping and operational compliance.

· Confident and proficient using workplace IT, including WMS terminals or handheld devices, email and standard reporting tools.

Skills and Personal Approach

· A visible, calm and credible people leader who is comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

· Able to set pace without compromising safety, accuracy or respect for colleagues.

· Strong judgement and practical problem-solving skills, particularly when priorities compete or information is incomplete.

· Clear communicator who can brief large teams, give constructive feedback and produce concise written handovers.

· Organised and data-aware, with the ability to interpret operational information and turn it into action.

· Resilient, flexible and comfortable working independently during weekend operations.

· Genuinely motivated by building pride in task, recognising effort and helping people perform at their best.

· Able to communicate effectively in spoken and written English to support safe working, team leadership, system use and operational handovers.

Key Working Relationships

· Direct Fulfilment Manager and fellow Direct Fulfilment Supervisor

· Distribution Centre management team

· Inventory and Administration teams

· Retail Fulfilment, Goods In, Returns and Replenishment teams

· Technology, systems support and carrier partners, as required

Additional expectations

The role is based on site within a busy Distribution Centre and requires regular presence on the warehouse floor. The postholder will need to work the agreed four-day pattern, including weekends, and remain flexible when operational demand requires reasonable changes to priorities or hours. Duties may evolve in line with the needs of the operation, provided they remain appropriate to the level and purpose of the role.

Please note that only successful candidates will be contacted.

All applicants must have the right to live and work in the UK.

If you want to find out more about us, what it is like to work for us, all about our benefits, and our pledges on Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging, please visit our website.

Space NK are an equal opportunities employer.

How We Will Use Your Information

We will use the information you provide to us with your job application to help us process your application for the specific job you have applied for. If you apply speculatively, we will process your application for the job/relevant business area that you detail within your email.

Please note that our current system does not use an automated filtering system.

All applications made via the website, through a third-party website or in-store will be kept on file for a period of 12 months.

This information will be retained and used to assess your suitability to similar positions that may arise in the future, or if the initial vacancy becomes live again during the 12-month period. If you would prefer us to not hold your information on file/ you wish to be ‘forgotten’ if you are not offered a position with Space NK, please email your ‘right to be forgotten’ to our recruitment email address with RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN as the title of the email. We will always inform you when we have deleted your application details, otherwise we will treat your application as consent to us holding this information.

title: Patient Service Representative - Allouez
description:

Patient Service Representative

Education Qualifications

Experience Qualifications

Skills and Abilities

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform
description:
Mission Summary

The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:

  • Data Processing: We are building state-of-the-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user-friendly, and highly fault-tolerant.
  • Data Discovery: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
  • Data Lineage: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
  • Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
  • Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
  • Lead and champion high-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
  • Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
  • Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
  • Experience with distributed system design and development
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, continuous delivery environment

Bonus Points (not required):

  • Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
  • Experience working in cross-functional development teams
  • Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus
#LI-JL1

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. title: Ekobrottsutredare Göteborg
description:
Ekobrottsmyndigheten förebygger, upptäcker, avbryter, utreder och lagför ekonomiska brott. Våra 850 medarbetare har olika kompetenser och yrkesroller, såsom åklagare, poliser, ekobrottsutredare, administratörer och andra specialister, som alla arbetar tillsammans mot ekobrott. Det är vår unika styrka. 1 plats(er).

Vill du bli en av oss och bidra till att bekämpa den ekonomiska brottsligheten? Vi söker nu en ekobrottsutredare till kamrarna i Göteborg. Hos oss får du möjlighet att tillsammans med engagerade kollegor vara med och bidra till att förebygga och bekämpa ekonomisk brottslighet samtidigt som du får goda möjligheter till egen utveckling.

Arbetsplats

Vid Ekobrottsmyndigheten i Göteborg bedrivs verksamheten vid två ekobrottskamrar och en polisoperativ enhet. Till kamrarna i Göteborg söker vi nu en ekobrottsutredare.

Din roll

Som ekobrottsutredare medverkar du i brottsutredningar och arbetar i team där åklagare, administratörer, poliser och andra utredare med särskild kompetens inom exempelvis revision och analys kan ingå. I arbetsuppgifterna igår bland annat att:

  • samla in och sammanställa utredningsmaterial
  • analysera utredningsmaterial och skriva promemorior
  • hålla förhör
  • delta vid tillslag.

Dina kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

  • akademisk examen inom ett för verksamheten relevant område eller motsvarande kunskap och erfarenhet förvärvad på annat sätt och som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
  • minst ett års erfarenhet av kvalificerat utredningsarbete under de senaste fem åren
  • erfarenhet av att hålla förhör
  • erfarenhet av att analysera och strukturera stora mängder information
  • goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift
  • goda datorkunskaper och är en van användare av Microsoft Office-paketet.

När vi anställer lägger vi stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och förmågor. Vi söker dig som är en lagspelare som tar ansvar för helheten och verksamhetens bästa. Du är ansvarstagande, engagerad och prestigelös. Du arbetar strukturerat, noggrant och effektivt samt trivs i en utvecklingsorienterad miljö. Du är även analytisk och pedagogisk. Arbetsuppgifterna ställer krav på god samarbetsförmåga och en positiv inställning till att samarbeta med olika yrkesgrupper såväl internt som externt.

För att lyckas i din roll på Ekobrottsmyndigheten så vill och kan du arbeta i enlighet med myndighetens medarbetarpolicy, EBM-modellen. (https://www.ekobrottsmyndigheten.se/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/ebm-modellen-webbanpassad.pdf)

Det är meriterande med:

  • erfarenhet av att arbeta med utredningar avseende ekonomisk brottslighet
  • kunskaper inom skatterätt
  • kunskaper i bokföring
  • erfarenhet av att arbeta med finansiella utredningar
  • kunskap och erfarenhet av hur en förundersökning bedrivs
  • goda kunskaper i engelska.

Information om anställningen

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning
  • Tjänstebenämning: Utredare
  • Arbetsort: Göteborg
  • Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
  • Lön: Individuell lönesättning tillämpas

På Ekobrottsmyndigheten jobbar vi med att utveckla våra medarbetares kompetens och erbjuder därför ett varierat utbildningsprogram. Det finns goda förutsättningar för kompetensutveckling, friskvård samt en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv.

Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Då tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass kommer en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.

Ansök

Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och svar på våra urvalsfrågor senast den 16 oktober. Av din ansökan ska det framgå på vilket sätt du uppfyller vår kravprofil.

Din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Har du skyddade personuppgifter, referenser eller liknande information som du själv bedömer som skyddsvärd rekommenderar vi dig att du skickar din ansökan märkt med annonsens referensnummer via brev till adressen Ekobrottsmyndigheten, Box 6001 102 31 Stockholm.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning. Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

title: Software Engineer
description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.


How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

  • Platform Ownership: Design, build, and operate the core serverless execution engine and Workflows orchestration layer that serve as foundational primitives for CDF’s AI and automation capabilities.
  • Reliability Engineering: Own uptime, latency SLOs, and incident response for platform services ensuring Functions execute deterministically and Workflows progress without data loss or silent failures.
  • Scalability: Architect for multi-tenant & multi-cloud, high-throughput workloads. Design scheduling, queueing, and retry mechanisms that degrade gracefully under pressure.
  • API Design: Define and evolve clean API-first architecture, versioned REST and event-driven APIs that downstream engineering teams and external customers depend on.
  • Observability: Instrument services with distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting (Open-telemetry / Prometheus / Grafana / Honeycomb stack) so failures surface before customers notice.
  • CI/CD & Testing: Champion test automation - unit, integration, and smoke tests and maintain deployment pipelines that ship to production with confidence.
  • Performance: Profile and resolve bottlenecks in execution throughput, cold-start latencies, and cross-service call chains driving a “snappy” platform experience for industrial workloads.
  • Cost Efficiency (Bonus): Model compute and storage costs for functions execution; identify and implement optimizations that reduce cloud spend without sacrificing reliability.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

  • 3–6 Years of Engineering: Proven track record building and operating production backend services at scale.
  • Expertise: Deep mastery of JVM languages (Kotlin preferred, Java acceptable), Python(FastAPI), distributed systems patterns, and cloud-native service design (Kubernetes, Azure, GCP, AWS, Private cloud).
  • Workflow & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with workflow engines (Conductor, Apache Airflow, or equivalent) and event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub).
  • Data & Storage: Comfortable working with relational databases (PostgreSQL) & non-relational databases, object storage(Data-lakes), and caching layers (Redis) in multi-tenant environments.
  • Observability Stack: Practical experience with Open-telemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana for instrumentation and operational insight.
  • ML Platform Exposure: experience supporting ML workloads & notebooks in production, whether through job scheduling, resource management, experiment tracking integration, or model serving infrastructure.
  • Contextualisation Domain (Bonus): Familiarity with industrial knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, or NLP/CV pipelines as they relate to industrial asset data is a strong differentiator.
  • Full-Stack Awareness (Bonus): Familiarity with React or TypeScript is a plus for consuming and dogfooding your own platform’s developer tooling.
  • The Platform Thinking Spirit: A passion for building composable, well-documented, and automated platform systems that empower other engineers including ML engineers to build faster.

    Nice to have

    ML Platform & Contextualisation:

    • ML Workload Support: Build and extend platform primitives compute scheduling, environment management, and secrets handling, that enable ML engineers to run model training, fine-tuning, and batch inference jobs reliably.
    • Contextualisation Pipelines: Support the engineering infrastructure behind Cognite’s Contextualisation capabilities (entity matching, asset hierarchy inference, P&ID parsing) by ensuring the platform can orchestrate long-running, GPU-aware, and data-intensive ML workflows without manual intervention.
    • Vector & Embedding Infrastructure (Bonus): Familiarity with serving or storing vector embeddings to support semantic search and RAG-based contextualisation use cases.
    • Model Lifecycle Awareness: Understand model versioning, A/B experiment tracking, and the boundary between platform concerns and ML framework concerns, so the platform stays lean while ML teams stay unblocked.
Learn more about us
  • Impact 2025
  • Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
  • We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.
Equal Opportunity
Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

title: Compliance Department Head (Circle Lead)
description:
Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading
digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in
Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we
managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine
customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and
flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better
financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company
with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the
bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)
in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the
country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,
Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who
‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time
of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More about the bank with startup culture environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have
fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow
outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to
work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold
the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise
Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,
have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our
journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

Responsibilities

  • Understand the provisions and regulations set by the Regulator and the applicable laws and regulations regarding bank activities.
  • Review and/or recommend updating and improving the Bank's policies, provisions, systems and procedures with the provisions of regulation and the prevailing laws and regulations.
  • Identify, measure, monitor and control compliance risk with reference to the provisions.
  • Prepare training materials to disseminate information to all Bank employees regarding matters related to the Compliance.
  • Prepare reports on the implementation of the Bank's Compliance function activities to the stakeholder in the Bank and Regulator.
  • Monitoring and ensuring that new provisions/regulations have been distributed to all related work units and inform to related work units on reporting obligations to Regulator.
  • Conduct compliance review and/or checklist on various products and activities and credit with carry out timely, clear and consistent reporting.
  • Disseminate and ensure training materials related to the Compliance Function and APU/PPT

Requirements

  • Candidate must possess at least Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
  • Have knowledge about compliance and anti-money laundering, banking products and services, specifically digital products from Financial Services Institutions
  • 7 Years’ experience and at least 5 years relevant experience
  • Communication, Technical, Computer and Analysis Skill in related area.
  • Good logic and analytical thinking
  • Willingness to learn and high morale
  • Ability to work in a team
We exist to support consumer confidence in the financial system. We design regulatory objectives to protect investors and ensure that markets are fair, efficient, and transparent.

It’s our job to identify risks that an organization faces and advise on how to avoid or address them. We implement controls to protect the organization from those risks. We monitor and report on the effectiveness of controls in the management of the organization's risk exposure. Our monitoring activities also include keeping an eye on business development to keep it within rules made by regulators.

title: QA Team Lead
description:
Millions of users worldwide. Billions in transactions. And one focused team, building high-impact solutions that scale across the globe every single day.

Orbio World is where top minds push the boundaries of global e-commerce. We build scalable systems, set trends, and create products used by millions. Here, ownership is expected, impact is real, and meaningful work takes priority.

Ready to change the game?

Orbio World’s IT Team builds and supports the technology behind our e-commerce brands — from funnels and checkout flows to payments, integrations, internal systems, and new product launches.
We move fast and increasingly use AI and automation to shorten the path from idea to production.

We are looking for a QA Team Lead to own our quality strategy, lead the QA team, strengthen test automation, and help us build a modern, AI-assisted approach to Quality Assurance.
This role is not just about finding bugs. We want someone who can prevent issues, identify risks earlier, automate repetitive work, and continuously improve how quality is built into our development process.

Sounds like an ideal opportunity for someone like yourself?

If so, then get ready to:

  • Own and continuously improve our QA strategy, processes, standards, and tooling;

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the QA team;

  • Build a risk-based testing approach for business-critical areas such as checkout, payments, funnels, integrations, and new brand launches;

  • Own and evolve our test automation strategy, increasing coverage while reducing repetitive manual testing;

  • Define the right balance between manual, automated, API, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing;

  • Drive AI-first Quality Assurance, identifying opportunities to automate or improve QA activities using AI;

  • Experiment with AI for requirements analysis, test generation, test data, regression optimization, and defect analysis;

  • Work closely with Developers and Product/Project Managers to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle;

  • Define meaningful quality metrics and KPIs, analyze production incidents, and turn learnings into improvements;

  • Promote a culture where quality is a shared responsibility across the entire Delivery team.

What success looks like:

Success in this role is not measured by how many bugs the QA team finds. It means fewer critical production issues, faster and safer releases, stronger automation, less repetitive manual testing, earlier risk detection, and increasing use of AI to make QA more effective.

Ultimately, you will help us evolve QA from a traditional testing function into modern Quality Engineering — using automation, data, and AI to help us move faster without sacrificing quality.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience leading a QA team and owning QA processes;

  • Strong understanding of manual and automated testing;

  • Experience building or leading a test automation strategy;

  • Strong knowledge of web, API, integration, and end-to-end testing;

  • Ability to decide what should be automated and where testing creates the most business value;

  • Experience with modern QA tools and CI/CD environments;

  • Strong interest in practical AI applications within software testing and QA;

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment with frequent releases and changing priorities;

  • Strong ownership mindset and drive for continuous improvement.

Now let’s talk perks:

🏖️ Balance that works for you

Take your birthday off, wrap up two hours earlier on Fridays, and enjoy one work-from-home day each week—plus 20 extra remote days from anywhere in the world.

🌟 Grow on your terms

Use your personal budget for courses or conferences. Grab any book you need. Join internal trainings, guest lectures, and more.

🌱 Wellness you can feel

Feel supported with prepaid therapy sessions, personal accident insurance, full annual blood tests and vaccination programs, and private health insurance after 3 months. Sports and wellness events? On us.

🎁 Perks that add up

Earn extra paid vacation days as you grow with us. Celebrate milestones with travel vouchers—€3000 after 5 years and €5000 after 10. Plus meaningful rewards, exclusive deals through, and your choice of free parking or public transport after 3 months.

🏡 Time to recharge & connect

Enjoy a week-long stay each year in our company apartments in Druskininkai or Kunigiškės. Join team-building activities, cross-team experiences, and everything from casual hangs to unforgettable workations.

👪🏼 Support that matters

Welcoming a new family member? We’ve got you with a bonus and flexibility. Called for official training? Take additional paid time off. Want to make an impact? Join Orbio Kids, Orbio Academy, volunteering, and charity initiatives.

💵 Salary

From 5000 Eur/month (gross), depending on individual experience.

Join Orbio World at the forefront of how millions discover, connect, and explore the world like never before.

title: Project Manager
description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

The Opportunity:

At Rimes, the Project Manager is the backbone of structured client delivery — the person who turns agreed scope into a clear, executable plan and sees it through to production. You will own your projects end-to-end, from mobilisation through deployment, coordinating cross-functional Rimes and client teams across design, configuration, data onboarding, testing and go-live.

This is a career-level role within our Professional Services organisation, sitting at the centre of the Solution Delivery sub-function and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Solution Consultants, Implementation Engineers and Solution Architects. You will work independently, bring discipline and client focus to every engagement, and take full accountability for delivery outcomes on your projects.

Responsibilities:

Project Planning & Governance -

  • Own the project plan for your allocated engagements, covering scope, timeline, resource requirements, dependencies, milestones and critical path.
  • Run a structured project kickoff: confirm scope, roles, assumptions and escalation paths in writing with all key stakeholders before delivery begins.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate project governance: regular cadence meetings, clear agendas, documented decisions and tracked actions; distribute meeting notes within 24 hours.
  • Ensure clarity on scope, timelines, budget and contracted deliverables at handoff from pre-sales, establish a definitive baseline before delivery commences.

Scope & Change Management -

  • Manage project scope proactively, identify scope creep early, assess impact formally and work with the Solution Consultant and client through a structured change control process.
  • Ensure requirements are signed off in writing before build begins; manage any post-sign-off changes as formal change requests with full documentation, impact assessment and stakeholder communication.
  • Balance the need to accommodate critical changes with the obligation to protect project timeline and budget.

Risk & Issue Management -

  • Maintain a live risk and issue log throughout the project, reviewed regularly with your delivery team and PS lead.
  • Identify risks at kickoff and monitor them actively; escalate within 24 hours of identifying a risk that could affect timeline, budget or client satisfaction.
  • Communicate risk status to the client factually and professionally, clients should never be surprised by risks materialising.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Provide regular, honest RAG status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders, amber communicated early is always better than red communicated late.
  • Prepare and deliver clear project status updates, written and verbal, calibrated to the audience, whether operational contacts, project sponsors or senior management.
  • Manage client expectations at the project governance level; escalate relationship risks to your PS lead promptly.

Delivery Coordination -

  • Coordinate across the PS delivery team, Solution Consultants, Implementation Engineers, Test Analysts and Content colleagues, to ensure workstreams are aligned and dependencies are managed.
  • Drive the delivery team through the agreed implementation lifecycle, solution design, configuration, data onboarding, testing, UAT, deployment readiness and production deployment.
  • Run a structured UAT phase with defined acceptance criteria and a clear process for defect management and resolution; obtain written client approval before closing the implementation.
  • Manage change beyond formal project delivery as needed, including post-deployment change requests, defects and transition into steady-state operations.

General Delivery and Change -

  • Manage change beyond formal project delivery as needed, including smaller client change, post-deployment change requests, defects and transition activity, providing appropriate project management ownership through the transition into steady state operations.
  • Support wider Professional Services and Rimes priorities as required, including internal projects and change initiatives aligned to company and functional OKRs, applying project management discipline appropriate to the scale and nature of the work.

AI & Innovation -

  • Actively leverage AI-enabled tools in project management tasks, planning, status reporting, risk tracking, meeting documentation and communications.
  • Stay current with evolving AI tooling relevant to PS delivery and contribute to team adoption of effective new practices.

Requirements:

Knowledge & Experience -

  • Solid working knowledge of project management methodology, ideally including formal certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) or demonstrable equivalent experience.
  • Experience managing client-facing implementation projects in a technology, financial services or data management environment.
  • Understanding of Agile delivery methods and when to apply them within a structured delivery context.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage RAID logs, change control and formal project governance processes.
  • Familiarity with Rimes' products and delivery context, or comparable experience with outsourced data management or financial technology implementations.

Skills -

  • Plans and manages own projects without day-to-day guidance, self-sufficient on familiar project types and delivery challenges.
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication, able to produce concise, accurate status reports and manage client expectations professionally.
  • Confident running governance meetings: sets agendas, manages time, captures decisions and tracks actions.
  • Methodical approach to risk: identifies, assesses and escalates risks before they become issues.
  • Hands-on proficiency with project management tooling — JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Project or equivalent.
  • Comfortable with AI-enabled PM tooling; actively builds efficiency into their delivery practice.

Behaviours -

  • Takes full accountability for delivery on their projects, never delegates accountability upward.
  • Proactively surfaces risks, blockers and status changes, does not wait to be asked and does not go silent when things are not on track.
  • Maintains clear and professional client relationships at the project level, responsive, structured and reliable.
  • Drives the team towards closure, does not consider delivery complete until agreed acceptance criteria are met and production deployment is confirmed.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver, finds ways through obstacles without sacrificing quality or governance.
  • Structured and disciplined, applies consistent rigour to governance, documentation and reporting, even under delivery pressure.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

Rimes is committed to promote the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it’s through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

title: School meal worker (Hot Drop) - St Finbarr's Togher GAA
description:
A little bit about us

Looking for a job that actually makes a difference - and fits into your day-to-day routine?

At The Lunch Bag, we deliver healthy, hot school meals to children across Ireland. We're the country’s leading school meal provider, and we’re on a mission to help children build healthy habits for life.

We’re changing children’s lives, one lunch at a time. Are you flexible, bubbly, and keen to bring a little extra joy to the school day? We’re looking for people who want to help us keep driving forward and doing something great. Bonus? You’re off when the schools are!

So, what’s the job?

We’re on the hunt for School Lunch Operatives – reliable, cheerful people who take pride in doing things right and bring a bit of warmth to every school day.

Think of yourself as the final link in the lunch chain. All meals are prepared in our headquarters in Nenagh, Tipperary, and then delivered to the Hot Drop Locations. It’s from there that you’ll take over. Your duties will consist of heating the meals in the oven, loading them into vans and driving them to the schools.

If you’re a detail addict and thought this was a little vague, here’s a list for you:

  • Load pre-packaged school meals into ovens.

  • Turn on oven and heat meals to specific temperature according to HACCP guidelines.

  • Unload ovens and load into vans.

  • Drive the lunches in a company vehicle to the local schools.

  • Ensure adequate stock levels.

  • Follow and maintain work and cleaning schedule.

  • Maintain temperature and cleaning records.

  • HACCP and Manual Handling Training will be provided.

What we’re looking for

Since you’ll be representing The Lunch Bag in schools, we’re looking for doers - people who are sound, good-natured, and genuinely care about doing a good job. Our values matter to us, and to keep improving the lives of children across the country, we need people who share that same goal.

We’re not asking for bodybuilders, but you do need to be able to lift 14kg boxes as part of the job. You may also need to climb some stairs – not every facility in Ireland has a lift

Working for children is really rewarding – their cute little faces can brighten your day... just don’t let them get hungry or they’ll turn into tiny monsters! So we’re looking for someone who can work quickly, stay calm under pressure, and still do things properly.

All you need is the ability to read English, have full clean Irish driving license, and heat each lunch with care.

We’re looking for cheerful people who like being out and about. Teleportation would make life easier, but until that arrives, we need drivers who are happy to take a roughly one-hour trip to deliver meals to local schools.

I still have questions actually…

No problem! We’re here to answer them.

When will I work?

This job is offered on a part-time basis, 6 hours a day, Monday through Friday! Typical hours of work are 08:30 to 14:30 with some flexibility required as start and finish times may be a little earlier or later.

Will I have to work all year long?

No! As schools close for the summer, we follow the academic calendar. As a result, you will work with us approx 183 days of the year and will have the rest off to enjoy some well-deserved rest! Our staff sign on to Social Welfare as Educational Sector Workers during the summer months.

What benefits do I get by joining The Lunch Bag?

Well, for starters - a genuinely supportive team who’ve got your back.

The role’s flexible, ideal if you’re looking to ease back into work or just want something steady during school terms.

How much is it paid?

It’s THE question everybody is asking! The same way we take care of the children in the schools, we take care of our people. You will earn €14.65 per hour – 50c above minimum wage.
